en: to own
exampleEn: They have a beautiful home.
exampleCn: 他们有一个漂亮的家。

en: used to introduce an added statement, usually something that is different from what you have said before
exampleEn: She's very hard-working but not very imaginative.
exampleCn: 她工作很努力，但缺乏想象力。

en: a large amount or to a large degree
exampleEn: I don't earn much money.
exampleCn: 我赚钱不多。

en: someone who is learning at a school
exampleEn: Student numbers are expanding rapidly.
exampleCn: 学生人数在迅速增加。

en: used to connect different possibilities
exampleEn: Is it Tuesday or Wednesday today?
exampleCn: 今天是星期二还是星期三？

en: a little more or less than the stated number or amount
exampleEn: about two months ago

en: in a good way, to a high or satisfactory standard
exampleEn: a well-paid job

en: to enjoy or approve of something or someone
exampleEn: Do you like fish?
exampleCn: 你爱吃鱼吗？

en: to have information in your mind
exampleEn: Do you know his address?
exampleCn: 你知道他的地址吗？

en: every one (of), or the complete amount or number (of), or the whole (of)
exampleEn: All animals have to eat in order to live.
exampleCn: 所有动物都必须吃东西才能生存。

en: to produce something, often using a particular substance or material
exampleEn: Do you want me to make some coffee?
exampleCn: 要我煮些咖啡吗？

en: as well as the thing or person already mentioned
exampleEn: Are there any other questions?
exampleCn: 还有其他问题没有？

cn: 获得，得到；买到；挣得，赢得
en: to obtain, buy, or earn something
exampleEn: He went to the shop to get some milk.
exampleCn: 他到那家小店买牛奶去了。

en: the part of existence that is measured in minutes, days, years, etc., or this process considered as a whole
exampleEn: We didn't have much time.
exampleCn: 我们没多少时间。

en: to put something such as a tool, skill, or building to a particular purpose
exampleEn: Could I use your phone, please?
exampleCn: 请让我用一下你的电话可以吗？

en: at the present time, not in the past or future
exampleEn: Jim now works in construction.
exampleCn: 吉姆现在从事建造业。

en: a clear liquid, without colour or taste, that falls from the sky as rain and is necessary for animal and plant life
exampleEn: She took a mouthful of water.
exampleCn: 她喝了一大口水。

en: to be conscious of what is around you by using your eyes
exampleEn: Did you see what happened?
exampleCn: 你看见出什么事了吗？

en: used to join two parts of a comparison
exampleEn: My son is a lot taller than my daughter.
exampleCn: 我的儿子比女儿高得多。

en: men, women, and children
exampleEn: Many people never do any exercise.
exampleCn: 许多人从来不做任何运动。

en: for the reason that
exampleEn: I chose boxing because it is my favourite sport.
exampleCn: 我选择了拳击，因为那是我最喜爱的运动。

en: a living thing that grows in earth, in water, or on other plants, usually has a stem, leaves, roots, and flowers, and produces seeds
exampleEn: native plants and animals
exampleCn: 原产于当地的动植物

en: in addition
exampleEn: She's a photographer and also writes books.
exampleCn: 她是个摄影师，还是个作家。

en: some but not all of a thing
exampleEn: Part of my steak isn't cooked properly.
exampleCn: 我这块牛排有些部分没做好。

en: correct
exampleEn: You got three answers right and two wrong.
exampleCn: 你答对了三道题，错了两道。

en: next or after that
exampleEn: Let me finish this job, then we'll go.
exampleCn: 让我把这工作做完，我们再走。

cn:
①相信；觉得；思考

②考虑；想；思索
en:
①to believe something or have an opinion or idea

②to use the brain to plan something, solve a problem, understand a situation, etc.
exampleEn: I think that I've met you before.
exampleCn: 我觉得以前见过你。

cn: 令人满意的；令人愉快的；合意的；有趣的
en: very satisfactory, enjoyable, pleasant, or interesting
exampleEn: I've just had some very good news.
exampleCn: 我刚得知一些特别令人开心的消息。

cn:
①班；班级

②（货物、服务或人的）等级，类别，级别
en:
①a group of students who have lessons together

②a group into which goods, services or people are put according to their standard
exampleEn: Which class are you in this year?
exampleCn: 今年你在哪个班？

en: different from one that existed earlier
exampleEn: She's looking for a new job.
exampleCn: 她在找新工作。

cn:
①工作，活儿；劳动

②作品，著作
en:
①an activity, such as a job, that a person uses physical or mental effort to do, usually for money

②something created as a result of effort, especially a painting, book, or piece of music
exampleEn: I've got so much work to do.
exampleCn: 我有一大堆工作要做。

cn: 第一（的）；首先；最初；首要（的）
en: (a person or thing) coming before all others in order, time, amount, quality, or importance
exampleEn: This is my first visit to New York.
exampleCn: 这是我第一次到纽约。

en: to travel or move to another place
exampleEn: We don't go to the cinema very often these days.
exampleCn: 近来我们不大常看电影。

en: used mainly in negative sentences and questions and with "too", "so", and "as" to mean "a large number of"
exampleEn: I don't have many clothes.
exampleCn: 我衣服不多。

en: in fact
exampleEn: He isn't really angry - he's just pretending.
exampleCn: 他不是真生气——他只是假装的。

en: to move something or someone from one place to another
exampleEn: Take the book up to the third floor of the library.
exampleCn: 把书拿到图书馆的三层。

cn:
①小的，少的

②幼小的，年幼的
en:
①small in size or amount

②young
exampleEn: a little dog

en: to a great degree or extremely
exampleEn: The situation is very serious.
exampleCn: 形势非常严峻。

en: to pronounce words or sounds, to express a thought, opinion, or suggestion, or to state a fact or instruction
exampleEn: Small children find it difficult to say long words.
exampleCn: 小孩子觉得长词不好说。

en: a period of twelve months, especially from 1 January to 31 December
exampleEn: Annette worked in Italy for two years.
exampleCn: 安妮特在意大利工作了两年。

en: used to show that there is a single one or very few of something, or that there are no others
exampleEn: I was the only person on the train.
exampleCn: 我是火车上唯一的乘客。

en: anything that lives and moves, including people, birds, etc.
exampleEn: Both children are real animal lovers.
exampleCn: 两个孩子都很喜爱动物。

en: to direct your eyes in order to see
exampleEn: They looked at the picture and laughed.
exampleCn: 他们看了看那幅画，笑了起来。

cn: 不同的，不一样的，有差别的
en: not the same
exampleEn: We each have different needs and interests.
exampleCn: 我们每人有不同的需要和兴趣。

en: to give attention to someone or something in order to hear him, her, or it
exampleEn: He spent his time listening to the radio.
exampleCn: 他把时间花在了听收音机上。

en: used to refer in an approximate way to an object or to avoid naming it
exampleEn: There are some nice things in the shops this summer.
exampleCn: 今年夏天商店里有些好东西。

en: to move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker
exampleEn: Are you coming with me?
exampleCn: 你跟我来吗？

en: to have to have something, or to want something very much
exampleEn: Babies need constant care.
exampleCn: 婴儿时刻都需要人照看。

en: to make or become different
exampleEn: We can't change our plans now.
exampleCn: 我们现在不能改变计划了。

cn:
①大量的；巨大的；强烈的

②美妙的，好极的，很棒的
en:
①large in amount, size, or degree

②very good
exampleEn: an enormous great hole

en: a large amount or number of people or things
exampleEn: She eats lots of fruit.
exampleCn: 她水果吃得很多。

cn: 早期的，初期的；在早期，在初期；提早（的），提前（的）
en: near the beginning of a period of time
exampleEn: She was in her early teens.
exampleCn: 她有十三四岁了。

en: to start to happen or exist
exampleEn: What time does the concert begin?
exampleCn: 音乐会什么时候开始？

cn:
①长时间的，长久的

②（距离、长度）长的
en:
①continuing for a large amount of time

②being a distance between two points that is more than average or usual
exampleEn: a long film

en: something that is typical of the group of things that it is a member of
exampleEn: This painting is a marvellous example of her work.
exampleCn: 这幅画是她非常出色的代表作。

en: not another different place, time, situation, person, or thing
exampleEn: My brother and I sleep in the same room.
exampleCn: 我弟弟和我睡在同一个房间。

cn:
①学习；攻读；研读

②仔细研究；调查
en:
①to learn about a subject, especially in an educational course or by reading books

②to examine something very carefully
exampleEn: to study biology

en: to say words aloud; to speak to someone
exampleEn: My little girl has just started to talk.
exampleCn: 我的小女儿刚开始说话。

cn:
①一些；一点；若干

②任何一个，无论哪个
en:
①some, or even the smallest amount or number of

②one of or each of a particular type of person or thing when it is not important which
exampleEn: Is there any of that lemon cake left?
exampleCn: 还剩下任何柠檬蛋糕吗？

en: to make it possible or easier for someone to do something, by doing part of the work yourself or by providing advice, money, support, etc.
exampleEn: How can I help you?
exampleCn: 我如何才能帮你呢？

en: generous, helpful, and thinking about other people's feelings
exampleEn: She's a very kind and thoughtful person.
exampleCn: 她是个非常宽容体贴的人。

en: an object, situation, quality, or action that is not exactly known or stated
exampleEn: There's something sharp in my shoe.
exampleCn: 我的鞋子里有个尖东西。

cn:
①小的；少的；矮小的

②年幼的，幼小的
en:
①little in size or amount when compared with what is typical or average

②A small child is a very young child that is older than a baby.
exampleEn: a small dog

en: necessary or of great value
exampleEn: They had important matters to discuss.
exampleCn: 他们有些重要的问题要讨论。

cn: 食物；食品；（供植物生长的）养料
en: something that people and animals eat, or plants absorb, to keep them alive
exampleEn: There was a lot of food and drink at the party.
exampleCn: 聚会上供应了大量的食物和饮料。

en: to offer something to someone, or to provide someone with something
exampleEn: They never gave me a chance.
exampleCn: 他们从来就没给过我机会。

en: to make it possible for something to be seen
exampleEn: Let me show you this new book I've just bought.
exampleCn: 给你看看我刚买的这本新书。

en: to begin doing something
exampleEn: They started building the house in January.
exampleCn: 他们一月份动工盖这所房子。

cn:
①离开；离去；走开

②留下；剩下
en:
①to go away from someone or something, for a short time or permanently

②If something leaves something else, a part or effect of it stays after it has gone or been used.
exampleEn: The bus leaves in five minutes.
exampleCn: 公共汽车五分钟后发车。

en:
①more than is needed or wanted; more than is suitable or enough

②in addition, also
exampleEn: I'm too fat.
exampleCn: 我太胖了。

cn: （偶然）发现，碰上；找到，寻得；找出，查明
en: to discover, especially where a thing or person is, either unexpectedly or by searching, or to discover where to get or how to achieve something
exampleEn: I couldn't find Andrew's phone number.
exampleCn: 我找不到安德鲁的电话号码。

en: an area, town, building, etc.
exampleEn: Her garden was a cool pleasant place to sit.
exampleCn: 坐在她的花园里真是凉爽宜人。

en: a unit that forms part of the system of counting and calculating
exampleEn: Think of a number and multiply it by two.
exampleCn: 想出一个数，然后乘以二。

cn:
①课程；教程

②进展；进程；经过，过程
en:
①a set of classes or a plan of study on a particular subject, usually leading to an exam or qualification

②the often gradual development of something, or the way something happens, or a way of doing somethingt
exampleEn: They're going away on a training course next week.
exampleCn: 下星期他们要出去上实习课。

cn:
①末期的；晚期的；接近终了

②迟的，晚的；延迟的
en:
①near the end of a period of time

②after the planned, expected, usual, or necessary time
exampleEn: We talked late into the night.
exampleCn: 我们一直谈到深夜。

en: a tall plant that has a wooden trunk and branches that grow from its upper part
exampleEn: We sat under a tree for shade.
exampleCn: 我们坐在树下乘凉。

en: a coloured liquid that is put on a surface such as a wall to decorate it
exampleEn: This wall needs another coat of paint.
exampleCn: 这面墙需要再刷一层漆。

en: every thing, person, etc. in a group of two or more, considered separately
exampleEn: Each ticket admits one adult.
exampleCn: 每张票只准许一位成人入场。

en: a number of people or things that are put together or considered as a unit
exampleEn: I'm meeting a group of friends for dinner tonight.
exampleCn: 今晚我要与一帮朋友聚餐。

en: When you play, especially as a child, you spend time doing an enjoyable and/or entertaining activity.
exampleEn: The children spent the afternoon playing with their new toys.
exampleCn: 孩子们下午在玩自己的新玩具。

en: to make marks that represent letters, words, or numbers on a surface, such as paper or a computer screen, using a pen, pencil, or keyboard, or to use this method to record thoughts, facts, or messages
exampleEn: When you fill in the form, please write clearly in black ink.
exampleCn: 填表时，请用黑色墨水书写清楚。

en: (a) talk between two or more people in which thoughts, feelings, and ideas are expressed, questions are asked and answered, or news and information is exchanged
exampleEn: She had a strange conversation with the man who moved in upstairs.
exampleCn: 她跟搬到楼上的那个家伙进行了一次奇怪的交谈。

cn: 寿命；生命；一生，人生；生活；性命
en: the period between birth and death, or the experience or state of being alive
exampleEn: Life's too short to worry about money.
exampleCn: 人生短暂，何必为金钱而烦恼.

en: a large town
exampleEn: We took some photos of the city.
exampleCn: 我们拍了一些这个城市的照片。

cn: （须解决的）问题；疑难问题，困难
en: a situation, person, or thing that needs attention and needs to be dealt with or solved
exampleEn: Our main problem is lack of cash.
exampleCn: 我们的主要问题是缺乏现金。

en: a creature with feathers and wings, usually able to fly
exampleEn: Most birds lay eggs in the spring.
exampleCn: 大多数鸟都在春天产卵。

en: (on) the present day
exampleEn: What's the date today?
exampleCn: 今天几号？

en: the star that provides light and heat for the earth and around which the earth moves
exampleEn: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
exampleCn: 太阳东升西落。

en: a set of pages that have been fastened together inside a cover to be read or written in
exampleEn: I took a book with me to read on the plane.
exampleCn: 我随身带了本书在飞机上看。

en: red, blue, green, yellow, etc.
exampleEn: What's your favourite colour?
exampleCn: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

en: a period of 24 hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night
exampleEn: I saw Tom three days ago.
exampleCn: 我三天前见过汤姆。

cn: 上一次的；最近的；最后的
en: the most recent or the one before the present one
exampleEn: The last time I saw him was in May.
exampleCn: 我上次见到他是在五月份。

en: a sentence or phrase used to find out information
exampleEn: The police asked me questions all day.
exampleCn: 警察盘问了我一整天。

en: the final part of something such as a period of time, activity, or story
exampleEn: The end of the play was much more exciting than I'd expected.
exampleCn: 电影结尾比我预想的刺激多了。

en: to say something to someone, often giving them information or instructions
exampleEn: Tell me about your holiday then.
exampleCn: 那么跟我说说你的假期吧。

en: the earth and all the people, places, and things on it
exampleEn: a world record

en: two people or things together
exampleEn: Both my parents are teachers.
exampleCn: 我的父母都是教师。

en: many times
exampleEn: I often see him in the garden.
exampleCn: 我常见他在花园里。

en: having lived or existed for many years
exampleEn: We're all getting older.
exampleCn: 我们都老了。

en: the period of time someone has been alive or something has existed
exampleEn: Do you know the age of that building?
exampleCn: 你知道那座楼的历史有多久吗？

en: to look at words or symbols and understand what they mean
exampleEn: He spent a pleasant afternoon reading a book.
exampleCn: 他一下午都在阅读书，过得很开心。

en: the whole physical structure that forms a person or animal
exampleEn: A good diet and plenty of exercise will help you to keep your body healthy.
exampleCn: 良好的饮食和充足的锻炼将有助于保持身体健康。

cn: 下一个的；其次的；紧接着的
en: being the first one after the present one or after the one just mentioned
exampleEn: She's away for the next few days.
exampleCn: 接下来几天她休假。

en: a pattern of sounds made by musical instruments, voices, or computers, or a combination of these, intended to give pleasure to people listening to it
exampleEn: He is interested in music.
exampleCn: 他对音乐有兴趣。

en: a building that people, usually one family, live in
exampleEn: She lives in a little house in Cross Street.
exampleCn: 她住在十字街上的一所小房子里。

en: large in size or amount
exampleEn: They have a big house in the country.
exampleCn: 他们在乡下有一幢大房子。

cn:
①电影；影片

②薄薄的一层；薄膜
en:
①a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story

②a thin layer of something on a surface
exampleEn: I hate people talking while I'm watching a film.
exampleCn: 我讨厌看电影时有人讲话。

cn: 记得，记起；回想起；记住；牢记
en: to be able to bring back a piece of information into your mind, or to keep a piece of information in your memory
exampleEn: Can you remember what her phone number is?
exampleCn: 你记得她的电话号码是多少吗？

en: a natural wide flow of fresh water across the land into the sea, a lake, or another river
exampleEn: We sailed slowly down the river.
exampleCn: 我们顺流而下

en: every time or all the time
exampleEn: It's always cold in this room.
exampleCn: 这间屋里总是那么冷。

en:
①thin, flat material made from crushed wood or cloth, used for writing, printing, or drawing on

②a short piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one done by students as part of the work for a course
exampleEn: a piece of paper

en: used when referring to all the members of a group of three or more
exampleEn: The police want to interview every employee about the theft.
exampleCn: 警方想就盗窃案件与每位员工面谈。

en: a boy or girl from the time of birth until he or she is an adult, or a son or daughter of any age
exampleEn: As a child I didn't eat vegetables.
exampleCn: 我小时候不爱吃蔬菜。

en: to (cause something to) change from being open to not being open
exampleEn: Could you close the door please?
exampleCn: 请关上门，好吗？

en: to know the meaning of something that someone says
exampleEn: Is there anyone here who understands Arabic?
exampleCn: 这儿有人懂阿拉伯语吗？

en: up to (the time that)
exampleEn: We didn't eat until past midnight.
exampleCn: 直到过了午夜我们才吃东西。

en: the word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by
exampleEn: The students were listed by name and by country of origin.
exampleCn: 学生按照姓名和国籍登记入册。

en: with each other
exampleEn: We used to go to yoga together.
exampleCn: 我们过去常常一起去做瑜伽。

en: the salty water that covers a large part of the surface of the earth, or a large area of salty water, smaller than an ocean, that is partly or completely surrounded by land
exampleEn: We went swimming in the sea.
exampleCn: 我们去海里游泳。

en: to receive or become conscious of a sound using your ears
exampleEn: She heard a noise outside.
exampleCn: 她听到外面一阵嘈杂。

en: to move something or someone into the stated place, position, or direction
exampleEn: Put your clothes in the cupboard.
exampleCn: 把你的衣服放在衣橱里。

en: one more time
exampleEn: Could you spell your name again, please?
exampleCn: 请您再拼一次您的名字好吗？

en: a period of seven days, especially either from Monday to Sunday or from Sunday to Saturday
exampleEn: We go to the cinema about once a week.
exampleCn: 我们大约一周去看一次电影。

en: to move something to a position that is not closed, or to make something change to a position that is not closed
exampleEn: Could you open the window, please?
exampleCn: 请打开窗户好吗？

en: having or producing a comfortably high temperature, although not hot
exampleEn: I put my hands in my pockets to keep them warm.
exampleCn: 我把手放在衣兜里保暖。

cn:
①坚硬的，坚固的

②困难的，费力的
en:
①not easy to bend, cut, or break

②difficult to understand, do, experience, or deal with
exampleEn: a hard surface

en: immediately after the first and before any others
exampleEn: This is the second time I've had flu this winter.
exampleCn: 这是今年冬天以来我得的第二场流感。

en: a system of communication consisting of sounds, words, and grammar, or the system of communication used by people in a particular country or type of work
exampleEn: She does research into how children acquire language.
exampleCn: 她研究儿童是如何习得语言的。

en: able to be done or achieved, or able to exist
exampleEn: Is it possible to buy tickets in advance?
exampleCn: 可以提前订票吗？

en: a single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written
exampleEn: Some words are more difficult to spell than others.
exampleCn: 有些词比其他的词难拼写。

en: a current of air moving approximately horizontally, especially one strong enough to be felt
exampleEn: There isn't enough wind to fly a kite.
exampleCn: 风不够大，风筝飞不起来。

en: a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling
exampleEn: I like this room - it has plenty of light.
exampleCn: 我喜欢这个房间——光线非常充足。

en: having lived or existed for only a short time and not old
exampleEn: His girlfriend's very young.
exampleCn: 他的女朋友非常年轻。

en: a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or surrounds something
exampleEn: He crashed his car into a wall.
exampleCn: 他的汽车撞到了墙上。

en: the season between autumn and spring, lasting from November to March north of the equator and from May to September south of the equator, when the weather is coldest
exampleEn: I think you tend to eat more in winter.
exampleCn: 我想你在冬天可能会吃得更多。

en: an animal that lives in water, is covered with scales, and breathes by taking water in through its mouth, or the flesh of these animals eaten as food
exampleEn: Several large fish live in the pond.
exampleCn: 池塘里有几条大鱼。

en: to get knowledge or skill in a new subject or activity
exampleEn: They learn Russian at school.
exampleCn: 他们在学校学俄语。

en: on some occasions but not always or often
exampleEn: Sometimes it's best not to say anything.
exampleCn: 有时候，最好是什么话都别说。

en: to hold something or someone with your hands, arms, or on your back and take them from one place to another
exampleEn: Let me carry your bag for you.
exampleCn: 让我帮你拿包吧。

cn:
①国家；国土 

②乡村，乡下
en:
①an area of land that has its own government, army, etc.

②land that is not in towns, cities, or industrial areas and is either used for farming or left in its natural condition
exampleEn: The climate is cooler in the east of the country.
exampleCn: 该国东部气候比较凉爽。

en:
①in or to a position that is further than a particular point

②used to say what the time is when it is a particular number of minutes after an hour
exampleEn: I live on Station Road, just past the post office.
exampleCn: 我住在车站路，就在邮局过去一点。

en: the part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things
exampleEn: All their toys are made by hand.
exampleCn: 他们所有的玩具都是手工制作的。

en: to put or take food into the mouth, chew it, and swallow it
exampleEn: We usually eat at about seven o'clock.
exampleCn: 我们通常在七点前后吃饭。

en: having a low temperature
exampleEn: My feet are so cold.
exampleCn: 我的双脚冰凉。

en: not far away in distance
exampleEn: Is there a restaurant near here?
exampleCn: 这附近有餐馆吗？

en: the house, apartment, etc. where you live, especially with your family
exampleEn: He left home when he was 23.
exampleCn: 他二十三岁时离家独立生活。

en: not at any time or not on any occasion
exampleEn: We've never been to Australia.
exampleCn: 我们从未去过澳大利亚。

cn:
①短的；矮的

②短的，短暂的
en:
①small in length, distance, or height

②being an amount of time that is less than average or usual
exampleEn: a short skirt

en: a numbered day in a month, often given with a combination of the name of the day, the month, and the year
exampleEn: What is your date of birth？
exampleCn: 你的出生日期是什么时候？

cn:
①任何东西，任何事物

②无论什么东西；随便什么事情
en:
①used in questions and negatives to mean "something"

②any event, act, object, or situation
exampleEn: Is there anything I can do to help?
exampleCn: 有任何事情我能帮上忙的吗？

en: the activity of buying and selling goods and services
exampleEn: He's in the frozen food business.
exampleCn: 他做冷冻食品生意。

en: an electronic machine that is used for storing, organizing, and finding words, numbers, and pictures, for doing calculations, and for controlling other machines
exampleEn: All our customer orders are handled by computer.
exampleCn: 我们所有顾客的订单都是用电脑来处理的。

en: a period of 60 minutes
exampleEn: The exam lasted an hour and a half.
exampleCn: 考试持续了一个半小时。

en: needing little effort
exampleEn: an easy exam

en: the part of a plant that is often brightly coloured and has a pleasant smell, or the type of plant that produces these
exampleEn: They've got some beautiful flower beds in their garden.
exampleCn: 他们的花园里有一些漂亮的花坛。

en: the part of every 24-hour period when it is dark because there is very little light from the sun
exampleEn: I slept really badly last night.
exampleCn: 我昨晚睡得很不好。

en: the regular work that a person does to earn money
exampleEn: He's never managed to hold down a steady job.
exampleCn: 他从来没能保住一份稳定的工作。

cn:
①画，绘画

②吸引，引起（兴趣、注意）
en:
①to make a picture of something or someone with a pencil or pen

②to attract attention or interest
exampleEn: Jonathan can draw very well.
exampleCn: 乔纳森的画画得相当棒。

en: a period of about four weeks, especially one of the twelve periods into which a year is divided
exampleEn: He shut himself away for a month to catch up on his academic work.
exampleCn: 他与世隔绝一个月，力图把功课赶上去。

en: drops of water from clouds
exampleEn: Come inside out of the rain.
exampleCn: 进屋来，别在雨里淋着。

en: an adult female human being
exampleEn: She's a really nice woman.
exampleCn: 她真是个非常好的女人。

en: a place where people people study for an undergraduate or postgraduate  degree
exampleEn: Which university were you at?
exampleCn: 你曾就读于哪所大学？

en: needing skill or effort
exampleEn: It will be very difficult to prove that they are guilty.
exampleCn: 证明他们有罪将非常困难。

en: a hard, transparent material, used to make windows, bottles, and other objects
exampleEn: coloured glass

en: a place where children go to be educated
exampleEn: They're building a new school in the town.
exampleCn: 他们正在镇里建一座新学校。

en: the flat surface of a room on which you walk
exampleEn: The bathroom floor needs cleaning.
exampleCn: 浴室地面需要清洁。

en: a drawing, painting, photograph, etc.
exampleEn: Freddy drew a picture of my dog.
exampleCn: 弗雷迪给我的狗画了一张像。

cn:
①跑，奔跑

②（使）运转；（使）运作；（使）运行；操作
en:
①(of people and some animals) to move along, faster than walking, by taking quick steps in which each foot is lifted before the next foot touches the ground

②to (cause something to) operate
exampleEn: I can run a mile in five minutes.
exampleCn: 我可以在五分钟里跑一英里。

en: the small, soft, white pieces of ice that sometimes fall from the sky when it is cold, or the white layer on the ground and other surfaces that it forms
exampleEn: Outside the snow began to fall.
exampleCn: 外面开始下雪了。

en: to experience something physical or emotional
exampleEn: My eyes feel really sore.
exampleCn: 我的眼睛真的很痛。

en: a mother or father of a person or an animal
exampleEn: He's still living with his parents.
exampleCn: 他还和父母住在一起。

en: the part of the body above the neck where the eyes, nose, mouth, ears, and brain are
exampleEn: Put this hat on to keep your head warm.
exampleCn: 戴上这顶帽子，给头部保暖。

en: the season of the year between spring and autumn when the weather is warmest, lasting from June to September north of the equator and from December to March south of the equator
exampleEn: We have breakfast on the balcony in the summer.
exampleCn: 夏天，我们在阳台上吃早饭。

en: to give someone knowledge or to train someone; to instruct
exampleEn: She taught English to foreign students.
exampleCn: 她给外国学生讲授英语。

en: a group of people who are related to each other, such as a mother, a father, and their children
exampleEn: He doesn't have any family.
exampleCn: 他没有任何亲人。

en: to give money to someone for something you want to buy or for services provided
exampleEn: How much did you pay for the tickets?
exampleCn: 你买那些票花了多少钱？

en: a place where people live and work, containing many houses, shops, places of work, places of entertainment, etc., and usually larger than a village but smaller than a city
exampleEn: We stayed in the best hotel in town.
exampleCn: 我们住在镇上最好的旅馆里。

en: to make a journey, usually over a long distance
exampleEn: As a young man he had travelled the world.
exampleCn: 他年轻时周游过世界。

en: a common white substance found in sea water and in the ground, used especially to add flavour to food or to preserve it
exampleEn: Can you pass the salt, please?
exampleCn: 请把盐递过来好吗？

en: moving or happening quickly, or able to move or happen quickly
exampleEn: Computers are getting faster all the time.
exampleCn: 计算机的速度在不断提升。

en: the front of the head, where the eyes, nose, and mouth are
exampleEn: She has a long, thin face.
exampleCn: 她长着一张瘦长的脸。

cn:
①遇见，遇到

②满足；达到，完成
en:
①to come together with someone without intending to

②to fulfil, satisfy, or achieve
exampleEn: Guess who I met in town today.
exampleCn: 猜猜今天我在城里遇到了谁。

en: any type of shop
exampleEn: a clothing store

en: a way of discovering, by questions or practical activities, what someone knows, or what someone or something can do or is like
exampleEn: The class are having a spelling test today.
exampleCn: 今天班里有一个拼写测验。

en: words or actions that show you are grateful or pleased about something
exampleEn: They expressed their thanks to the organizers.
exampleCn: 他们对组织者表达了谢意。

en: a person or animal that has grown to full size and strength
exampleEn: Adults pay an admission charge but children get in free.
exampleCn: 成年人买票入内，儿童免费。

en: having a high temperature
exampleEn: hot weather

en: coins or notes that are used to buy things, or an amount of these that a person has:
exampleEn: He robs her of money.
exampleCn: 他抢夺她的财产。

en: a man, woman, or child
exampleEn: Who was the first person to swim the English Channel?
exampleCn: 游过英吉利海峡的第一人是谁？

cn:
①钥匙

②（练习或考试的）问题答案
en:
①a piece of metal that has been cut into a special shape and is used for opening or closing a lock, starting a car engine, etc.

②a list of the answers to the questions in an exercise or test
exampleEn: car keys

en: a side of one of the pieces of paper in a book, newspaper, or magazine, usually with a number printed on it
exampleEn: The title is right at the top of the page.
exampleCn: 标题就在页面的顶端。

cn: 好的；足够好的；健康的，身体好的
en: good or good enough; healthy and well
exampleEn: I felt terrible last night but I feel fine this morning.
exampleCn: 我昨晚感觉很不舒服，但今天早上就好了。

cn:
①（讨论、考虑或研究的）主题，话题；问题；题目

②（中小学或大学的）学科；科目；专业
en:
①the thing that is being discussed, considered, or studied

②an area of knowledge that is studied in school, college, or university
exampleEn: Our subject for discussion is homelessness.
exampleCn: 我们讨论的话题是无家可归问题。

en: to get something by paying money for it
exampleEn: Eventually she had saved enough money to buy a small car.
exampleCn: 她最终存够了买一辆小汽车的钱。

cn: 回答；作答；答应；答复；答案
en: a reaction to a question, letter, phone call, etc.
exampleEn: I got eight correct answers and two wrong ones in last week's exam.
exampleCn: 上周考试，我做对了八道题，做错了两道。

en: an adult male human being
exampleEn: Steve can solve anything - the man's a genius.
exampleCn: 史蒂夫能解决一切——此人是个天才。

en: a short piece of writing
exampleEn: He left a note to say he would be home late.
exampleCn: 他留下字条说他会晚点回家。

en: to move the body and feet to music
exampleEn: They danced to the beat of the drums.
exampleCn: 他们随着鼓声跳舞。

en: to cause something to go from one place to another, especially by post or email
exampleEn: I'll send her a letter next week.
exampleCn: 我下周要给她寄信。

en: one of the 60 parts that an hour is divided into, consisting of 60 seconds
exampleEn: It takes me 20 minutes to get to work.
exampleCn: 我上班路上要花二十分钟。

en: someone whose job is to teach in a school or college
exampleEn: She's a very capable teacher.
exampleCn: 她是一位能力很强的教师。

en: an area of land, together with a house and buildings, used for growing crops and/or keeping animals as a business
exampleEn: She spent the summer working on a farm.
exampleCn: 她的夏天在农场劳作中度过了。

cn:
①桌子；台子；餐桌

②（一览）表，表格
en:
①a flat surface, usually supported by four legs, used for putting things on

②an arrangement of facts and numbers in rows or blocks, especially in printed material
exampleEn: Could you set the table for lunch, please?
exampleCn: 你来摆下餐桌准备吃午饭好吗？

en: to allow time to go by, especially while staying in one place without doing very much, until someone comes, until something that you are expecting happens or until you can do something
exampleEn: I waited for her outside while she went in to see the doctor.
exampleCn: 她进去看病时我在外面等她。

en: to look at something for a period of time, especially something that is changing or moving
exampleEn: I had dinner and watched TV for a couple of hours.
exampleCn: 我吃了饭，然后看了几个小时电视。

en: the oval object with a hard shell that is produced by female birds, especially chickens, eaten as food
exampleEn: How do you like your eggs - fried or boiled?
exampleCn: 鸡蛋你想怎样吃？是吃煎的还是煮的？

en: to not move away from or leave a place or situation
exampleEn: Stay until the rain has stopped.
exampleCn: 等雨停再走吧。

en: the conditions in the air above the earth such as wind, rain, or temperature, especially at a particular time over a particular area
exampleEn: The weather has turned cold.
exampleCn: 天气变得寒冷了。

en: a large animal with four legs that people ride on or use for carrying things or pulling vehicles
exampleEn: to ride a horse

en: moving, happening, or doing something without much speed
exampleEn: a slow runner

cn: 坏的，不好的；令人不悦的
en: unpleasant and causing difficulties or harm
exampleEn: We've just had some very bad news.
exampleCn: 我们刚刚得到了一些很不好的消息。

en: a low, green plant that grows naturally over a lot of the earth's surface, having groups of very thin leaves that grow close together in large numbers
exampleEn: Small things stirred in the grass around the tent.
exampleCn: 帐篷周围的草丛里有小东西在动。

en: the part of the body at the bottom of the leg on which a person or animal stands
exampleEn: I've got a blister on my left foot.
exampleCn: 我左脚上起了个水疱。

en: a piece of electronic equipment used for listening to radio broadcasts
exampleEn: I switched on the radio.
exampleCn: 我打开了收音机。

en: to finish doing something that you were doing
exampleEn: I couldn't stop laughing.
exampleCn: 我忍不住笑个没完。

cn:
①昏暗的，黑暗的

②（颜色）暗的，深色的
en:
①with little or no light

②nearer to black than white in colour
exampleEn: It was too dark to see much.
exampleCn: 光线太暗，看不清楚。

en: a building where objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest are kept
exampleEn: a museum of modern art
exampleCn: 现代艺术博物馆

en: to say words, to use the voice, or to have a conversation with someone
exampleEn: Would you mind speaking more slowly, please?
exampleCn: 请你再慢点说，好吗？

en: to move along by putting one foot in front of the other, allowing each foot to touch the ground before lifting the next
exampleEn: He walks two miles to work every morning.
exampleCn: 他每天早晨步行两英里去上班。

en: known and recognized by many people
exampleEn: His books are world-famous.
exampleCn: 他的著作举世闻名。

en: a road vehicle with an engine, four wheels, and seats for a small number of people
exampleEn: They don't have a car.
exampleCn: 他们没有车。

en: a group of houses and other buildings that is smaller than a town, usually in the countryside
exampleEn: a fishing village

en: costing little money or less than is usual or expected
exampleEn: I got a cheap flight at the last minute.
exampleCn: 我在最后一刻买到了一张便宜的机票。

en: a film shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story
exampleEn: The movie was over shortly before six.
exampleCn: 电影在六点钟不到就结束了。

cn: 昂贵的；花钱多的；价格高的
en: costing a lot of money
exampleEn: Rolls Royces are very expensive.
exampleCn: 劳斯莱斯汽车价格昂贵。

en: a person who you know well and who you like a lot, but who is usually not a member of your family
exampleEn: We've been friends for years.
exampleCn: 我们已是多年的朋友了。

en: to like something very much
exampleEn: She loves animals.
exampleCn: 她喜欢动物。

en: not correct
exampleEn: Three of your answers were wrong.
exampleCn: 你的回答中有三个是错的。

cn: 令人兴奋的；使人激动的；刺激的
en: making you feel excited
exampleEn: It was a really exciting match.
exampleCn: 这的确是一场扣人心弦的比赛。

en:
①an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money

②sloping raised land, especially along the sides of a river
exampleEn: I need to go to the bank at lunchtime.
exampleCn: 我得利用午饭时间去趟银行。

en: the lowest part of something
exampleEn: The ship sank to the bottom of the sea.
exampleCn: 船沉入海底。

en: a large area of land with grass and trees, usually surrounded by fences or walls, and specially arranged so that people can walk in it for pleasure or children can play in it
exampleEn: We watched the joggers in the park.
exampleCn: 我们在公园里看别人慢跑。

en: a railway engine connected to carriages for carrying people or to wheeled containers for carrying goods
exampleEn: Hurry up, or we'll miss the train.
exampleCn: 快点，不然我们就赶不上火车了。

en: to stop living or existing, either suddenly or slowly
exampleEn: Twelve people died in the accident.
exampleCn: 十二人在此次事故中丧生。

cn:
①开（车），驾驶

②驱赶，赶走；迫使，驱使

③驱动；推动
en:
①to move or travel on land in a motor vehicle, especially as the person controlling the vehicle's movement

②to force someone or something to go somewhere or do something

③to provide the power to keep a machine working, or to make something happen
exampleEn: I'm learning to drive.
exampleCn: 我在学开车。

en:
①a written message from one person to another, usually put in an envelope and sent by post

②any of the set of symbols used to write a language, representing a sound in the language
exampleEn: I got a letter from the bank this morning.
exampleCn: 今天早晨我收到了一封银行的来函。

en: a space usually filled with glass in the wall of a building or in a vehicle, to allow light and air in and to allow people inside the building to see out
exampleEn: He caught me staring out of the window.
exampleCn: 他看到我正在向窗外凝视。

en: an area of sand or small stones near the sea or another area of water such as a lake
exampleEn: We spent the day on the beach.
exampleCn: 我们在海滩度过了一整天。

en: a road in a city or town that has buildings that are usually close together along one or both sides
exampleEn: Our daughter lives just across the street from us.
exampleCn: 我们的女儿就住在我们家街对面。

en: (a drink made by pouring hot water onto) dried and cut leaves and sometimes flowers, especially the leaves of the tea plant
exampleEn: Would you like tea or coffee?
exampleCn: 你喝茶还是喝咖啡？

en: to take hold of something, especially something that is moving through the air
exampleEn: I managed to catch the glass before it hit the ground.
exampleCn: 我在玻璃杯落地之前接住了它。

en: to decide what you want from two or more things or possibilities
exampleEn: He chose a shirt from the many in his wardrobe.
exampleCn: 他从衣柜里众多衬衫中选了一件。

en: the part of the day from the time when the sun rises or you wake up until the middle of the day or lunch time
exampleEn: Did you really feel ill this morning?
exampleCn: 今天早晨你真的感到身体不适吗？

en: a regularly printed document consisting of large sheets of paper that are folded together, or a website, containing news reports, articles, photographs, and advertisements
exampleEn: He was carrying a newspaper.
exampleCn: 他正拿着一份报纸。

en: a long, curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside
exampleEn: He slipped on a banana skin.
exampleCn: 他踩在香蕉皮上滑倒了。

en:
①to be unable to remember a fact, something that happened, or how to do something

②to not remember to do something
exampleEn: I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name.
exampleCn: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。

en: a flat, usually round dish with a slightly raised edge that you eat from or serve food from
exampleEn: There's still lots of food on your plate.
exampleCn: 你的盘子里还有很多食物。

en: to (cause someone to) be in a position in which the lower part of the body is resting on a seat or other type of support, with the upper part of the body vertical
exampleEn: He came and sat next to me.
exampleCn: 他走过来坐在我身边。

en: a large, rectangular piece of furniture, often with four legs, used for sleeping on
exampleEn: It's such a comfortable bed.
exampleCn: 这床真舒服。

en: a popular hot drink with a strong smell that is made from dark beans, or the beans or crushed beans from which this drink is made
exampleEn: Would you get some coffee when you go shopping?
exampleCn: 你去买东西时买点咖啡好吗？

en: the soft part containing seeds that is produced by a plant. Many types of fruit are sweet and can be eaten.
exampleEn: Oranges, apples, pears, and bananas are all types of fruit.
exampleCn: 橘子、苹果、梨和香蕉都是水果。

en: a piece of land next to and belonging to a house, where flowers and other plants are grown, and often containing an area of grass
exampleEn: The children were playing in the garden.
exampleCn: 孩子们在花园里玩。

en: to get pleasure from something
exampleEn: I enjoy playing basketball.
exampleCn: 我喜欢打篮球。

en: to wish for a particular thing or plan of action.
exampleEn: I want some chocolate.
exampleCn: 我想要些巧克力。

cn:
①球棒；球拍；球板

②蝙蝠
en:
①a specially shaped piece of wood used for hitting the ball in some games

②a small animal like a mouse with wings that flies at night
exampleEn: a table tennis bat

en: When you cook food, you prepare it to be eaten by heating it in a particular way, such as baking or boiling, and when food cooks, it is heated until it is ready to eat.
exampleEn: I don't cook meat very often.
exampleCn: 我不常做肉吃

en: one of the parts of the body of a human or animal that is used for standing or walking
exampleEn: My legs were tired after so much walking.
exampleCn: 走了这么远的路，我的腿有些累了。

en: having little money and/or few possessions
exampleEn: Most of the world's poorest countries are in Africa.
exampleCn: 世界上最穷的国家多数在非洲。

en: of more than average height, or of a particular height
exampleEn: She's much taller than me.
exampleCn: 她比我高得多。

en: a device for taking photographs or making films or television programmes
exampleEn: She put a new film in her camera.
exampleCn: 她在相机里装上新胶卷。

en: a small animal with fur, four legs and a tail that is kept as a pet
exampleEn: saw that orange cat today.
exampleCn: 今天我看到了那只橘猫。

en: a common animal with four legs, especially kept by people as a pet or to hunt or guard things
exampleEn: We could hear dogs barking in the distance.
exampleCn: 我们可以听到远处的狗叫声。

en: a long, hard surface built for vehicles to travel along
exampleEn: We live on a busy road.
exampleCn: 我们住在一条繁忙的公路边。

cn: 电视机；电视；电视广播业
en: a device shaped like a box with a screen that receives electrical signals and changes them into moving images and sound, or the method or business of sending images and sound by electrical signals
exampleEn: Could you turn the television down?
exampleCn: 你把电视声音调小点好吗？

en: a short piece of information that you give to a person when you cannot speak to them directly
exampleEn: There is an important message for you from your brother.
exampleCn: 你哥哥有个重要的消息要告诉你。

cn: 准备好的，有准备的；现成的；方便使用的
en: prepared and suitable for fast activity
exampleEn: Are you ready to leave?
exampleCn: 你准备好离开了吗？

en: less important than related things
exampleEn: A distinction should be made between the primary and secondary tasks.
exampleCn: 要区别主要的和次要的任务。

en: a group of musicians who play modern music together
exampleEn: The band will be going on tour.
exampleCn: 这个乐队将要进行巡回演出。

cn:
①游戏，运动；游戏用具，运动器具

②野味；野禽；猎物
en:
①an entertaining activity or sport, especially one played by children, or the equipment needed for such an activity

②wild animals and birds that are hunted for food or sport
exampleEn: The children played a game of cops and robbers.
exampleCn: 孩子们玩警察捉强盗的游戏。

en: a musical instrument, usually made of wood, with six strings and a long neck, played with the fingers or a plectrum
exampleEn: He sat on the grass, strumming his guitar.
exampleCn: 他坐在草地上弹着吉他。

en: a building and the surrounding area where buses or trains stop for people to get on or off
exampleEn: Our office is near the station.
exampleCn: 我们的办事处在火车站附近。

en: a square or rectangular container with stiff sides and sometimes a lid
exampleEn: a cardboard box

en: not dirty
exampleEn: It's a beautiful, clean and orderly city.
exampleCn: 这是一座美丽、干净、整齐的城市。

en: a very young child, especially one that has not yet begun to walk or talk
exampleEn: The baby is three months old.
exampleCn: 这婴儿三个月大了。

cn:
①外套，外衣，大衣外套；外衣大衣

②（动物的）皮毛
en:
①an outer piece of clothing with sleeves that is worn over other clothes, usually for warmth

②the hair, wool, or fur covering an animal
exampleEn: Do your coat up, Joe, or you'll freeze.
exampleCn: 扣好外套，乔，不然你会冻坏的。

en: one of the two organs in your face that are used for seeing
exampleEn: He has no sight in his left eye.
exampleCn: 他左眼失明。

en: to complete something or come to the end of an activity
exampleEn: I'll call you when I've finished my homework.
exampleCn: 我做完作业后会给你打电话的。

cn:
①美丽的，漂亮的

②美好的；极好的
en:
①very attractive

②very pleasant
exampleEn: She was wearing a beautiful dress.
exampleCn: 她穿着一身漂亮的连衣裙。

en: a piece of equipment that shows you what time it is, usually in a house or on a building and not worn by a person
exampleEn: I think the kitchen clock is fast.
exampleCn: 我觉得厨房的钟表快了。

en: a flat object that is used to close the entrance of something such as a room or building, or the entrance itself
exampleEn: We could hear someone knocking at the door.
exampleCn: 我们能听到有人在敲门。

en: a place where you can buy goods or services
exampleEn: a book shop

en: to make musical sounds with the voice, usually a tune with words
exampleEn: She usually sings in the shower.
exampleCn: 她常常边冲澡边唱歌。

en: to go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them
exampleEn: Will you visit me when I'm in hospital?
exampleCn: 我住院你会来看我吗？

en: a female parent
exampleEn: I wonder when mother will ring?
exampleCn: 我不知道母亲什么时候会打电话来？

en: to move through water by moving the body or parts of the body
exampleEn: I swam two miles this morning.
exampleCn: 我今天早上游了两英里。

cn:
①愉快的；美好的；满意的

②好心的；友善的；有礼貌的
en:
①pleasant, enjoyable, or satisfactory

②kind, friendly, or polite
exampleEn: This milk doesn't smell very nice.
exampleCn: 这种牛奶闻起来味道不太好。

en: a male child or, more generally, a male of any age
exampleEn: You've been a very naughty boy!
exampleCn: 你真是个调皮的男孩！

en: (an amount of) liquid that is taken into the body through the mouth
exampleEn: They'd had no food or drink for two days.
exampleCn: 他们已经两天没吃没喝了。

en: a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with light brown, red, or pink skin, or the plant on which these grow
exampleEn: mashed potatoes

en: (on) the day after today
exampleEn: She's leaving tomorrow.
exampleCn: 她明天就走了。

en: one of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing
exampleEn: I had to have a tooth out.
exampleCn: 我不得不拔了颗牙。

en: the period that starts at about twelve o'clock or after the meal in the middle of the day and ends at about six o'clock or when the sun goes down
exampleEn: It was a sunny afternoon.
exampleCn: 那是一个阳光明媚的下午。

en: a seat for one person, that has a back, usually four legs, and sometimes two arms
exampleEn: She was rooted to her chair.
exampleCn: 她坐在椅子上一动不动。

en: a room in a school or college where groups of students are taught
exampleEn: They are cleaning the classroom.
exampleCn: 他们正在打扫教室呢。

en: having a lot of flesh on the body
exampleEn: Like most women, she thinks she's fat.
exampleCn: 与大多数女性一样，她觉得自己很胖。

en: feeling, showing, or causing pleasure or satisfaction
exampleEn: a happy childhood

en: a plant, root, seed, or pod that is used as food, especially in dishes that are not sweet
exampleEn: A turnip is another root vegetable.
exampleCn: 萝卜是另一种根茎类蔬菜。

en: on the day before today
exampleEn: He called yesterday while you were out.
exampleCn: 昨天你外出时他打电话来了。

en: either of the two long parts of the upper body that are attached to the shoulders and have the hands at the end
exampleEn: My arms ache from carrying this bag.
exampleCn: 提这个包累得我胳膊疼。

en: a message or document sent using this system
exampleEn: I got an email from Danielle last week.
exampleCn: 我上周收到丹妮尔的一封电子邮件。

en: a female child or young woman, especially one still at school
exampleEn: Two girls showed us round the classrooms.
exampleCn: 两个女孩领着我们参观了教室。

en: the flesh of an animal when it is used for food
exampleEn: The meat will rot if it isn't kept cool.
exampleCn: 肉如果不冷藏就会腐败。

en: a device that uses either a system of wires along which electrical signals are sent or a system of radio signals to make it possible for you to speak to someone in another place who has a similar device
exampleEn: Just then, his phone rang.
exampleCn: 就在那时，他的电话响了。

en: a photograph
exampleEn: She took lots of photos of the kids.
exampleCn: 她给孩子们照了很多像片。

en: not in danger or likely to be harmed
exampleEn: The children are quite safe here.
exampleCn: 孩子们在这里十分安全。

en: your male child
exampleEn: We have two sons and three daughters.
exampleCn: 我们有两个儿子和三个女儿。

en: a building or set of buildings where large amounts of goods are made using machines
exampleEn: a car factory

en: Saturday and Sunday, or Friday evening until Sunday night; the part of the week in which many people living in the West do not go to work
exampleEn: I have a lot of homework to do over the weekend.
exampleCn: 我周末有很多作业要做。

en: the number of the house, name of the road, and name of the town where a person lives or works, and where letters can be sent
exampleEn: her business address

en: the white liquid produced by cows, goats, and sheep and used by humans as a drink or for making butter, cheese, etc.
exampleEn: a glass of milk

en: a place where meals are prepared and served to customers
exampleEn: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street.
exampleCn: 他们在福斯大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

en: a farm animal with thick wool that eats grass and is kept for its wool, skin, and meat
exampleEn: The farmer has several large flocks of long-haired sheep.
exampleCn: 这位农夫养着几大群长毛绵羊。

en: a large vehicle in which people are driven from one place to another
exampleEn: He was knocked down by a bus.
exampleCn: 他被公共汽车撞倒了。

en: a building where you pay to have a room to sleep in, and where you can sometimes eat meals
exampleEn: We stayed at a hotel on the beach.
exampleCn: 我们住在一家滨海酒店。

en: used to introduce a piece of information that the speaker thinks is strange or interesting:
exampleEn: Interestingly, Dubai lacks street addresses!
exampleCn: 有意思的是迪拜没有街道地址。

en: the opening in the face of a person or animal, consisting of the lips and the space between them, or the space behind containing the teeth and the tongue
exampleEn: Her mouth is her best feature.
exampleCn: 她的嘴是她容貌上最好看的部分。

cn: 体育运动；体育比赛；体育竞技项目
en: a game, competition, or activity needing physical effort and skill that is played or done according to rules, for enjoyment and/or as a job
exampleEn: Football, basketball, and hockey are all team sports.
exampleCn: 足球、棒球和曲棍球都是团队运动。

en: a sweet substance especially from the plants sugar cane and sugar beet, used to make food and drinks sweet
exampleEn: I don't take sugar in my coffee, thanks.
exampleCn: 我的咖啡不加糖，谢谢。

en: a small vehicle for travelling on water
exampleEn: We took turns to row the boat up the river.
exampleCn: 我们轮流划船逆流而上。

cn:
①忙碌的；忙于…的；专注的

②（地方）热闹的，熙熙攘攘的
en:
①If you are busy, you are working hard, or giving your attention to a particular thing.

②A busy place is full of activity or people.
exampleEn: The kids are busy with their homework.
exampleCn: 孩子们在忙着做家庭作业。

en: the main meal of the day, usually the meal you eat in the evening but sometimes, in Britain, the meal eaten in the middle of the day
exampleEn: We were just having dinner.
exampleCn: 我们正在吃晚餐。

en: a male parent
exampleEn: My father took me to watch the football every Saturday.
exampleCn: 我父亲每周六带我去看足球赛。

en: pleasure, enjoyment, or entertainment
exampleEn: She's great fun to be with.
exampleCn: 跟她在一起很有意思。

en: humorous; causing laughter
exampleEn: It's a really funny film.
exampleCn: 这真是场滑稽的电影。

en: a small piece of paper or card given to someone, usually to show that they have paid for an event, journey, or activity
exampleEn: The ticket will guarantee you free entry.
exampleCn: 这张票可保证你免费入场。

cn:
①穿（衣服）；戴（首饰等）

②磨损；耗损；用旧
en:
①to have clothing, jewellery, etc. on your body

②to become weaker, damaged, or thinner because of continuous use
exampleEn: Tracey is wearing a simple black dress.
exampleCn: 特蕾西身着一袭素净的黑色长裙。

en: the quality or state of being hard
exampleEn: The old snow has compacted into the hardness of ice.
exampleCn: 雪堆积久了变得像冰那样坚实。

en: the small seeds of a particular type of grass, cooked, and eaten as food
exampleEn: boiled rice

en: best liked or most enjoyed
exampleEn: My favorite animal is rabbit.
exampleCn: 我最喜欢的动物是兔子。

en: the large system of connected computers around the world that allows people to share information and communicate with each other
exampleEn: I found out about the bombings from the internet.
exampleCn: 我从互联网上了解到有关爆炸的消息。

en: a meal that is eaten in the middle of the day
exampleEn: We must do lunch sometime.
exampleCn: 哪天我们一定得一起吃个午饭

en: a usually hot, liquid food made from vegetables, meat, or fish
exampleEn: Would you like a bowl of soup?
exampleCn: 你要来碗汤吗？

en: a set of pages of information on the internet about a particular subject, published by a single person or organization
exampleEn: This website is currently under construction.
exampleCn: 网站正在建设中。

en: any object in the shape of a sphere, especially one used as a toy by children or in various sports such as tennis and football
exampleEn: The kitten curled itself into a ball.
exampleCn: 小猫蜷缩成一团。

en: a place where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are sold and drunk, or the area in such a place where the person serving the drinks stands
exampleEn: They noticed him going into the hotel bar.
exampleCn: 他们看见他进了宾馆酒吧间。

en: a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked
exampleEn: Do you bake your own bread?
exampleCn: 你自己烤面包吗？

en: the standard unit of money used in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and other countries
exampleEn: You can pay in euros or in US dollars.
exampleCn: 你可以用欧元或美元支付。

en: an occasion when food is eaten, or the food that is eaten on such an occasion
exampleEn: This is the best meal I had ever eaten.
exampleCn: 这是我所吃过的最好的一餐。

cn: 噪声；杂音；嘈杂声；喧闹声
en: a sound or sounds, especially when it is unwanted, unpleasant, or loud
exampleEn: I heard a loud noise and ran to the window.
exampleCn: 我听见一声巨响，于是向窗户跑去。

en: a meal eaten in the morning as the first meal of the day
exampleEn: What do you want for breakfast?
exampleCn: 你早餐想吃什么?

en: a man or boy with the same parents as another person
exampleEn: Do you have any brothers and sisters?
exampleCn: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？

en: your female child
exampleEn: Liz and Phil have a daughter and three sons.
exampleCn: 利兹和菲尔有一个女儿和三个儿子。

en:
①a person with a medical degree whose job is to treat people who are ill or hurt

②a person who has the highest degree from a college or university
exampleEn: The doctor prescribed some medication.
exampleCn: 医生开了一些药。

cn: （人的）头发；（人或动物的）汗毛，毛发
en: the mass of thin thread-like structures on the head of a person, or any of these structures that grow out of the skin of a person or animal
exampleEn: He's got short, dark hair.
exampleCn: 他的头发短而黑。

en: A milky liquid contains milk or is made with a lot of milk
exampleEn: a cup of milky coffee

en: a round, red fruit with a lot of seeds, eaten cooked or uncooked as a vegetable, for example in salads or sauces
exampleEn: tomato salad

en: a covering for the head that is not part of a piece of clothing
exampleEn: Mary was wearing her inevitable large hat.
exampleCn: 玛丽戴着她总是戴的那顶大帽子。

en: a room where food is kept, prepared, and cooked and where the dishes are washed
exampleEn: We usually eat breakfast in the kitchen.
exampleCn: 我们通常在厨房吃早饭。

en:
①a period of time in which a person is taught about a subject or how to do something

②an experience that teaches you how to behave better in a similar situation in the future
exampleEn: She has never taken any acting lessons.
exampleCn: 她从未上过表演课。

en: a long, thin object, usually made of wood, for writing or drawing, with a sharp black or coloured point at one end
exampleEn: a box of coloured pencils

en: a girl or woman who has the same parents as another person
exampleEn: Sophie and Emily are sisters.
exampleCn: 索菲和埃米莉是姐妹。

en: a round fruit with firm, white flesh and a green, red, or yellow skin
exampleEn: apple pie

en: a seed, or the pod containing seeds, of various climbing plants, eaten as a vegetable
exampleEn: green beans

en: not interesting or exciting
exampleEn: She found her job very boring.
exampleCn: 她觉得自己的工作很无聊。

en: to ask or request someone to go to an event
exampleEn: We're invited to Lola's party.
exampleCn: 我们受邀参加洛拉的晚会。

cn:
①社交聚会
②党，政党，党派
en:
①a social event at which a group of people meet to talk, eat, drink, dance, etc., often in order to celebrate a special occasion

②an organization of people with particular political beliefs that competes in elections to try to win positions in local or national government
exampleEn: a birthday party

cn: 测试员；试验员；测试器；测试仪
en: a person or thing that tests sth
exampleEn: Maybe you can be a computer game tester.
exampleCn: 或许你可以当程序测试员。

en: a man whose job is to bring the food to customers at their tables in a restaurant
exampleEn: A waiter offered him the menu.
exampleCn: 一个侍者给他送上了菜单。

en: to clean something using water
exampleEn: These sheets need washing.
exampleCn: 这些床单需要洗洗。

en: the woman that you are married to
exampleEn: I met Greg's wife for the first time.
exampleCn: 我是第一次见到格雷格的妻子。

en: an alcoholic drink that is usually made from grapes, but can also be made from other fruits or flowers. It is made by fermenting the fruit with water and sugar
exampleEn: Let's have a bottle of wine with dinner.
exampleCn: 我们晚餐喝一瓶葡萄酒好吗？

en: a room with a bath and/or shower and often a toilet
exampleEn: The house has four bedrooms and two bathrooms.
exampleCn: 这座房子有四间卧室和两个洗澡间。

en: a pale yellow solid food containing a lot of fat that is made from cream and is spread on bread or used in cooking
exampleEn: Have some bread and butter.
exampleCn: 吃些黄油面包片吧。

en: having or showing the ability to learn and understand things quickly and easily
exampleEn: He's a very clever man.
exampleCn: 他是个很聪明的人。

en: a large female farm animal kept to produce meat and milk
exampleEn: It is milked form a cow at night.
exampleCn: 这些奶是晚上从奶牛身上挤的。

en: to become dark
exampleEn: The sky began to darken as the storm approached.
exampleCn: 暴风雨来临时天空变得黑沉沉的。

en: a type of table that you can work at, often one with drawers
exampleEn: She sat at her desk writing letters.
exampleCn: 她坐在书桌前写信。

en: the part of the day between the end of the afternoon and night
exampleEn: The party is on Friday evening.
exampleCn: 聚会定于周五晚上举行。

en: work that teachers give their students to do at home
exampleEn: I'll do my homework after supper.
exampleCn: 晚饭后我要做家庭作业。

en: relating to parents or to being a parent
exampleEn: Parental anxieties reflect their circumstances.
exampleCn: 父母的焦虑反映了他们的处境。

cn: 骑（自行车、摩托车或马等）
en: to sit on something such as a bicycle, motorbike, or horse and travel along on it controlling its movements
exampleEn: I learned to ride a bike when I was six.
exampleCn: 我六岁学会了骑自行车。

cn:
①句，句子

②判决；宣判；判刑
en:
①a group of words, usually containing a verb, that expresses a thought in the form of a statement, question, instruction, or exclamation and starts with a capital letter when written

②a punishment given by a judge in court to a person or organization after they have been found guilty of doing something wrong
exampleEn: Your conclusion is good, but the final sentence is too long and complicated.
exampleCn: 你的结论没错，但最后一句话太长太复杂。

en: one of a pair of coverings for your feet, usually made of a strong material such as leather, with a thick leather or plastic sole and usually a heel
exampleEn: high-heeled shoes

en: not moving, or not changing
exampleEn: The traffic got slower and slower until it was stationary.
exampleCn: 车流移动得越来越慢，最后完全不动了。

en: having a taste similar to that of sugar; not bitter or salty
exampleEn: The pineapple was sweet and juicy.
exampleCn: 这个菠萝甜而多汁。

en: without trees
exampleEn: We traveled through treeless wastes.
exampleCn: 我们穿过了没有树木的荒地。

en: a time when someone does not go to work or school but is free to do what they want, such as travel or relax
exampleEn: We're taking a vacation in June.
exampleCn: 我们六月份要去度假。

cn: 不能入睡的；（一段时间内）难以入睡的
en: not able to sleep, or used to describe a period of time when you are not able to sleep
exampleEn: He was wakeful yesterday.
exampleCn: 他昨天没有睡着。

en: glassy surface is smooth and shiny, like glass.
exampleEn: a glassy sea

en: a large pink, brown, or black farm animal with short legs and a curved tail, kept for its meat
exampleEn: The meat produced from a pig is called pork, bacon, or ham.
exampleCn: 猪提供的肉类食品包括鲜猪肉、熏咸肉或火腿。

en: a vehicle designed for air travel, with wings and one or more engines
exampleEn: We'll be boarding the plane in about 20 minutes.
exampleCn: 大约二十分钟后我们将登机。

en: to talk or act in a way that makes someone lose interest
exampleEn: "Am I boring you?" she asked anxiously.
exampleCn: “我让你厌烦了吗?”她焦急地问道。

en: Someone or something that is interesting keeps your attention because he, she, or it is unusual, exciting, or has a lot of ideas.
exampleEn: She's quite an interesting woman.
exampleCn: 她是一个很有趣的女人。

en: quality of coming late or later in time
exampleEn: He apologized for his lateness.
exampleCn: 他为自己的迟到道歉。

en: funny and not serious
exampleEn: He was in a playful mood.
exampleCn: 他很想逗趣一下。

en: to do or play something regularly or repeatedly in order to become skilled at it
exampleEn: She practises the violin every day.
exampleCn: 她每天都练习拉小提琴。

en: in need of rest or sleep
exampleEn: I was so tired when I got home from work last night that I had a quick nap.
exampleCn: 我昨晚下班回家后很累，就小睡了一会儿。

en: to (cause someone to) become awake and conscious after sleeping
exampleEn: Please wake me early tomorrow.
exampleCn: 明天请早点叫醒我。

en: very, extremely, or to such a degree
exampleEn: The house is so beautiful.
exampleCn: 这房子太漂亮了！

en: used to say that a particular thing can or will happen only after something else happens or becomes true
exampleEn: I'll pay you double if you get the work finished by Friday.
exampleCn: 如果你周五前完工，我付你双倍的报酬。

en: now, very soon, or very recently
exampleEn: I'll just finish this, then we can go.
exampleCn: 我马上干完了，然后我们就能走了。

en: used to show that something is surprising, unusual, unexpected, or extreme
exampleEn: I don't even know where it is.
exampleCn: 我甚至连它在哪里都不知道。

cn:
①路，道路；路线

②措施，方法
en:
①a route, direction, or path

②an action that can produce the result you want; a method
exampleEn: Do you know the way to the restaurant?
exampleCn: 你知道去餐馆怎么走吗？

cn:
①打电话

②叫，呼喊；呼叫；（动物）鸣叫
en:
①to use a phone to talk to someone

②to say something in a loud voice, especially in order to attract someone's attention, or (of animals) to make a loud, high sound, especially to another animal
exampleEn: He called you last night when you were out.
exampleCn: 昨晚你不在时，他给你打过电话。

en: to begin to exist or to make something begin to exist
exampleEn: A solution began to form in her mind.
exampleCn: 她想到了一个解决办法

en: big in size or amount
exampleEn: A large stone landed right beside him.
exampleCn: 一大块石头正好落在他身旁。

en: used before a noun or noun phrase to add emphasis
exampleEn: That's such a good film.
exampleCn: 那部电影真不错。

en: to express or represent something such as an idea, thought, or fact
exampleEn: What does this word mean?
exampleCn: 这个单词是什么意思？

en: to start to be
exampleEn: It was becoming cold.
exampleCn: 天气越来越冷了。

en: in fact or really
exampleEn: It's not actually raining now.
exampleCn: 其实现在并没有下雨。

cn:
①又一的，再一个的

②不同的（人或事物）；别的；另一
en:
①one more person or thing or an extra amount

②a different person or thing
exampleEn: I'm going to have another piece of cake.
exampleCn: 我要再吃块蛋糕。

en: a period of 100 years
exampleEn: The city centre has scarcely changed in over a century.
exampleCn: 一百多年来市中心几乎没有变化。

cn: （包括雕塑、绘画、音乐等的） 艺术
en: the making of objects, images, music, etc. that are beautiful or that express feelings
exampleEn: I don't really go for modern art.
exampleCn: 我并不是很喜欢现代艺术。

cn: 在原处；回到原处；恢复原状；返回；回到以前
en: in, into, or towards a previous place or condition, or an earlier time
exampleEn: She went to Brazil for two years, but now she's back.
exampleCn: 她去巴西呆了两年，现在回来了。

cn:
①最多（的）；最大（的）；最

②大多数（的），大部分（的）；几乎全部（的）
en:
①the biggest number or amount of; more than anything or anyone else

②almost all
exampleEn: Which of you earns the most money?
exampleCn: 你们中谁赚钱最多？

en: to (cause to) change position
exampleEn: That desk is fixed, don't try to move it.
exampleCn: 那张桌子是固定的，别去移动它。

en: some, or a small number of something
exampleEn: I need to get a few things in town.
exampleCn: 我需要到城里买几样东西。

en: approximately
exampleEn: around six feet tall

cn: 增多；增大；增强；增长；成长；长大
en: to increase in size or amount, or to become more advanced or developed
exampleEn: Children grow so quickly.
exampleCn: 孩子们长得很快。

en: a suggestion or plan for doing something
exampleEn: She's full of good ideas.
exampleCn: 她满脑子好点子。

en: (especially of things that are not living) being a large distance from top to bottom or a long way above the ground, or having the stated distance from top to bottom
exampleEn: It's two and a half metres high and one metre wide.
exampleCn: 它有两米半高，一米宽。

en: the measured amount of heat in a place or in the body
exampleEn: The temperature has dropped considerably.
exampleCn: 温度已大大降低。

en: used to mean that something is very likely
exampleEn: I can probably make the time to see them.
exampleCn: 我大概能腾出时间去看望他们。

en: something that you can hear or that can be heard
exampleEn: Sound travels more slowly than light.
exampleCn: 声比光传播得慢。

en: at, to, or from a great distance in space or time
exampleEn: Is the station far away?
exampleCn: 火车站远吗？

en: an idea, opinion, or piece of information that is said or written
exampleEn: This leads naturally to my next point.
exampleCn: 这必然引出我的下一个论点。

en: continuing to happen or continuing to be done
exampleEn: I still haven't finished writing my essay.
exampleCn: 我还是没有完成我的论文。

en: the brightness that comes from the sun, fire, etc. and from electrical devices, and that allows things to be seen
exampleEn: Light was streaming in through the open door.
exampleCn: 光线从敞开的门口倾泻进来。

cn: 现实，实际情况；事实，真相
en: something that is known to have happened or to exist, especially something for which proof exists, or about which there is information
exampleEn: No decision will be made until we know all the facts.
exampleCn: 了解全部事实前我们不会作任何决定。

en: to make something by putting bricks or other materials together
exampleEn: They're building new houses by the river.
exampleCn: 他们正在河边建新房子。

en: back in time from the present
exampleEn: He left the house over an hour ago.
exampleCn: 他一个多小时前离开了这所房子。

en: despite this
exampleEn: There may, however, be other reasons that we don't know about.
exampleCn: 然而，可能还有其他我们不知道的原因。

cn: 确定的，肯定的，毫无疑问的
en: certain; without any doubt
exampleEn: I'm sure that I left my keys on the table.
exampleCn: 我肯定我把钥匙放在桌上了。

en: (of a situation or an event) to have existence or come into existence
exampleEn: An accident can happen anywhere.
exampleCn: 任何地方都可能发生事故。

en: water that has frozen and become solid
exampleEn: The pond was covered in ice all winter.
exampleCn: 这个池塘整个冬天都结着冰

en: (the study of or a record of) past events considered together, especially events of a particular period, country, or subject
exampleEn: I studied modern European history at college.
exampleCn: 我在大学里学的是欧洲现代史。

en: a very large area of sea
exampleEn: These mysterious creatures live at the bottom of the ocean.
exampleCn: 这些神秘的生物居住在海底。

en: during the time that, or at the same time as
exampleEn: I read it while you were drying your hair.
exampleCn: 在你吹干头发的时候我读了它。

en: a particular group of people or things that share similar characteristics and form a smaller division of a larger set
exampleEn: What type of clothes does she wear?
exampleCn: 她穿什么类型的衣服？

en: below the usual level
exampleEn: a low-fat diet

en: quite, but not extremely
exampleEn: The house has four bedrooms, so it's pretty big.
exampleCn: 这座房子有四个卧室，因此非常大。

cn: 艺术家；美术家；画家；雕塑家
en: someone who paints, draws, or makes sculptures
exampleEn: Monet is one of my favourite artists.
exampleCn: 莫奈是我最喜欢的画家之一。

en: to have or continue to have in your possession
exampleEn: We keep a tape of incoming calls.
exampleCn: 我们保留打进电话的录音磁带。

en: to attempt to do something
exampleEn: I'm trying my best, but I just can't do it.
exampleCn: 我在尽最大努力，可就是做不来。

en: a piece of land completely surrounded by water
exampleEn: The island is thinly populated.
exampleCn: 这个岛人口稀少。

en: belonging to or done by a particular person or thing
exampleEn: I'd like to have my own apartment.
exampleCn: 我想有自己的公寓。

en: a large area of land covered with trees and plants, usually larger than a wood, or the trees and plants themselves
exampleEn: The children got lost in the forest.
exampleCn: 孩子们在森林里迷了路。

en: to (cause to) change the direction in which you are facing or moving
exampleEn: Turn right at the traffic lights.
exampleCn: 在红绿灯处向右拐。

en: to contain something as a part of something else, or to make something part of something else
exampleEn: The bill includes tax and service.
exampleCn: 账单包括税款和服务费。

en: to have the necessary physical strength, mental power, skill, time, money, or opportunity to do something
exampleEn: It's so wonderful being able to see the sea from my window.
exampleCn: 从我的窗口就能看到大海，真是太棒了。

cn: （真实或虚构的）故事；叙述，描述；小说
en: a description, either true or imagined, of a connected series of events
exampleEn: He writes children's stories.
exampleCn: 他写童话故事。

en: the number 1,000,000
exampleEn: Over 16 million men had died in combat.
exampleCn: 一千六百多万人在战斗中阵亡。

en: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe
exampleEn: I went outside to get some fresh air.
exampleCn: 我到室外呼吸一下新鲜空气。

en: as much as is necessary; in the amount or to the degree needed
exampleEn: There was food enough for all.
exampleCn: 所有人都有足够的食物。

en: some；an amount that is not exact but is fewer than many
exampleEn: She wrote him several poems.
exampleCn: 她为他写了几首诗。

en: not having or doing something, or lacking something
exampleEn: I left without my umbrella.
exampleCn: 我没有带伞就出来了。

cn: 去（或在）别处；向另一方向；向一边
en: somewhere else, or to or in a different place, position, or situation
exampleEn: Keep away from him.
exampleCn: 离他远点。

en: a group of things that are of the same type or that share similar qualities
exampleEn: We both like the same sort of music.
exampleCn: 我们俩喜欢同一类音乐。

en: an empty area that is available to be used
exampleEn: The car has a generous amount of space.
exampleCn: 这辆汽车的空间很大。

en: a large area of water surrounded by land and not connected to the sea except by rivers or streams
exampleEn: We used to go boating on that lake.
exampleCn: 我们过去常去那个湖里划船。

cn: （与他人相比的）能力，水平，级别
en: someone's ability compared to other people
exampleEn: The exam can be taken at three levels.
exampleCn: 这种考试分为三个级别。

cn:
①一次，一回

②从前，以前；曾经，一度
en:
①one single time

②in the past, but not now
exampleEn: I went sailing once, but I didn't like it.
exampleCn: 我玩过一次帆船，不过我不喜欢。

en: to take or carry someone or something to a place or a person, or in the direction of the person speaking
exampleEn: Bring that knife to me.
exampleCn: 把那把刀递给我。

en: the direction that goes towards the part of the earth above the equator, opposite to the south, or the part of an area or country that is in this direction
exampleEn: Most of the country's population is concentrated in the north.
exampleCn: 这个国家的大部分人口集中在北方。

en: to think that something is true, correct, or real
exampleEn: The police didn't believe her story.
exampleCn: 警方不相信她对事情的描述。

en: in the way that most often happens
exampleEn: He usually gets home about six o'clock.
exampleCn: 他通常在六点左右到家。

en: to give an answer to a particular question when you do not have all the facts and so cannot be certain if you are correct
exampleEn: I didn't know the answer, so I had to guess.
exampleCn: 我不知道答案，所以只好猜了。

en: to store sounds or moving pictures using electronic equipment so that they can be heard or seen later
exampleEn: We recorded their wedding on video.
exampleCn: 我们给他们的婚礼录了像。

en: a little or a lot but not completely
exampleEn: It was quite a difficult job.
exampleCn: 那工作着实难做。

en: to get something ready so that it comes into operation or can be used
exampleEn: He set the alarm for 7 a.m.
exampleCn: 他把闹钟设在早上七点钟。

cn: 精确地；确切地；完全准确地
en: used when you are giving or asking for information that is completely correct
exampleEn: The journey took exactly three hours.
exampleCn: 正好是三个小时的路程。

en: the cause of an event or situation or something that provides an excuse or explanation
exampleEn: He had every reason to be angry.
exampleCn: 他完全有理由感到愤怒。

en: very much; more than usual or more than other people or things
exampleEn: She's not especially interested in sport.
exampleCn: 她对体育运动不是特别感兴趣。

cn: 破碎，破裂；打破；打断；损坏，弄坏
en: to or cause something to separate suddenly or violently into two or more pieces, or to or cause something to stop working by being damaged
exampleEn: I dropped the vase and it broke into pieces.
exampleCn: 我把花瓶掉在地上摔碎了。

en: the middle point or part
exampleEn: There was a large table in the centre of the room.
exampleCn: 屋子中央有张大桌子。

en: a very large ball of burning gas in space that is usually seen from the earth as a point of light in the sky at night
exampleEn: Stars twinkled above them as they lay on the hill.
exampleCn: 他们躺在小山上，头顶繁星闪烁。

en: how large or small something or someone is
exampleEn: Some kinds of trees grow to a huge size.
exampleCn: 有些树长得很高大。

en: designed and made using the most recent ideas and methods
exampleEn: modern medicine

en: the direction from which the sun rises in the morning, opposite to the west, or the part of an area or country that is in this direction
exampleEn: The points of the compass are north, south, east, and west.
exampleCn: 罗盘上的四个方位点是北、南、东和西。

en: the direction that goes towards the part of the earth below the equator, opposite to the north, or the part of an area or country that is in this direction
exampleEn: We spent our holiday in the south of France.
exampleCn: 我们去法国南部度假了。

en: to put or spread something over something, or to lie on the surface of something
exampleEn: The light was so bright that I had to cover my eyes.
exampleCn: 灯光太亮，我只好遮住眼睛。

en: an area of land, used for growing crops or keeping animals, usually surrounded by a fence
exampleEn: We drove past fields of ripening wheat.
exampleCn: 我们驱车经过快要成熟的麦田。

en: complete or not divided
exampleEn: I spent the whole day cleaning.
exampleCn: 我花了一整天打扫卫生。

cn: 几乎，差不多，差一点，将近
en: nearly
exampleEn: It was almost six o'clock when he left.
exampleCn: 他离开时将近六点了。

en: facts about a situation, person, event, etc.
exampleEn: Do you have any information about train times?
exampleCn: 你知道有关火车时刻的信息吗？

en: used to describe something that has no water or other liquid in, on, or around it
exampleEn: These plants grow well in dry soi.
exampleCn: 这些植物适宜在干旱的土壤里生长。

cn:
①块；片；段；碎片；碎块

②（某类事物中的）一件，一个，一条
en:
①a part of something

②a single object of a particular type
exampleEn: He cut the cake into six pieces.
exampleCn: 他把蛋糕切成了六块。

cn: 深的，向下延伸的；有…深的
en: going or being a long way down from the top or surface, or being of a particular distance from the top to the bottom
exampleEn: The hole is so deep you can't see the bottom.
exampleCn: 洞太深了你无法看到底部。

en: to make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it
exampleEn: Our guide explained where the cathedral was.
exampleCn: 导游给我们讲解了大教堂的位置。

en: before the present time
exampleEn: The car was already on the move.
exampleCn: 汽车已经开动了。

cn:
①点菜；订制；订货

②顺序，次序

③指示；指令；命令
en:
①a request to make, supply, or deliver food or goods

②the way in which people or things are arranged, either in relation to one another or according to a particular characteristic

③something that someone tells you you must do
exampleEn: "Can I take your order now?" said the waiter.
exampleCn: 侍者问：“现在可以点菜了吗？”

en: the number 1,000
exampleEn: The population of the village is about three thousand.
exampleCn: 这个村庄的人口约为三千人。

en: to move behind someone or something and go where he, she, or it goes
exampleEn: A dog followed us home.
exampleCn: 一条狗跟着我们回了家。

cn:
①观点；见解；看法

②景象；视野；视域
en:
①an opinion, belief, or idea, or a way of thinking about something

②what you can see from a particular place, or the ability to see from a particular place
exampleEn: Do you have any views about what we should do now?
exampleCn: 对于我们现在该做什么你有什么看法？

en: to suddenly go down onto the ground or towards the ground without intending to or by accident
exampleEn: He fell badly and broke his leg.
exampleCn: 他重重跌倒，摔断了腿。

en: the number 100
exampleEn: This vase is worth several hundred dollars.
exampleCn: 这只花瓶值几百元。

en: a building, room, or outside structure with rows of seats, each row usually higher than the one in front, from which people can watch a performance or other activity
exampleEn: We had seats in the front row of the theatre.
exampleCn: 我们坐在戏院前排。

cn:
①还，尚；迄今

②然而，尽管
en:
①still; until the present time

②(and) despite that; used to add something that seems surprising because of what you have just said
exampleEn: I haven't spoken to her yet.
exampleCn: 我还没和她谈过。

en: something that you are given, without asking for it, on a special occasion, especially to show friendship, or to say thank you
exampleEn: She gave us a picture as a wedding present.
exampleCn: 她赠给我们一幅画作结婚礼物。

en: a smooth thick liquid produced from plants or animals that is used in cooking
exampleEn: olive oil

cn:
①通过（考试、课程等）

②传递，传送
en:
①to be successful in an exam, course, etc.

②to give something to someone
exampleEn: Guess what? I've passed my driving test!
exampleCn: 你猜怎么着？我通过驾驶考试了！

en: to talk about a subject with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions
exampleEn: They had important matters to discuss.
exampleCn: 他们有些重要的问题要讨论。

cn: 明白的；清楚的；易懂的；清晰的
en: easy to understand, hear, read or see transparent
exampleEn: Can we make the sound any clearer?
exampleCn: 我们能把声音再调清晰一点吗？

cn: 不管怎样；无论如何；仍然
en: whatever else is happening, without considering other things
exampleEn: To be perfectly honest , I didn't want to go anyway.
exampleCn: 说真心话，无论如何我是真的不想去。

en: an area, often covered with sand or rocks, where there is very little rain and not many plants
exampleEn: They were lost in the desert for nine days.
exampleCn: 他们再沙漠中迷失了九天。

en:
①a flat outer surface of an object, especially one that is not the top, the bottom, the front, or the back

②an edge or border of something
exampleEn: The names of ships are usually painted on their sides.
exampleCn: 船的名字通常漆在船的侧面。

en: the way in which two or more things which you are comparing are not the same
exampleEn: What's the difference between an ape and a monkey?
exampleCn: 猿和猴有什么区别？

en: a place or event at which people meet in order to buy and sell things
exampleEn: The flower market is a big tourist attraction.
exampleCn: 花市对旅游者有很大的吸引力。

en: used after words beginning with any-, every-, no-, and some-, or after how, what, where, who, why, but not which, to mean 'other', 'another', 'different', 'extra':
exampleEn: I'm taking a few clothes and some books, not much else.
exampleCn: 我带了几件衣服和一些书，别的就不多了。

en: a small piece or amount of something
exampleEn: There were bits of paper all over the floor.
exampleCn: 地板上到处都是碎纸片。

en: every person
exampleEn: The news astonished everyone.
exampleCn: 这消息使大家十分惊讶。

en: used to show that something is possible or that you are not certain about something
exampleEn: I think perhaps we should go indoors.
exampleCn: 我想也许我们该进屋了。

cn: 科学；自然科学；科学知识
en: (knowledge from) the careful study of the structure and behaviour of the physical world, especially by watching, measuring, and doing experiments, and the development of theories to describe the results of these activities
exampleEn: Space travel is one of the wonders of modern science.
exampleCn: 太空遨游是现代科学的一大奇迹。

cn: 实际存在的，现实的；真实的
en: existing in fact and not imaginary
exampleEn: There is a very real threat that he will lose his job.
exampleCn: 他的确有失去工作的危险。

cn:
①阶段；发展时期

②舞台
en:
①a part of an activity or a period of development

②the area in a theatre that is often raised above ground level and on which actors or entertainers perform
exampleEn: The product is at the design stage.
exampleCn: 产品处于设计阶段。

en: to take and keep something in your hand or arms
exampleEn: He was holding a gun.
exampleCn: 他当时正拿着一把枪。

en: in place of someone or something else
exampleEn: There's no coffee - would you like a cup of tea instead?
exampleCn: 没有咖啡——来杯茶怎么样？

en: the central point, position, or part
exampleEn: He planted roses in the middle of the garden.
exampleCn: 他在花园中间种上玫瑰。

en: a study of a particular subject done over a period of time, especially by students
exampleEn: He's doing a class project on pollution.
exampleCn: 他正在做一个有关污染的学校课题。

en: a hard substance that forms the branches and trunks of trees and can be used as a building material, for making things, or as a fuel
exampleEn: He gathered some wood to build a fire.
exampleCn: 他捡了些木头生了一堆火。

cn: 从一边到另一边；穿过；横过
