en: from one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river
exampleEn: She walked across the road.
exampleCn: 她穿过马路。

cn:
①公司

②作伴；陪伴；同伴
en:
①an organization that sells goods or services in order to make money

②the fact of being with a person or people, or the person or people you are with
exampleEn: No smoking is company policy.
exampleCn: 禁止吸烟是公司的规定。

en: easy to understand or do; not difficult
exampleEn: It's simple to find our house.
exampleCn: 我们的房子很容易找到。

en: a white or gray mass in the sky, made of very small drops of water
exampleEn: Do you think those are rain clouds on the horizon?
exampleCn: 你看天边那些云是雨云吗？

en: a type of reptile that became extinct about 65,000,000 years ago. There were many different types of dinosaur, some of which were extremely large.
exampleEn: What's the connection between bird and dinosaur behavior?
exampleCn: 鸟类和恐龙的行为之间有什么联系呢？

en: the person who is responsible for managing an organization
exampleEn: I would like to speak to the manager.
exampleCn: 我想找经理谈谈。

cn: 强有力的，强劲的；强壮的；强烈的
en: powerful; having or using great force or control
exampleEn: She must be very strong to carry such a weight on her back.
exampleCn: 能把这么重的东西背在背上，她一定非常强健。

en: able to be bought or used
exampleEn: Is this dress available in a larger size?
exampleCn: 这件衣服有大一号的吗？

en: the scientific study of the natural processes of living things
exampleEn: marine biology

cn: 图书管理员，图书馆馆员
en: a person who works in a library
exampleEn: My dream is to be a librarian.
exampleCn: 我的梦想是成为一名图书管理员。

en: a long, thin mark on the surface of something
exampleEn: I drew a line across the page.
exampleCn: 我在这一页上画了一条横线。

cn: 各种不同的；各种各样的
en: many different
exampleEn: Schools use various methods of testing.
exampleCn: 学校采用各种各样的测试方法。

en: a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 metres
exampleEn: It's half a kilometer away from here.
exampleCn: 离这儿半公里远。

en: one of the periods into which a year is divided at a college or university, especially in the US and Australia
exampleEn: the first semester
exampleCn: 第一学期

en: used to refer to a single person when you do not know who they are or when it is not important who they are
exampleEn: Someone must have seen what happened.
exampleCn: 肯定有人看见了所发生的一切。

en: a building, room, or organization that has a collection, especially of books, for people to read or borrow, usually without payment
exampleEn: Jill spent the past few months doing research in the library.
exampleCn: 吉尔过去几个月一直在图书馆做研究。

en: a unit of measurement equal to 100 centimetres
exampleEn: The boy is one meter tall in his stocking feet.
exampleCn: 这个小男孩不穿鞋的身高是一米。

en: a set of decisions about how to do something in the future
exampleEn: a company's business plan

en: to no longer have something because you do not know where it is
exampleEn: He's always losing his car keys.
exampleCn: 他总是丢汽车钥匙。

cn: 容易地；轻易地；不费力地
en: with no difficulty or effort
exampleEn: The disease spreads easily.
exampleCn: 这种疾病容易传播。

en: all things
exampleEn: She's always late for everything.
exampleCn: 她总是每件事都迟到。

en: at any time
exampleEn: Nothing ever happens here in the evening.
exampleCn: 这儿晚上从来没发生过什么事儿。

en: someone who owns or takes care of a farm
exampleEn: He is a beef cattle farmer.
exampleCn: 他是一个肉牛养殖场主。

en: the round object that moves in the sky around the earth and can be seen at night
exampleEn: The moon goes round the earth.
exampleCn: 月亮绕着地球转。

cn: 受大众喜爱的，受欢迎的
en: liked, enjoyed, or supported by many people
exampleEn: She's the most popular teacher in school.
exampleCn: 她是学校里最受欢迎的老师。

en: the organ inside the head that controls thought, memory, feelings, and activity
exampleEn: His wife died from a brain tumour.
exampleCn: 他妻子死于脑瘤。

en: (material that is in) the state of burning that produces flames that send out heat and light, and might produce smoke
exampleEn: Animals are usually afraid of fire.
exampleCn: 动物通常都怕火。

en: a raised part of the earth's surface, much larger than a hill, the top of which might be covered in snow
exampleEn: The mountain is 3500 meters high.
exampleCn: 这座山有三千五百米高。

en: to write your name, usually on a written or printed document, to show that you agree with its contents or have written or created it yourself
exampleEn: He signed his name at the end of the letter.
exampleCn: 他在信的末尾签上了自己的名字。

cn: 特殊的，特别的；不寻常的
en: not ordinary or usual
exampleEn: We don't want any special treatment.
exampleCn: 我们不需要任何特殊待遇。

en: to put something with something else to increase the number or amount or to improve the whole
exampleEn: Add an egg yolk to make the mixture bind.
exampleCn: 加个蛋黄使混合料凝结在一起。

en: the part of a person that makes it possible for him or her to think, feel emotions, and understand things
exampleEn: Her death had an unbalancing effect on Joe's mind.
exampleCn: 她一死，乔在精神上打击很大。

en: to give something to someone else in return for money
exampleEn: The stall sells drinks and snacks.
exampleCn: 这个摊位卖饮料和小吃。

en: to make certain that something or someone is correct, safe, or suitable by examining it, him, or her quickly
exampleEn: Check your work before handing it in.
exampleCn: 交作业以前先检查一遍。

en: a series of instructions that can be put into a computer in order to make it perform an operation
exampleEn: She's written a program to find words that frequently occur together.
exampleCn: 她设计了一个程序以便找到经常一起出现的词语。

en: many different types of things or people
exampleEn: She does a variety of fitness activities.
exampleCn: 她参加各种各样的健身活动。

en: to produce something so that it is the same as an original piece of work
exampleEn: He was always copying from other students, but never got caught.
exampleCn: 他总是抄袭别的学生，可从未被抓到过。

en: a type of very small animal with six legs, a body divided into three parts and usually two pairs of wings, or, more generally, any similar very small animal
exampleEn: Ants, beetles, butterflies, and flies are all insects.
exampleCn: 蚂蚁、甲虫、蝴蝶和苍蝇都是昆虫。

en: to break the surface of something, or to divide or make something smaller, using a sharp tool, especially a knife
exampleEn: Cut the meat up into small pieces.
exampleCn: 把肉切成小片。

cn: （使）充满，（使）装满，（使）注满；占据；布满
en: to make or become full; to use empty space
exampleEn: I filled the bucket with water.
exampleCn: 我往桶里注满了水。

cn:
①回；返回

②放回；归还；带回
en:
①to come or go back to a previous place

②to send, take, give, put, etc. something back to where it came from
exampleEn: She left South Africa at the age of 15 and has never returned.
exampleCn: 她十五岁时离开了南非，再也没有回去过。

en: in or within a short time; before long; quickly
exampleEn: Your breakfast is coming soon.
exampleCn: 你的早餐很快就到。

en: to be in a vertical state or to put into a vertical state, especially (of a person or animal) by making the legs straight
exampleEn: Stand still and be quiet!
exampleCn: 站好了，不要出声！

en: to think that something is likely to be true
exampleEn: Dan didn't answer his phone, so I suppose that he's busy.
exampleCn: 丹没有接我的电话，所以我想他应该很忙。

en: at a fast speed
exampleEn: We'll have to walk quickly to get there on time.
exampleCn: 我们得快走才能准时赶到那儿。

en: used in questions and negatives to mean 'a person or people'
exampleEn: I haven't told anyone.
exampleCn: 我没有告诉任何人。

cn: 当然，毫无疑问，确实，肯定
en: used to reply completely or to emphasize something and show that there is no doubt about it
exampleEn: "Do you think more money should be given to education?" "Certainly!"
exampleCn: “你认为应当给教育拨更多经费吗?”“当然啦！”

en: a person, animal, or thing that is part of a group
exampleEn: a family member

en: (an) amount or level of something
exampleEn: This job demands a high degree of skill.
exampleCn: 这项工作需要高度的技巧。

en: not anything
exampleEn: There's nothing much to do in our town.
exampleCn: 在我们镇上没有太多事情可做。

cn:
①反对；与…相反

②紧贴着；紧靠着；倚在
en:
①disagreeing with a plan or activity

②next to and touching or being supported by (something)
exampleEn: 50 people voted against the new proposal.
exampleCn: 五十人投票反对这一新提案。

en: either of the two equal or nearly equal parts that together make up a whole
exampleEn: Cut the apple into halves.
exampleCn: 把这个苹果切成两半。

en: a physical object, usually smaller than the real object, that is used to represent something
exampleEn: a plastic model aircraft

en: the act of doing something regularly or repeatedly to improve your skill at doing it
exampleEn: I need to get some more practice before I take my driving test.
exampleCn: 考驾照前我还得再练练。

cn:
①提供（食物或饮料）

②（为…）工作；（为…）服务；尽职责
en:
①to provide food or drinks

②to work for; to do your duty to
exampleEn: Do they serve meals in the bar?
exampleCn: 这家酒吧提供饭菜吗？

en: to say or write what someone or something is like
exampleEn: He described the painting in detail.
exampleCn: 他详细描述了这幅画。

en: having a larger distance from one side to the other than is usual or expected, especially in comparison with the length of something; not narrow
exampleEn: His eyes were wide with surprise.
exampleCn: 他惊讶得睁大了眼睛。

en: to (cause something to) get better
exampleEn: I need to improve my English.
exampleCn: 我需要提高我的英语水平。

en: to want something to happen or to be true, and usually have a good reason to think that it might
exampleEn: I'm hoping for an interview next week.
exampleCn: 我盼望着下星期有一次面试。

cn:
①标识；记号

②分数；成绩
en:
①a symbol that is used for giving information

②a judgment, expressed as a number or letter, about the quality of a piece of work done at school, college, or university
exampleEn: What do those marks in the middle of the road mean?
exampleCn: 路中央的那些标识是什么意思？

cn:
①大自然，自然界

②种类；特性；本质
en:
①all the animals, plants, rocks, etc. in the world and all the features, forces, and processes that happen or exist independently of people, such as the weather, the sea, mountains, the production of young animals or plants, and growth

②the type or main characteristic of something
exampleEn: a nature article

cn: 主动给予；主动提出；提议
en: to ask someone if they would like to have something or if they would like you to do something
exampleEn: She was offered a job in Paris.
exampleCn: 她在巴黎得到了一份工作。

en: the amount of money for which something is sold
exampleEn: The price of oil has risen sharply.
exampleCn: 油价急剧上涨。

en: the highest place or part
exampleEn: She waited for me at the top of the stairs.
exampleCn: 她在楼梯梯顶位置等我。

en: weighing a lot, and needing effort to move or lift
exampleEn: How heavy is that box?
exampleCn: 那个箱子有多重？

en: a structure with walls and a roof, such as a house or factory
exampleEn: The once-empty site was now covered with buildings.
exampleCn: 一度空荡荡的地方现在布满了建筑物。

en: the amount of money needed to buy, do, or make something
exampleEn: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
exampleCn: 实际成本比我们预计的要高。

cn:
①花费；用，花（钱）

②花（时间）；度过
en:
①to give money as a payment for something

②to use time doing something or being somewhere
exampleEn: How much did you spend?
exampleCn: 你花了多少钱？

en: a room or part of a building in which people work, especially sitting at tables with computers, phones, etc., usually as a part of a business or other organization
exampleEn: the director's office

en: used when expressing rates, prices, or measurements to mean "for each"
exampleEn: The meal will cost $20 per person.
exampleCn: 这顿饭每人要花二十美元。

en: to produce writing or images on paper or other material with a machine
exampleEn: I'm waiting for a document to print.
exampleCn: 我正在等文件印出来。

en: to make whole or perfect
exampleEn: He only needs two more cards to complete the set.
exampleCn: 他只需再有两张牌就凑成一副了。

en: a person who buys goods or a service
exampleEn: Mrs Wilson is one of our regular customers.
exampleCn: 威尔逊太太是我们的一位老主顾。

en: to be suitable for something
exampleEn: With her qualifications, she should fit the job perfectly.
exampleCn: 以她的资历，应该完全能胜任这份工作。

en: after a long time or some difficulty
exampleEn: We finally got home at midnight.
exampleCn: 我们最后半夜才到家。

en: the direction in which the sun goes down in the evening, opposite to the east, or the part of an area or country that is in this direction
exampleEn: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
exampleCn: 太阳从东方升起，在西边落下。

en: a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea
exampleEn: a naval ship

en: a reptile with a long body and no legs
exampleEn: He's terrified of being bitten by a snake.
exampleCn: 他很害怕被蛇咬。

en: an unexpected event
exampleEn: Last night's heavy snow came as a complete surprise.
exampleCn: 昨晚的那场大雪下得太突然了。

cn: 野生的；未经栽培的；未经驯化的
en: used to refer to plants or animals that live or grow independently of people, in natural conditions and with natural characteristics
exampleEn: These herbs grow wild in the area.
exampleCn: 在这个地区，这种草是野生的。

cn: 清楚地；明白地；清晰地；易懂地
en: in a way that is easy to see, hear, read or understand
exampleEn: The facts are clearly stated in the report.
exampleCn: 报道对事实真相作了清楚的说明。

en: an organized event in which people try to win a prize by being the best, fastest, etc.
exampleEn: She's entered a crossword competition.
exampleCn: 她参加了纵横填字比赛。

cn: （组织或机构中的）部，系，处，科，室
en: a part of an organization such as a school, business, or government that deals with a particular area of study or work
exampleEn: The sales department is having a Christmas party this week.
exampleCn: 销售部本周正在举行圣诞晚会。

en: to see or become conscious of something or someon
exampleEn: I noticed a crack in the ceiling.
exampleCn: 我注意到天花板上有一条裂缝。

en: someone who paints pictures
exampleEn: He was a painter and poet.
exampleCn: 他是一位画家兼诗人。

cn:
①薄的；细的

②（身体）瘦的，不肥的
en:
①having a small distance between two opposite sides

②(of the body) with little flesh on the bones
exampleEn: a thin book

en: a television station
exampleEn: a sports channel

en: the system of tracks, stations, trains, etc.
exampleEn: a railroad station

en: a record of short pieces of information, such as people's names, usually written or printed with a single thing on each line and often ordered in a way that makes a particular thing easy to find
exampleEn: I've made a list of places I'd like to visit while we're in Paris.
exampleCn: 我把我们在巴黎期间我想去的地方列了一个单子。

en: to (cause different substances to) combine, so that the result cannot easily be separated into its parts
exampleEn: Mix the eggs into the flour.
exampleCn: 在面粉里和入些鸡蛋。

en: a flat surface in a cinema, on a television, or as part of a computer, on which pictures or words are shown
exampleEn: Our television has a 19-inch screen.
exampleCn: 我们的电视屏幕是十九英寸的。

en: a structure that is built over a river, road, or railway to allow people and vehicles to cross from one side to the other
exampleEn: We drove across the bridge.
exampleCn: 我们开车驶过大桥。

cn:
①未赶上，错过
②想念，惦念；怀念，思念
en:
①to arrive too late to get on a bus, train, or aircraft

②to feel sad that a person or thing is not present
exampleEn: He listened attentively so as not to miss a single word.
exampleCn: 他不想漏掉一个字，所以很用心的听了。

en: having a lot of money or valuable possessions
exampleEn: He's the third richest man in the country.
exampleCn: 他是全国第三大富豪。

en: a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again
exampleEn: The trip from York to Newcastle takes about an hour by train.
exampleCn: 乘火车从约克到纽卡斯尔大约要花一个小时。

en: related to or connected with music
exampleEn: musical instruments

en: at a slow speed
exampleEn: Could you please speak more slowly?
exampleCn: 你能说得再慢些吗？

en: to come or go into a particular place
exampleEn: You will begin to feel sleepy as the drug enters the bloodstream.
exampleCn: 药物进入血液后你就会开始感到困倦。

en:
①the season of the year between winter and summer

②a place where water naturally flows out from the ground
exampleEn: Many bulbs bloom in spring.
exampleCn: 很多球茎植物春天开花。

en: to choose something, especially after thinking carefully about several possibilities
exampleEn: They have to decide by next Friday.
exampleCn: 他们必须要在下周五之前做决定。

en: (of a container or a space) holding or containing as much as possible or a lot
exampleEn: This cup is very full so be careful with it.
exampleCn: 这个杯子太满了，要当心。

en: to get or be given something
exampleEn: Did you receive my letter?
exampleCn: 你收到我的信了吗？

en: to have or use something at the same time as someone else
exampleEn: I share a house with four other people.
exampleCn: 我和另外四个人合住一所房子。

en: a picture, short film, song, etc. that tries to persuade people to buy a product or service, or a piece of text that tells people about a job, etc.
exampleEn: She scanned the job advertisements in the paper.
exampleCn: 她浏览了一下报纸的招聘广告。

en: almost, or not completely
exampleEn: It's been nearly three months since my last haircut.
exampleCn: 从我上次理发到现在已经快三个月了。

en: added to
exampleEn: Two plus five is seven.
exampleCn: 二加五等于七。

cn: 工程师；工程（或机械）设计人员
en: a person whose job is to design or build machines, engines, or electrical equipment, or things such as roads, railways, or bridges, using scientific principles
exampleEn: My father is a a software engineer.
exampleCn: 我爸爸是软件工程师.

en: When a bird, insect, or aircraft flies, it moves through the air.
exampleEn: As soon as it saw us, the bird flew away.
exampleCn: 鸟一看到我们就飞走了。

cn:
①自由的；无拘束的

②免费的
en:
①not limited or controlled

②costing nothing, or not needing to be paid for
exampleEn: Students have a free choice of courses in their final year.
exampleCn: 学生在最后一学年可以自由选修课程。

en: an artificial substance that can be shaped when soft into many different forms and has many different uses
exampleEn: He put a sheet of plastic over the broken window.
exampleCn: 他在打碎的窗户上蒙了块塑料布。

en: a building or large room used for events involving a lot of people
exampleEn: a concert hall

en: ordinary or usual; the same as would be expected
exampleEn: Lively behaviour is normal for a four-year-old child.
exampleCn: 四岁的孩子好动是正常的。

en: to come out of a mother's body, and start to exist
exampleEn: I was born on Christmas Day.
exampleCn: 我出生在圣诞节。

cn:
①躺；平躺；平卧

②说谎，撒谎
en:
①to be in or move into a horizontal position on a surface

②to say or write something that is not true in order to deceive someone
exampleEn: A cat lies in front of the fire.
exampleCn: 一只猫趴在炉火前。

en: a usually short piece of music with words that are sung
exampleEn: to sing a song

en: someone who works in a particular job or in a particular way
exampleEn: a killed worker

en: to accept, tolerate, or endure something, especially something unpleasant
exampleEn: The pain was almost more than he could bear.
exampleCn: 这种痛苦几乎使他无法忍受。

en: a scientist who studies biology
exampleEn: Dingle is an evolutionary biologist who studies insects.
exampleCn: 丁格尔是一位研究昆虫的进化生物学家。

en: an organization for people who want to take part in a sport or social activity together, or the building they use for this
exampleEn: I've just joined the local golf club.
exampleCn: 我刚参加了当地的高尔夫球俱乐部。

en: (the title of) a male ruler of a country, who holds this position because of his royal birth
exampleEn: the kings and queens of England

en: relating to or typical of a whole country and its people, rather than to part of that country or to other countries
exampleEn: Britain has more than ten national newspapers.
exampleCn: 英国有十多种全国性报纸。

en: a number of people or animals who do something together as a group
exampleEn: Each specialist has a team of doctors under him or her.
exampleCn: 每位专家手下都有一组医生。

en: the part of a building, object, or person's body that faces forward or is most often seen or used
exampleEn: The front of the museum is very impressive.
exampleCn: 博物馆的正面极为壮观。

en: to give a description of something or information about it to someone
exampleEn: We called the insurance company to report the theft.
exampleCn: 我们打电话将失窃的事情告知保险公司。

en: to get and keep things of one type such as stamps or coins as a hobby
exampleEn: She collects dolls.
exampleCn: 她收藏玩具娃娃。

en: not including; but not
exampleEn: We work every day except Sunday.
exampleCn: 我们除星期天外每天都工作。

en: last
exampleEn: The game is in its final stages.
exampleCn: 这场比赛现在处于最后阶段。

cn:
①剩余部分；其余；其余的人

②暂停，停止；休息
en:
①the other things, people, or parts that remain or that have not been mentioned

②a period of time in which you relax, do not do anything active, or sleep
exampleEn: Do you have anything planned for the rest of the day?
exampleCn: 这天剩余的时间你安排什么事了吗？

en: the area above the earth, in which clouds, the sun, etc. can be seen
exampleEn: a blue sky

en: involving more than one country
exampleEn: His speciality is international law.
exampleCn: 他的专业是国际法。

en: the study of numbers, shapes, and space using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them
exampleEn: Mathematics is her favorite subject.
exampleCn: 数学是她喜欢的科目。

en: a route or track between one place and another, or the direction in which something is moving
exampleEn: This is the path to the cliffs.
exampleCn: 这条路通向悬崖。

en: the red liquid that is sent around the body by the heart, and carries oxygen and important substances to organs and tissue, and removes waste products
exampleEn: He lost a lot of blood in the accident.
exampleCn: 他在事故中大量失血。

en: a drawing of the earth's surface, or part of that surface, showing the shape and position of different countries, political borders, natural features such as rivers and mountains, and artificial features such as roads and buildings
exampleEn: I'm terrible at map reading.
exampleCn: 我一点儿也看不懂地图。

en: the activity or job of taking photographs or filming
exampleEn: She's taking an evening class in photography.
exampleCn: 她在夜校学摄影。

en: a large musical instrument with a row of black and white keys that are pressed to play notes
exampleEn: We're buying a new piano.
exampleCn: 我们准备买一架新钢琴。

en: covered in water or another liquid
exampleEn: My bike got wet in the rain.
exampleCn: 我的自行车在雨中淋湿了。

en: full of light, shining
exampleEn: A bright star was shining in the East.
exampleCn: 东方闪烁着一颗明亮的星。

en: Classical music is considered to be part of a long, formal tradition and to be of lasting value.
exampleEn: Swan Lake' is one of the great classical ballets.
exampleCn: 《天鹅湖》是一部伟大的古典芭蕾舞剧。

en: a large, thin, flat, usually rectangular piece of something
exampleEn: a sheet of glass

en: to have the same opinion
exampleEn: Ann and I never seem to agree.
exampleCn: 安和我好像从来都没有意见一致过。

cn: 单独（的），独自（的）；孤独的（地），无伴的（地）
en: without other people
exampleEn: He likes being alone in the house.
exampleCn: 他喜欢自己一个人呆在家里。

en: happening on or relating to every day
exampleEn: Exercise has become part of my daily routine.
exampleCn: 锻炼已经变成了我每日日程的一部分。

cn:
①体育活动；锻炼；运动

②习题；练习
en:
①physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy

②a short piece of written work that you do to practise something you are learning
exampleEn: Swimming is my favourite form of exercise.
exampleCn: 我最喜欢的锻炼方式是游泳。

en: (of food or flowers) in a natural condition rather than artificially preserved by a process such as freezing
exampleEn: fresh fruit and vegetables

en: pleased and happy
exampleEn: We were glad about her success.
exampleCn: 我们都为她的成功感到高兴。

en: a musical play in which most of the words are sung, or plays and music of this type
exampleEn: "Carmen" is my favourite opera.
exampleCn: 《卡门》是我最喜爱的歌剧。

en: to move something towards yourself, sometimes with great physical effort
exampleEn: He pulled the chair away from the desk.
exampleCn: 他把椅子从书桌旁拉开。

en: the distance along a street from where one road crosses it to the place where the next road crosses it, or one part of a street like this, especially in a town or city
exampleEn: The museum is just six blocks away.
exampleCn: 博物馆离这儿只有六条街。

en: a machine that uses the energy from liquid fuel or steam to produce movement

exampleCn: 我的汽车发动机最近老出问题。

en: added to what is normal
exampleEn: If you need any extra help, just call me.
exampleCn: 如果还需要其他的帮助，尽管给我打电话。

en: shaped like a ball or circle, or curved

exampleCn: 塔楼曾是城市防御的重要组成部分。

exampleCn: 我再学校最喜欢的学科是历史和地理

exampleCn: 她说她的耳朵疼。

en: a large, round fruit with hard yellow or green skin, sweet flesh, and a lot of seeds
exampleEn: We garnished the melon with strawberries.
exampleCn: 我们给甜瓜配上草莓。

en: to put something into a bag, box, etc.
exampleEn: I haven't packed my clothes yet.
exampleCn: 我还没收拾衣服呢。

en: the standard unit of money used in the UK and some other countries
exampleEn: a one-pound coin

en: a long, flat board fixed horizontally, usually against a wall or inside a cupboard so that objects can be stored on it

en: a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time and place

exampleCn: 她不得不取消去看牙医的预约。

exampleCn: 非洲有三分之的土地面临荒漠化的威胁。

en: a paper or set of papers with written or printed information, especially of an official type

exampleCn: 他们被控使用伪造的文件。

en: things such as chairs, tables, beds, cupboards, etc. that are put into a house or other building to make it suitable and comfortable for living or working in

exampleCn: 他们有很多古董家具。

en: a grey or white powder produced by crushing dry peppercorns, used to give a spicy, hot taste to food
exampleEn: freshly ground black pepper

en: making very little noise
exampleEn: It's so quiet without the kids here.
exampleCn: 孩子们不在，这里真安静。

en: to put something that is damaged, broken, or not working correctly, back into good condition or make it work again
exampleEn: to repair a roof after a storm
exampleCn: 暴风雨后修理房顶

en: to form a word or words with the letters in the correct order
exampleEn: I think it's important that children should be taught to spell.
exampleCn: 我认为教孩子们正确地拼写非常重要。

en: two times
exampleEn: I've already asked him twice.
exampleCn: 我已经问过他两次了。

en: someone who visits a person or place
exampleEn: You have some visitors to see you.
exampleCn: 有人来看你了。

en: a shop or website where books are sold
exampleEn: The bookstore opened last year.
exampleCn: 书店去年开张了。

en: to produce tears as the result of a strong emotion, such as unhappiness or pain
exampleEn: I could hear someone crying in the next room.
exampleCn: 我能听见隔壁房间有人在哭。

en: the possibility of harm or death to someone
exampleEn: the dangers of rock-climbing
exampleCn: 攀岩的种种危险

en: a sweet, sticky, yellow substance made by bees and used as food
exampleEn: A scent of honey wafted up from the hives.
exampleCn: 一股蜂蜜的香味从蜂房里飘上来。

en: an oval fruit that has a thick, yellow skin and sour juice
exampleEn: For this recipe you need the juice of two lemons.
exampleCn: 按照这份食谱，你需要两个柠檬的果汁。

en: a large wild animal of the cat family with yellowish-brown fur that lives in Africa and southern Asia
exampleEn: A lion is a dangerous animal.
exampleCn: 狮子是猛兽。

cn: 幸运的，走运的，运气好的
en: having good things happen to you by chance
exampleEn: He's lucky that he wasn't fired.
exampleCn: 他很幸运，没有被解雇。

en: a person who studies physics or whose job is connected with physics
exampleEn: He's known to be an outstanding physicist.
exampleCn: 他被公认为杰出的物理学家。

cn: 很可能真实的；很可能发生的
en: likely to be true or likely to happen
exampleEn: It is probable that share prices will fall even more.
exampleCn: 股价很可能进一步下跌。

en: If something is described as a shame, it is disappointing or not satisfactory.
exampleEn: It's a great shame that the event had to be cancelled.
exampleCn: 音乐会被迫取消，真是很遗憾。

en: Woody plants have hard stems.
exampleEn: The garden was overgrown with woody plants such as hawthorn and bramble.
exampleCn: 花园里长满了诸如山楂、黑莓之类的木本植物。

en: something bad that happens that is not expected or intended and that often damages something or injures someone
exampleEn: She was injured in a car accident.
exampleCn: 她在一起交通事故中受伤了。

en: an unusual, exciting, and possibly dangerous activity, such as a trip or experience, or the excitement produced by such an activity
exampleEn: She had some exciting adventures in Egypt.
exampleCn: 她在埃及经历了一些很刺激的奇遇。

en: a strip of leather or material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration
exampleEn: She fastened her belt tightly around her waist.
exampleCn: 她把腰带束紧。

en: money in the form of notes and coins, rather than cheques or credit cards
exampleEn: Will you pay by credit card or in cash?
exampleCn: 你是刷信用卡还是付现金？

en: a theatre where people pay to watch films
exampleEn: The town no longer has a cinema.
exampleCn: 小镇已不再有电影院了。

en: When it is cloudy, there are clouds in the sky.
exampleEn: Scotland will be cloudy with wintry showers.
exampleCn: 苏格兰将会转阴，并伴有寒冷的阵雨。

en: stupid or not reasonable
exampleEn: It's a crazy idea.
exampleCn: 这是个荒唐的想法。

en: a device like a box that moves up and down, carrying people or goods from one floor of a building to another or taking people up and down underground in a mine
exampleEn: The elevator doors parted and out stepped the President.
exampleCn: 电梯门打开了，总统从里面步出。

en: a style that is popular at a particular time, especially in clothes, hair, make-up, etc.
exampleEn: Fur coats have gone out of fashion.
exampleCn: 皮草大衣已经过时了。

cn: （绘画及雕塑中对人物、风景等的）正面描绘
en: a frontal view, as in a painting or other work of art
exampleEn: I am convinced that frontality is a basic character of all Japanese architecture.
exampleCn: 我认为正面性是日本建筑的一个基本特征。

en: made of gold
exampleEn: a golden necklace

en: to move or do things more quickly than normal or to make someone do this
exampleEn: Hurry or you'll be late.
exampleCn: 快点儿，要不你就晚了。

en: someone who lives on an island
exampleEn: The islanders endured centuries of exploitation.
exampleCn: 岛民们忍受了几个世纪的剥削。

en: to push yourself suddenly off the ground and into the air using your legs
exampleEn: The children were jumping up and down with excitement.
exampleCn: 孩子们兴奋地跳来跳去。

en: able to be moved
exampleEn: This dresser is movable, and we can take it to our new flat.
exampleCn: 这个梳妆台是可移动的，我们可以把它带到新公寓去。

en: a fungus with a round top and short stem. Some types of mushroom can be eaten
exampleEn: Some mushrooms are poisonous.
exampleCn: 有些蘑菇有毒。

en: the part of the body that joins the head to the shoulders
exampleEn: She wore a gold chain around her neck.
exampleCn: 她脖子上戴着一条金链子。

en: a person's job
exampleEn: In the space marked "occupation" she wrote "police officer".
exampleCn: 在“职业”一栏里她写了“警察”。

en: relating to, used for, or produced by photography
exampleEn: The equipment of the photographic studio was expensive.
exampleCn: 这个摄影室的装备花费巨大。

en: a person who takes photographs, either as a job or hobby
exampleEn: a fashion photographer

en: a chemical element that is a valuable shiny, white metal, used for making cutlery, jewellery, coins, and decorative objects
exampleEn: We gave them a dish made of solid silver as a wedding present.
exampleCn: 我们送给他们一个纯银盘子作为结婚礼物。

en: an organ in the body where food is digested, or the soft front part of your body just below the chest
exampleEn: My stomach is still sore after the operation.
exampleCn: 手术后，我的胃还在疼。

cn: 剧场的；演剧的；戏剧（或歌剧等）剧本编写的
en: belonging or relating to the theatre, or to the performance or writing of plays, opera, etc.
exampleEn: Acting with an amateur theatrical group can be fun.
exampleCn: 和业余戏剧小组一起演出可能是有趣的。

en: happening once a week or every week
exampleEn: The fire alarm has a weekly test.
exampleCn: 每周都要对火警系统进行检测。

en: after the time mentioned
exampleEn: We had tea, and afterwards we sat in the garden for a while.
exampleCn: 我们喝了茶，后来在花园里坐了一会儿。

en: a clear liquid that can make you drunk, also used as a solvent and in fuel and medicines
exampleEn: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.
exampleCn: 这种饮料不含任何酒精。

en: a flat cover made of wool or similar warm material, usually used on a bed
exampleEn: I wrapped a blanket around the baby.
exampleCn: 我用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

en: to reach, or cause something to reach, the temperature at which a liquid starts to turn into a gas
exampleEn: Liquid nitrogen boils at a very low temperature.
exampleCn: 液态氮在很低的温度下就会达到沸点。

en: the person who is in charge of an organization and who tells others what to do
exampleEn: She was the boss of a large international company.
exampleCn: 她曾是一家大型跨国公司的老板。

en: to annoy or cause problems for someone
exampleEn: Don't bother your father when he's working.
exampleCn: 你父亲工作时不要打扰他。

en: the quality of shining with, or of producing, a lot of light
exampleEn: The star varies in brightness by about three magnitudes.
exampleCn: 星体的亮度大约分三个星等。

en: someone who is in your class at school
exampleEn: Tom is my classmate.
exampleCn: Tom是我的同班同学。

en: a sofa
exampleEn: He crossed to the couch and sat beside her.
exampleCn: 他跨过沙发坐在她旁边。

en: in or into equal amounts
exampleEn: Divide the mixture evenly between the baking pans.
exampleCn: 将混合物分成等份放在烤盘中。

en: a weather condition in which very small drops of water come together to form a thick cloud close to the land or seaocean, making it difficult to see
exampleEn: Mist, fog, and snow are common in this area.
exampleCn: 薄雾、寒雾和雪在这个地区很常见。

en: a person who is staying with you, or a person you have invited to a social occasion, such as a party or a meal
exampleEn: We have guests staying this weekend.
exampleCn: 有客人到家来和我们一起度周末。

en: a public road, especially an important road that joins cities or towns together
exampleEn: The highway links the two cities together.
exampleCn: 这条高速公路把那两座城市连接了起来。

en: decorative objects worn on clothes or on the body, such as rings and necklaces, often made from valuable metals and containing precious stones
exampleEn: I asked him to have my jewelry valued.
exampleCn: 我请求他为我的珠宝估价。

en: a unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams
exampleEn: Flour is sold by the kilogram.
exampleCn: 面粉按公斤出售。

en: the use of special powers to make things happen that would usually be impossible, such as in stories for children

exampleCn: 这一组织以相信巫术和魔法而出名。

en: a list of the food that you can eat in a restaurant

exampleCn: 我们只有分类菜单。

en: making a lot of noise

exampleCn: 太吵了，我们都听不见自己说话了。

en: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day, or about that time
exampleEn: We reached the summit at noon.
exampleCn: 中午时分我们抵达峰顶。

en: well arranged or organized
exampleEn: She put the letters in three orderly piles.
exampleCn: 她把信整理成整齐的三摞。

en: A pale light or colour is not bright or strong.

exampleCn: 她戴着一顶浅蓝色的帽子。

en: a picture produced using a camera
exampleEn: I spent the day taking photographs of the city.
exampleCn: 我花了一天时间拍摄这座城市的照片。

cn: （无线电或电视）接收器；接收机
en: a piece of equipment that changes radio and television signals into sounds and pictures
exampleEn: When he was a child, Stuart built a radio receiver and transmitter.
exampleCn: 当斯图尔特是孩子的时候，他制作了一个无线电接受和发射机。

en: a salad made with tuna, cheese, egg, etc. and lettuce or other cold ingredients
exampleEn: She had a tuna salad for lunch.
exampleCn: 她午餐吃的是金枪鱼色拉。

en: a set of steps that lead from one level of a building to another

exampleCn: 上楼后，她的办公室在右手边。

en: a jacket and trousers or a jacket and skirt that are made from the same material
exampleEn: She wore a dark blue suit.
exampleCn: 她穿着一套深蓝色的衣服。

en: a series of musical notes, especially one that is pleasant and easy to remember
exampleEn: He was humming a tune as he dried the dishes.
exampleCn: 他边哼着调子边擦干碗碟。

en: any of several different types of container used to store papers, letters, and other documents in an ordered way, especially in an office

exampleCn: 我们把你的记录归档保存五年。

en: with reference to the geography of a particular region
exampleEn: Geographically, china's western part is higher than the eastern part.
exampleCn: 从地理上看，中国的西部高于东部。

en: a female god
exampleEn: Aphrodite was the ancient Greek goddess of love.
exampleCn: 阿佛洛狄忒是古希腊神话中的爱神。

en: a unit of mass equal to 0.001 kilograms
exampleEn: To make this cake, you'll need 100 grams each of sugar and flour, and two eggs.
exampleCn: 做这个蛋糕你需要一百克糖，面粉以及两个鸡蛋。

en: in a very obvious or noticeable way
exampleEn: This year's sales have risen markedly.
exampleCn: 今年的销售额明显提高了。

en: too; very
exampleEn: Earlier sales forecasts were overly optimistic.
exampleCn: 早先的销售预测过于乐观了。

en: a person or organization you are closely involved with in some way
exampleEn: He gave up his job as a police officer after his partner was killed.
exampleCn: 他在搭档被杀后辞去了警官的工作。

en: to the life, realistically

exampleCn: 规划地区已经作了详尽的的实地检视﹐也详细照相作记录。

en: a person who sings
exampleEn: Bryn Terfel is a famous singer from Wales.
exampleCn: 布莱恩·特费尔是威尔士著名歌手。

en: an object for children to play with
exampleEn: Leave daddy's camera alone - it isn't a toy!
exampleCn: 别碰爸爸的照相机——它不是玩具！

en: to achieve first position and/or get a prize in a competition, election, fight, etc.
exampleEn: Who won the men's finals at the Open?
exampleCn: 网球男子决赛谁赢了？

en: an opinion that someone offers you about what you should do or how you should act in a particular situation
exampleEn: Steven gave me some good advice.
exampleCn: 史蒂文给了我一些好建议。

en: to raise something or lift something up
exampleEn: The platform was elevated by means of hydraulic legs.
exampleCn: 平台由液压支架抬升起来。

en: an exam
exampleEn: All students without exception must take the English examination.
exampleCn: 所有学生都必须参加英语考试，无一例外。

en: using or consisting of facts
exampleEn: The essay contains a number of factual errors.
exampleCn: 文章中有一些与事实不符的错误。

en: with fog
exampleEn: It's quite foggy now.
exampleCn: 现在雾很大。

en: relating to the front of something
exampleEn: the frontal regions of the brain
exampleCn: 大脑的前部区域

en: the quality of being glad
exampleEn: Why do they serve with gladness?
exampleCn: 为什么他们高兴快乐事奉神呢？

en: wanting to give your attention to something and discover more about it
exampleEn: I'm not interested in sport.
exampleCn: 我对体育运动不感兴趣。

en: Presidential activities or things relate or belong to a president.
exampleEn: Many countries favour a presidential system of government.
exampleCn: 很多国家选择总统制政府。

en: the fact of believing something is true without any proof or something that you believe to be true without any proof
exampleEn: That article was based on pure supposition.
exampleCn: 那篇文章纯粹是基于推测。

cn: 正确的，真实的，确实的；如实的
en: (especially of facts or statements) right and not wrong; correct
exampleEn: Her story is only partly true.
exampleCn: 她的描述只有部分是真实的。

en: a teacher of the highest rank in a department of a British university, or a teacher of high rank in an American university or college
exampleEn: She's a professor of nutrition at Columbia University.
exampleCn: 她是哥伦比亚大学的营养学教授。

en: a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country
exampleEn: All areas of the country will have some rain tonight.
exampleCn: 今晚全国所有地区都将有降雨。

en: a formal talk on a serious subject given to a group of people, especially students
exampleEn: We went to a lecture on Italian art.
exampleCn: 我们去参加了一个关于意大利艺术的讲座。

cn:
①生存；活着

②生活，过活
en:
①to be alive or have life

②to spend your life in a particular way
exampleEn: He only lived a few days after the accident.
exampleCn: 出事后他只活了几天就死了。

en: cows and bulls that are kept for their milk or meat
exampleEn: The cattle are rounded up in the evenings.
exampleCn: 到了晚上，牛都要圈起来。

en: the planet third in order of distance from the sun, between Venus and Mars; the world on which we live
exampleEn: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are called "rocky planets".
exampleCn: 水星、金星、地球和火星被称为“岩石行星”。

en: to (make something) become larger in amount or size
exampleEn: The cost of the project has increased dramatically since it began.
exampleCn: 该项目自开始以来成本就急剧上升。

en: the dry solid part of the earth's surface, or any large piece of this that sticks up out of the ground or the sea
exampleEn: Mountains and cliffs are formed from rock.
exampleCn: 山和悬崖都是由岩石构成的。

en: a set of connected things or devices that operate together
exampleEn: a central heating system

en: to make something or bring something into existence
exampleEn: France produces a great deal of wine for export.
exampleCn: 法国生产大量葡萄酒供出口。

en: length of time
exampleEn: Her work means that she spends long periods away from home.
exampleCn: 她的工作意味着她得长时间离家在外。

cn:
①状态；情形；状况

②（德国、澳大利亚、美国等的）州，邦
en:
①a condition or way of being that exists at a particular time

②a part of a large country with its own government, such as in Germany, Australia, or the US
exampleEn: The building was in a state of disrepair.
exampleCn: 这栋大楼年久失修。

en: an area of ground, especially when used for a particular purpose such as farming or building
exampleEn: This sort of land is no good for growing potatoes.
exampleCn: 这种地不适合种土豆。

cn:
①兴趣，关注

②利益，好处
en:
①the feeling of wanting to give your attention to something or of wanting to be involved with and to discover more about something

②something that brings advantages to or affects someone or something
exampleEn: I've always had an interest in astronomy.
exampleCn: 我一直对天文学感兴趣。

en: of or typical of people
exampleEn: The food was not fit for human consumption.
exampleCn: 这食物不适合人吃。

en: to make something new, or invent something
exampleEn: He created a wonderful meal from very few ingredients.
exampleCn: 他用很少的几种食材做了一顿美餐。

en: from a particular time in the past until a later time, or until now
exampleEn: Emma went to work in New York a year ago, and we haven't seen her since.
exampleCn: 埃玛一年前去纽约工作了，自那时起我们就没有见过她

en: the quality of being hot or warm, or the temperature of something
exampleEn: Cook the meat on a high heat.
exampleCn: 用高温来烹调肉。

en: the power and ability to be physically and mentally active
exampleEn: Her writing is full of passion and energy.
exampleCn: 她的文章中充满激情和活力。

en: someone who is paid to work for someone else
exampleEn: He is an employee of Fuji Bank.
exampleCn: 他是富士银行的一位雇员。

en: something that happens or exists because of something else
exampleEn: The road has been widened, but the result is just more traffic.
exampleCn: 道路被拓宽，但结果车流量却更大了。

en: to (cause something to) grow or change into a more advanced, larger, or stronger form
exampleEn: It became clear that he wasn't developing like all the other little boys.
exampleCn: 显然他没有像其他小男孩那样正常生长发育。

cn: 古代的；古老的；年代久远的
en: of or from a long time ago, having lasted for a very long time
exampleEn: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.
exampleCn: 自古以来人们就住在这个山谷里。

en: the process in which someone or something grows or changes and becomes more advanced
exampleEn: healthy growth and development
exampleCn: 健康的成长发育

cn:
①虽然，尽管

②可是，不过，然而
en:
①despite the fact that

②but
exampleEn: She hasn't called, even though she said she would.
exampleCn: 虽然她说过要打电话，可还没打。

en: to show the way to a group of people, animals, vehicles, etc. by going in front of them
exampleEn: I don't know the way, so you'd better lead.
exampleCn: 我不认识路，你最好在前面带路。

en: a detailed study of a subject, especially in order to discover (new) information or reach a (new) understanding
exampleEn: medical research

en: a single thing or a separate part of something larger
exampleEn: The company plans to split into two or three units.
exampleCn: 公司计划拆分成三个部分。

en: the result of a particular influence
exampleEn: I think I'm suffering from the effects of too little sleep.
exampleCn: 我觉得我睡眠太少，健康受到了影响。

cn: 区域；地区；（国家的）行政区
en: a particular area or part of the world, or any of the large official areas into which a country is divided
exampleEn: one of China's autonomous regions
exampleCn: 中国的自治区之一

cn:
①提议；建议

②暗示；间接表明；意味着
en:
①to mention an idea, possible plan, or action for other people to consider

②to communicate or show an idea or feeling without stating it directly or giving proof
exampleEn: I suggested an Italian restaurant near the station for the party.
exampleCn: 我建议聚会去火车站附近的一家意大利餐馆。

en: one of the parts that something is divided into
exampleEn: the sports section of the newspaper
exampleCn: 报纸的体育版

en: to make or draw plans for something, for example clothes or buildings
exampleEn: Who designed this building?
exampleCn: 谁设计了这个建筑？

en: an extremely large, round mass of rock and metal, such as Earth, or of gas, such as Jupiter, that moves in a circular path around the sun or another star
exampleEn: Might there be intelligent life on other planets?
exampleCn: 其他星球上有可能存在智能生命吗？

en: the act of thinking about or considering something, an idea or opinion, or a set of ideas about a particular subject
exampleEn: Let me have your thoughts on that report by Friday.
exampleCn: 星期五或之前告诉我你对那份报告的看法吧。

en: to give someone something that they need
exampleEn: This booklet provides useful information about local services.
exampleCn: 这本小册子提供了有关当地服务机构的有用信息。

en: the surface of the earth
exampleEn: I sat down on the ground.
exampleCn: 我坐在地上。

cn: 停留，留下；保持不变，仍然是
en: to stay in the same place or in the same condition
exampleEn: The doctor ordered him to remain in bed for a few days.
exampleCn: 医生嘱咐他要继续卧床几天。

cn:
①肯定的，无疑的；有把握的；确定的

②不可避免地，必然地；极可能地
en:
①having no doubt or knowing exactly that something is true, or known to be true, correct, exact, or effective

②impossible to avoid or extremely likely
exampleEn: You should make certain that everyone understands the instructions.
exampleCn: 你应该确保大家都能听懂指令。

en: a general feeling or understanding
exampleEn: Did you get any sense of how they might react?
exampleCn: 你预感他们会作何反应？

en: the hard, solid substance found in the ground that is often used for building, or a piece of this
exampleEn: The stones have been worn smooth by the constant flow of water.
exampleCn: 不停的流水把这些石头冲刷得很光滑。

cn: （建筑物的）地点，位置；建筑工地；（某事发生的）地点，现场
en: a place where something is, was, or will be built, or where something happened, is happening, or will happen
exampleEn: The company hasn't yet chosen the site for the new hospital.
exampleCn: 公司尚未选定新医院的院址。

en: to move in one direction, especially continuously and easily
exampleEn: Many short rivers flow into the Pacific Ocean.
exampleCn: 许多小河汇入太平洋。

en: the activity of buying and selling, or exchanging, goods and/or services between people or countries
exampleEn: he country's trade in manufactured goods has expanded in the last ten years.
exampleCn: 该国的工业品贸易在最近十年里扩大了规模。

cn: 使有可能；允许，准许；容许
en: to give permission for someone to do something, or to not prevent something from happening
exampleEn: You're not allowed to talk during the exam.
exampleCn: 考试期间不许交谈。

en: a collection or mass, especially of something that cannot be counted
exampleEn: Small amounts of land were used for keeping animals.
exampleCn: 少量的土地用于饲养动物。

en: the weather conditions that an area usually has
exampleEn: a hot climate

en: the particular state that something or someone is in
exampleEn: The piano was in good condition.
exampleCn: 这台钢琴状况良好。

en: someone whose job is doing market research
exampleEn: Researchers uncovered new facts about his family.
exampleCn: 研究人员发现了有关他家庭的新情况。

cn: 天然的，非人为的；非人造的
en: as found in nature and not involving anything made or done by people
exampleEn: Floods and earthquakes are natural disasters.
exampleCn: 洪水和地震是自然灾害。

en: existing and considered separately from the other things or people in a group
exampleEn: Each individual table is finished by hand.
exampleCn: 每一张桌子都是手工做成的。

en: to order, limit, or rule something, or someone's actions or behaviour
exampleEn: You're going to have to learn to control your temper.
exampleCn: 你必须学会控制住自己的脾气。

en: to spend time thinking about a possibility or making a decision
exampleEn: We're considering selling the house.
exampleCn: 我们在考虑卖掉房子。

en: to allow something to happen or someone to do something by not doing anything to stop an action or by giving your permission
exampleEn: She wanted to go but her parents wouldn't let her.
exampleCn: 她想走，但父母不让。

en: to move upwards
exampleEn: The balloon rose gently up into the air.
exampleCn: 气球慢慢升入空中。

cn:
①常见的；经常的；普遍的；普通的；平常的

②共同的；共有的
en:
①the same in a lot of places or for a lot of people

②belonging to or shared by two or more people, or things
exampleEn: It's quite common to see couples who dress alike.
exampleCn: 夫妻穿着相似是司空见惯的事儿。

en: If you freeze something, you lower its temperature below 0°C, causing it to become cold and often hard, and if something freezes, its temperature goes below 0°C.
exampleEn: Water freezes to ice at a temperature of 0°C.
exampleCn: 水在零摄氏度结冰。

en: to have something inside or include something as a part
exampleEn: How much liquid do you think this bottle contains?
exampleCn: 你认为这个瓶可装多少液体？

en:
①If an activity, situation, etc. involves something, that thing is a part of the activity, etc.

②If a situation involves someone or something, he, she, or it is affected by it.
exampleEn: The operation involves putting a small tube into your heart.
exampleCn: 这项手术需要在你的心脏里放一根小管子。

en: (the total amount collected of) a plant such as a grain, fruit, or vegetable grown in large amounts
exampleEn: The main crops grown for export are coffee and rice.
exampleCn: 主要的出口作物是咖啡和大米。

cn:
①社交的，交际的

②社会的；群居的
en:
①relating to activities in which you meet and spend time with other people and that happen during the time when you are not working

②relating to society and living together in an organized way
exampleEn: I had an active social life when I was at college.
exampleCn: 上大学时，我的社交生活很丰富。

en: to put a question to someone, or to request an answer from someone
exampleEn: She asked me a question.
exampleCn: 她问了我一个问题。

en: the particular physical form or appearance of something
exampleEn: These bricks are all different shapes.
exampleCn: 这些砖形状都不同。

en: (the process of getting) knowledge or skill from doing, seeing, or feeling things
exampleEn: Do you have any experience of working with kids?
exampleCn: 你有照看孩子的工作经验吗？

cn: 男（性）的；男子的；雄性的，公的
en: used to refer to men or boys, or the sex that fertilizes eggs, and does not produce babies or eggs itself
exampleEn: What percentage of the adult male population is unemployed?
exampleCn: 成年男性中的失业比例是多少？

cn: （体力或智力方面的）能力；才能，才智
en: the physical or mental power or skill needed to do something
exampleEn: She had the ability to explain things clearly and concisely.
exampleCn: 她有能力简单扼要地把事情解释清楚。

en: a way of doing an activity that needs skill
exampleEn: We have developed a new technique for detecting errors in the manufacturing process.
exampleCn: 我们开发了一项新技术，用于检测生产流程中的错误。

en: despite the fact that
exampleEn: She walked home by herself, although she knew that it was dangerous.
exampleCn: 她一个人步行回的家，尽管她知道那样做很危险。

cn:
①出现；呈现；显现

②看来好像；似乎
en:
①to start to be seen or to be present

②to seem
exampleEn: He suddenly appeared in the doorway.
exampleCn: 他突然出现在门口。

en: a chemical element that is a common greyish-coloured metal. It is strong, used in making steel, and exists in very small amounts in blood.
exampleEn: Iron rusts easily.
exampleCn: 铁易生锈。

cn:
①到达，抵达

②达到，发展到，提升到
en:
①to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort travelling

②to get to a particular level, especially a high one
exampleEn: We won't reach Miami until five or six o'clock.
exampleCn: 我们得五六点钟才能到达迈阿密。

en: anything that happens, especially something important or unusual
exampleEn: Susannah's party was the social event of the year.
exampleCn: 苏珊娜办的聚会是当年社交界的一件盛事。

en: quite; to a slight degree
exampleEn: It's rather cold today, isn't it?
exampleCn: 今天相当冷，是不是？

en: to keep happening, existing, or doing something, or to cause something or someone to do this
exampleEn: It's said that as the boat went down the band continued to play.
exampleCn: 据说，船沉时乐队仍在继续演奏。

en: slightly cold
exampleEn: cool water

en: the way that someone behaves
exampleEn: His research involved the study of instinctive behaviour in birds.
exampleCn: 他的研究是关于鸟类本能行为的。

en: to need something or make something necessary
exampleEn: Please call this number if you require any further information.
exampleCn: 如需更多信息请拨此电话号码垂询。

en: to be decided by or to change according to the stated thing
exampleEn: Whether or not we go to Mexico for our holiday depends on the cost.
exampleCn: 我们去不去墨西哥度假取决于成本花费。

en: to be, or to be real
exampleEn: Poverty still exists in this country.
exampleCn: 这个国家仍存在贫困现象。

en: a large group of people who live together in an organized way, making decisions about how to do things and sharing the work that needs to be done. All the people in a country, or in several similar countries, can be referred to as a society
exampleEn: a civilized society

en: something that is made to be sold, usually something that is produced by an industrial process or, less commonly, something that is grown or obtained through farming
exampleEn: I'm trying to cut down on dairy products.
exampleCn: 我正设法减少乳制品的食用量。

en: water that flows naturally along a fixed route formed by a channel cut into rock or ground, usually at ground level
exampleEn: underground streams

en: the group of people who officially control a country
exampleEn: The government is expected to announce its tax proposals today.
exampleCn: 预计今天政府会公布其税收计划。

en: a test done in order to learn something or to discover if something works or is true
exampleEn: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.
exampleCn: 有些人认为应该禁止拿动物做实验。

cn: 给（人、团体或动物）提供食物；喂养
en: to give food to a person, group, or animal
exampleEn: I usually feed the neighbour's cat while she's away.
exampleCn: 邻居不在家时，我经常替她喂猫。

en: the symbol for a number or an amount expressed in numbers
exampleEn: Write the amount in both words and figures.
exampleCn: 请用文字和数字两种形式将数目写出来。

cn: 很可能的，可能要发生的
en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.
exampleEn: I suppose that might happen but it's not very likely.
exampleCn: 我认为那样的事也许会发生，但可能性不大。

en: used in negative sentences instead of "also" or "too"
exampleEn: I don't eat meat and my husband doesn't either.
exampleCn: 我不吃肉，我丈夫也不吃。

cn: 女性的；妇女的；雌的；母的
en: belonging or relating to women, or the sex that can give birth to young or produce eggs
exampleEn: She was voted the best female vocalist.
exampleCn: 她当选最佳女歌手。

en: from, existing in, serving, or responsible for a small area, especially of a country
exampleEn: Our children all go to the local school.
exampleCn: 我们的孩子都在当地的学校上学。

en: looking or being almost, but not exactly, the same
exampleEn: My father and I have similar views on politics.
exampleCn: 我和父亲在政治上观点相似

en: a single piece of information or fact about something
exampleEn: She insisted on telling me every single detail of what they did to her in hospital.
exampleCn: 她坚持要告诉我她在医院遭遇的一切。

en: an expert who studies or works in one of the sciences
exampleEn: a research scientist

en: a way of doing something, especially one that is typical of a person, group of people, place, or period
exampleEn: His office is very utilitarian in style, with no decoration.
exampleCn: 他的办公室在风格上讲究实用，没有任何装饰。

en: for or out of every 100, shown by the symbol %
exampleEn: Only 8 percent of the area is forested.
exampleCn: 这里只有百分之八是丛林地带。

en: to move from side to side, or to make something move like this while holding it in the hand
exampleEn: The corn waved gently in the summer breeze.
exampleCn: 谷物在夏日微风中轻轻摆动。

en: to find information, a place, or an object, especially for the first time
exampleEn: Who discovered America?
exampleCn: 谁发现了美洲？

cn: 主要的；最重要的；最大的
en: larger, more important, or having more influence than others of the same type
exampleEn: The teacher asked me to note down the main points of the speech.
exampleCn: 老师要求我把演说的要点记下来。

en: any regularly repeated arrangement, especially a design made from repeated lines, shapes, or colours on a surface
exampleEn: The curtains had a floral pattern.
exampleCn: 窗帘上有花的图案。

en: in or from the west of a place
exampleEn: California and other western states
exampleCn: 加利福尼亚和其他西部各州

en: the way in which two things are connected
exampleEn: Scientists have established the relationship between lung cancer and smoking.
exampleCn: 科学家们已经证明了肺癌和吸烟之间的联系。

en: to give the effect of being; to be judged to be
exampleEn: I seem to know more about him than anyone else.
exampleCn: 我似乎比其他人更了解他。

cn: 自然环境的；有关环境的
en: relating to the environment
exampleEn: She cares deeply about environmental issues.
exampleCn: 她对环境问题深感担忧。

cn:
①性格，个性；特征

②（电影、戏剧或故事中的）人物，角色
en:
①the particular combination of qualities in a person or place that makes them different from others

②a person represented in a film, play, or story
exampleEn: It would be very out of character of her to lie.
exampleCn: 撒谎可不符合她的个性。

en: a place or position
exampleEn: The hotel is in a beautiful location overlooking the lake.
exampleCn: 该酒店的位置极佳，可以俯瞰整个湖面。

en: to become or to make something become smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc.
exampleEn: Do nuclear weapons really reduce the risk of war?
exampleCn: 核武器真的可以减小战争爆发的危险吗？

en: extremely large in size or amount
exampleEn: They live in a huge house.
exampleCn: 他们住在一所很大的房子里。

cn: （相似或相同事物的）一对，一双，几个；（有某种联系之人的）一对，几个
en: two or a few things that are similar or the same, or two or a few people who are in some way connected
exampleEn: The doctor said my leg should be better in a couple of days.
exampleCn: 医生说我的腿过两天就会好转。

cn:
①起初的，原先的，最早的

②独创的，有创意的，新颖的
en:
①existing since the beginning, or being the earliest form of something

②not the same as anything or anyone else and therefore special and interesting
exampleEn: Is this the original fireplace?
exampleCn: 这是原先的壁炉吗？

en: the group of people together in one place to watch or listen to a play, film, someone speaking, etc.
exampleEn: She lectures to audiences all over the world.
exampleCn: 她向世界各地的听众发表演讲。

cn: 技术（学）；应用技术；工业技术
en: (the study and knowledge of) the practical, especially industrial, use of scientific discoveries
exampleEn: What this country needs is a long-term policy for investment in science and technology.
exampleCn: 这个国家所需要的是科技投入方面的长期政策。

en: to be everywhere around something
exampleEn: Snow-capped mountains surround the city.
exampleCn: 山顶为积雪覆盖的群山环绕着这座城市。

cn: 中心的，中央的；中部的；靠近中心的；核心的
en: in, at, from, or near the centre or most important part of something
exampleEn: Of course, you pay more for premises with a central location.
exampleCn: 当然，位于市中心的房屋就要贵一些。

en: to think or believe something will happen, or someone will arrive
exampleEn: He didn't expect to see me.
exampleCn: 他没有料到会碰见我。

en: a hard substance such as iron, steel, gold, or lead
exampleEn: Copper and gold are both metals.
exampleCn: 铜和金都是金属。

cn:
①做事；采取行动

②演出；扮演，饰演
en:
①to do something for a particular purpose or to solve a problem

②to perform a part in a film, play, etc.
exampleEn: She acted without thinking.
exampleCn: 她不加思索就采取了行动。

en: especially, or more than usual
exampleEn: I didn't particularly want to go, but I had to.
exampleCn: 我并不是特别想去，但我不得不去

en: happening or starting from a short time ago
exampleEn: Is that a recent photo?
exampleCn: 那张照片是最近照的吗？

en: an ability to do an activity or job well, especially because you have practised it
exampleEn: Ruth had great writing skills.
exampleCn: 露丝写作技法纯熟

en: music, art, theatre, literature, etc.
exampleEn: popular culture

en: the act of dealing with customers in a shop, restaurant, or hotel by taking their orders, showing or selling them goods, etc.
exampleEn: The only trouble with this café is that the service is so slow.
exampleCn: 这家咖啡馆唯一的缺点就是服务太慢。

en: a substance, such as water, that is not solid or a gas and that can be poured easily
exampleEn: Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.
exampleCn: 水银在室温下为液体。

en: to speak about something quickly, giving little detail or using few words
exampleEn: My wife mentioned seeing you the other day.
exampleCn: 我妻子提到前几天见到了你。

en: an accepted principle or instruction that states the way things are or should be done, and tells you what you are allowed or are not allowed to do
exampleEn: A referee must know all the rules of the game.
exampleCn: 裁判一定要通晓比赛的所有规则。

en: to be on fire, or to produce flames
exampleEn: The wood was wet and would not burn.
exampleCn: 木头湿了，烧不着。

en: a very small insect that lives under the ground in large and well-organized social groups
exampleEn: The ant is carrying a leaf.
exampleCn: 蚂蚁在搬运叶子。

en: notice, thought, or interest
exampleEn: Ladies and gentlemen, could I have your attention, please?
exampleCn: 女士们、先生们，请大家注意一下好吗？

en: a small, usually round area of colour that is differently coloured or lighter or darker than the surface around it
exampleEn: He had a spot of grease on his tie.
exampleCn: 他的领带上有一小块油渍。

en: the greatest amount, number, or level of something that is either possible or allowed
exampleEn: Is there a limit on the amount of money you can claim?
exampleCn: 你能索赔到的金额有上限吗？

en: provided by the government from taxes to be available to everyone
exampleEn: public funds

en: the amount of space between two places
exampleEn: He travels quite a distance to work every day.
exampleCn: 他每天上班的路途很远。

cn: 知识；学问；学识；了解；理解
en: understanding of or information about a subject that you get by experience or study, either known by one person or by people generally
exampleEn: Her knowledge of English grammar is very extensive.
exampleCn: 她的英语语法知识很广博。

en: one of the four periods of the year; spring, summer, autumn, or winter
exampleEn: Autumn is my favourite season.
exampleCn: 秋季是我最喜欢的季节。

cn: 南方的，南部的；从南面来的
en: in or from the south part of an area
exampleEn: He had developed a slight southern accent.
exampleCn: 他有了一点南方口音。

en: as stated by
exampleEn: According to the forecast, it should brighten up later.
exampleCn: 根据天气预报，晚一点天应该会转晴。

en: a large hole in the side of a hill, cliff or mountain, or one that is underground
exampleEn: She took me by the hand and led me into the cave.
exampleCn: 她抓住我的手，带我进了山洞。

cn:
①价值；价格

②有用性；重要性
en:
①the amount of money that can be received for something

②how useful or important something is
exampleEn: She had already sold everything of value that she possessed.
exampleCn: 她已经把自己所有值钱的东西都卖了。

en: a particular way of doing something
exampleEn: I have a simple and easy method.
exampleCn: 我有个简易的方法。

en: in or from the north part of an area
exampleEn: Joshua Halpern is a native Northern Californian.
exampleCn: 乔舒亚·哈尔彭是土生土长的北加州人。

cn:
①所有物；财产；资产

②属性，性能，特性
en:
①an object or objects that belong to someone

②a quality in a substance or material, especially one that means that it can be used in a particular way
exampleEn: Children need to be taught to have respect for other people's property.
exampleCn: 应该教育孩子尊重他人的财产。

en: one of the seven large land masses on the earth's surface, surrounded, or mainly surrounded, by sea and usually consisting of various countries
exampleEn: Stanley traversed the African continent from west to east.
exampleCn: 斯坦利从西向东横穿非洲大陆。

en: to arrange something or a collection of things so that it can be seen by the public
exampleEn: Family photographs were displayed on the wall.
exampleCn: 墙上挂着家人的照片。

en: to chase and try to catch and kill an animal or bird for food, sport, or profit
exampleEn: Some animals hunt at night.
exampleCn: 有些动物在夜间猎食。

en: people in general, not including yourself
exampleEn: You shouldn't expect others to do your work for you.
exampleCn: 你不应该指望别人替你干活儿。

cn:
①（报纸或杂志上的）文章，报道；论文

②物品，物件；物品的一件
en:
①a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, or on the internet

②a particular thing, especially one that is one of several things of a similar type or in the same place
exampleEn: There was an interesting article on vegetarianism in the paper yesterday.
exampleCn: 昨天报纸上登了一篇关于素食主义的有趣文章。

en: an occasion that allows something to be done
exampleEn: I didn't have a chance to speak to her.
exampleCn: 我没有机会跟她说话。

en: a manager of an organization, company, college, etc.
exampleEn: She has become the director of the new information centre.
exampleCn: 她成为新成立的信息中心主任。

en: to form or have a mental picture or idea of something
exampleEn: Can you imagine how it feels to be blind?
exampleCn: 你能想象失明的感觉吗？

en: something that you remember from the past
exampleEn: I have vivid memories of that evening.
exampleCn: 我对那晚仍记忆犹新。

en: relating to politics
exampleEn: Her political future is in question.
exampleCn: 她的政治前途还是个疑问。

cn:
①作文

②成分；构成；结构
en:
①a short piece of writing about a particular subject, done by a student

②the parts, substances, etc. that something is made of
exampleEn: a 200-word composition

en: written artistic works, especially those with a high and lasting artistic value
exampleEn: He was passionate about all literature.
exampleCn: 他对所有文学作品都有热情。

en: why you do something or why something exists
exampleEn: His only purpose in life seems to be to enjoy himself.
exampleCn: 他生活的唯一目的似乎就是享受。

en: existing or happening independently or in a different physical space
exampleEn: I try to keep meat separate from other food in the fridge.
exampleCn: 我尽量把肉同冰箱里的其他食物分开放。

en: how fast something moves
exampleEn: We drove along at a terrific speed.
exampleCn: 我们以极快的速度驱车行驶。

cn: 有利条件，有利因素；优势；好处
en: a condition giving a greater chance of success
exampleEn: Being tall gave him an advantage over the other players.
exampleCn: 他个子高，比其他运动员有利。

en: the art and practice of designing and making buildings
exampleEn: to study architecture

en: a particular way or direction between places
exampleEn: The route we had planned took us right across Greece.
exampleCn: 我们计划走的路线正好穿过希腊。

en: for that reason
exampleEn: We were unable to get funding and therefore had to abandon the project.
exampleCn: 我们无法筹到资金，因此不得不放弃计划。

en: to use too much of something or use something badly when there is a limited amount of it
exampleEn: Don't waste your money on such junk.
exampleCn: 别在这种垃圾上浪费你的钱。

cn:
①申请，请求

②使用，运用，应用
en:
①to request something, usually officially, especially in writing or by sending in a form

②to make use of something or use it for a practical purpose
exampleEn: Please apply in writing to the address below.
exampleCn: 请将书面申请寄到以下地址。

en: mainly
exampleEn: Recycled materials are mostly of limited use.
exampleCn: 再生材料大多用途有限。

en: following or belonging to the customs or ways of behaving that have continued in a group of people or society for a long time without changing
exampleEn: She's very traditional in her ideas and opinions.
exampleCn: 她这人在思想观念上非常传统。

en: to come near or nearer to something or someone in space, time, quality, or amount
exampleEn: We could just see the train approaching in the distance.
exampleCn: 我们刚好能看到火车从远处驶来。

en: in every way or as much as possible
exampleEn: I agree with you completely.
exampleCn: 我完全同意你的意见。

en: achieving the results wanted or hoped for
exampleEn: a successful operation

en: a subject that is discussed, written about, or studied
exampleEn: He returns to this topic later in the report.
exampleCn: 他在报告中后来又提到这个话题。

en: the land next to or close to the sea
exampleEn: We spent a week on the coast.
exampleCn: 我们在海滨度过了一个星期。

en: the position towards which someone or something moves or faces
exampleEn: They drove away in opposite directions.
exampleCn: 他们朝相反的方向驶去。

en: how good or bad something is
exampleEn: The food was of such poor quality.
exampleCn: 这种食品质量很差。

en: not long ago, or at a time that started not long ago
exampleEn: Have you seen any good films recently?
exampleCn: 你最近看过什么好电影吗？

en: an area, especially one that is different from the areas around it because it has different characteristics or is used for different purposes
exampleEn: This stretch of coast has been designated a danger zone.
exampleCn: 这段海岸已被划定为危险地带。

en: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money there and to allow you to take it out when you need to
exampleEn: I paid the money into my account this morning.
exampleCn: 今天上午我把钱存入了我的账户。

en: the amount or number of something, especially that can be measured
exampleEn: The quantity of chemical pollutants has increased exponentially.
exampleCn: 化学污染物的数量已经急剧上升。

en: a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts
exampleEn: The children played all day in the sand.
exampleCn: 孩子们玩了一整天沙子。

cn: （书、杂志等中区别于图片的）正文，文字材料
en: the written words in a book, magazine, etc., not the pictures
exampleEn: The book has 500 pages of text.
exampleCn: 这本书正文有五百页。

en: an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river running through it
exampleEn: There was snow on the hill tops but not in the valley.
exampleCn: 山顶上有雪，但山谷里没有。

en: to ask yourself questions or express a wish to know about something
exampleEn: He's starting to wonder whether he did the right thing in accepting this job.
exampleCn: 他现在开始怀疑自己接受这份工作是否正确。

cn:
①收费，要价，开价

②（警方）指控，控告
en:
①to ask an amount of money for something, especially a service or activity

②(of the police) to make a formal statement saying that someone is accused of a crime
exampleEn: The local museum doesn't charge for admission.
exampleCn: 当地博物馆不收门票费。

en: to be made of or formed from something
exampleEn: The team consists of four Europeans and two Americans.
exampleCn: 该队由四个欧洲人和两个美国人组成。

cn: 坚决请求，强烈要求；强要
en: to ask for something forcefully, in a way that shows that you do not expect to be refused
exampleEn: I demanded an explanation.
exampleCn: 我需要一个解释。

en: the details or reasons that someone gives to make something clear or easy to understand
exampleEn: Could you give me a quick explanation of how it works?
exampleCn: 你能给我简要说明一下它的工作原理吗？

en: a member of your family
exampleEn: All her close relatives came to the wedding.
exampleCn: 她所有的近亲都来参加她的婚礼了。

en: the set of things that are happening and the conditions that exist at a particular time and place
exampleEn: Her news put me in a difficult situation.
exampleCn: 她的消息让我陷入困难的境地。

cn:
①厚的；粗的；粗壮的

②密的，密集的；茂密的
en:
①having a large distance between two sides

②growing close together and in large amounts
exampleEn: a thick coat

cn:
①举起；抬起；提起

②养育；喂养；种植
en:
①to lift something to a higher position

②to take care of a person, or an animal or plant, until they are completely grown
exampleEn: Would all those in favour please raise their hands?
exampleCn: 赞成的人请举手好吗？

en: a very large sea mammal that breathes air through a hole at the top of its head
exampleEn: A whale was found washed up on the shore.
exampleCn: 一头鲸被发现冲到了岸上。

en: to examine or look for the difference between two or more things
exampleEn: We compared the two reports carefully.
exampleCn: 我们仔细地比较了两个报告。

en: a large area of countryside, especially in relation to its appearance
exampleEn: The landscape is dotted with the tents of campers and hikers.
exampleCn: 乡间散布着宿营者和远足者搭起的帐篷。

cn:
①明白；认识到；意识到

②实现；使变为事实；使发生
en:
①to understand a situation, sometimes suddenly

②to achieve something you were hoping for
exampleEn: They didn't realize the danger they were in.
exampleCn: 他们没有意识到自己身处危险之中。

cn: 移开；拿开；去掉；除去；调动
en: to take something or someone away from somewhere, or off something
exampleEn: The men came to remove the rubbish from the backyard.
exampleCn: 这些人来清除后院的垃圾。

en: an occasion or situation that makes it possible to do something that you want to do or have to do, or the possibility of doing something
exampleEn: Everyone will have an opportunity to comment.
exampleCn: 每个人都有机会发表意见。

en: the action of entertaining other people by dancing, singing, acting, or playing music
exampleEn: She gave a superb performance as Lady Macbeth.
exampleCn: 她出色地扮演了麦克白夫人。

cn: 雕塑，雕刻；塑像，雕塑品，雕刻品
en: the art of forming solid objects that represent a thing, person, idea, etc. out of a material such as wood, clay, metal, or stone, or an object made in this way
exampleEn: Tom teaches sculpture at the local art school.
exampleCn: 汤姆在当地艺校教雕塑。

en: a substance, especially when you do not know or say exactly what it is
exampleEn: There's sticky stuff all over the chair.
exampleCn: 椅子上到处都是黏乎乎的东西。

cn: （位置或水平）较高的；较上的；上层的
en: at a higher position or level than something else, or being the top part of something
exampleEn: The office building's upper floors were being repainted.
exampleCn: 办公楼的上面几层在重新油漆。

en: the distance down either from the top of something to the bottom, or to a distance below the top surface of something
exampleEn: the depth of a lake

cn: （社会或家庭的）一代（人），同代人，同辈人
en: all the people of about the same age within a society or within a particular family
exampleEn: The younger generation smokes less than their parents did.
exampleCn: 年轻的一代比他们父母这一代人吸烟要少。

en: a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time
exampleEn: the wedding scene

en: the act of lifting one foot and putting it down on a different part of the ground, such as when you walk or run
exampleEn: He rose to his feet and took a couple of steps towards her.
exampleCn: 他站起身来，朝她的方向走了几步。

en: very
exampleEn: They played extremely well.
exampleCn: 他们演奏得非常精彩。

en: extremely small
exampleEn: The glass shattered into a thousand tiny pieces.
exampleCn: 玻璃碎成了无数个小碎片。

en: any of the hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its frame
exampleEn: The child was so thin that you could see her bones.
exampleCn: 这孩子瘦得可怜，都能看见她的骨头。

en: dry dirt in the form of powder that covers surfaces inside a building, or very small dry pieces of soil, sand, or other substances
exampleEn: The furniture was covered in dust and cobwebs.
exampleCn: 家具上落满了灰尘和蜘蛛网。

en: being in the middle between an upper and lower amount, size, degree, or value
exampleEn: a girl of medium height
exampleCn: 中等身材的女孩

en: the achieving of the results wanted or hoped for
exampleEn: The success rate for this operation is very low.
exampleCn: 这种手术的成功率非常低。

en: without anything else being involved or in between
exampleEn: Our hotel room was directly above a construction site.
exampleCn: 我们在酒店住的房间就在建筑工地的上方。

en: a period of time that is to come
exampleEn: Sometimes I worry about the future.
exampleCn: 有时候我担心未来。

en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before
exampleEn: Do you recognize this song?
exampleCn: “你听出这首歌来了吗？”

en: the answer to a problem
exampleEn: Do you have an alternative solution?
exampleCn: 你有没有别的解决办法？

en: a substance that is used to provide heat or power, usually by being burned
exampleEn: Wood, coal, oil, petrol, and gas are all different kinds of fuel.
exampleCn: 木材、煤炭、石油、汽油和天然气是不同种类的燃料。

cn: 通常地；主要地；大部分地
en: usually or to a large degree
exampleEn: Oats mainly grow in cool climate.
exampleCn: 燕麦主要生长在气候凉爽的地区。

cn:
①做，进行；施行

②演出，表演
en:
①to do an action or piece of work

②to entertain people by dancing, singing, acting, or playing music
exampleEn: Computers can perform a variety of tasks.
exampleCn: 计算机能执行多项任务。

en: to take some things and leave others
exampleEn: Pick a card from the pack.
exampleCn: 从这纸牌中挑出一张。

en: used when you are giving an average or usual example of a particular thing
exampleEn: Typically, a doctor will see about 30 patients a day.
exampleCn: 医生通常每天要看约三十位病人。

en: to agree to take something
exampleEn: I offered her an apology, but she wouldn't accept it.
exampleCn: 我向她道歉，但是她不接受。

en: a piece of work given to someone, typically as part of their studies or job
exampleEn: I had set myself a tough assignment.
exampleCn: 我给自己定了一项艰巨任务。

en: an object made from a hard material, especially stone or metal, to look like a person or animal
exampleEn: They planned to put up a statue to the president.
exampleCn: 他们计划为总统竖一尊雕像。

en: simple and not complicated, so able to provide the base or starting point from which something can develop
exampleEn: The basic problem is that they don't talk to each other enough.
exampleCn: 根本问题在于他们彼此不怎么说话。

en: the activity in which people talk about something and tell each other their ideas or opinions
exampleEn: The matter is still under discussion.
exampleCn: 这个问题还在讨论之中。

en: to fall or to allow something to fall
exampleEn: She dropped her keys.
exampleCn: 她把钥匙掉了。

en: the act of giving something to someone and them giving you something else
exampleEn: She proposes an exchange of contracts at two o'clock.
exampleCn: 她提议两点钟办理房屋产权过户手续。

en:
①people, especially those of a particular group or type

②modern music and songs that are written in a style similar to that of traditional music
exampleEn: Ordinary folk can't afford cars like that.
exampleCn: 普通人买不起那样的轿车。

en: to keep someone or something safe from injury, damage, or loss
exampleEn: It's important to protect your skin from the harmful effects of the sun.
exampleCn: 保护皮肤不受太阳的伤害是很重要的。

en: a helpful or good effect, or something intended to help
exampleEn: The discovery of oil brought many benefits to the town.
exampleCn: 石油的发现给该镇带来很多利益。

en: a large sea fish that can be eaten
exampleEn: Cod and chips, please.
exampleCn: 请来份鳕鱼薯条。

en: relating to music, art, theatre, literature, etc.
exampleEn: They organized a series of cultural events.
exampleCn: 他们组织了一系列文化活动。

en: a subject or problem that people are thinking and talking about
exampleEn: environmental issues

en: to take the place of something, or to put something or someone in the place of something or someone else
exampleEn: The factory replaced most of its workers with robots.
exampleCn: 这家工厂用机器人取代了大多数工人。

cn: 科学的；应用科学方法的
en: relating to science, or using the organized methods of science
exampleEn: a scientific discovery

en: (of people, things, places, etc.) to pull or draw someone or something towards them, by the qualities they have, especially good ones
exampleEn: The circus is attracting huge audiences.
exampleCn: 马戏团吸引了大批的观众。

en: the things that can be seen behind the main things or people in a picture
exampleEn: The book's cover has white lettering on a blue background.
exampleCn: 书的封面是蓝底白字。

en: (the situation of being faced with) something that needs great mental or physical effort in order to be done successfully and therefore tests a person's ability
exampleEn: You know me - I like a challenge.
exampleCn: 你了解我——我喜欢挑战。

cn: 可供选择的东西；选择范围
en: the range of different things from which you can choose
exampleEn: There wasn't much choice on the menu.
exampleCn: 菜单上供选择的菜品不多。

cn: 清楚的；显然的，明显的；明白的
en: easy to see, recognize, or understand
exampleEn: It's obvious that she doesn't like him.
exampleCn: 显然她不喜欢他。

en: the amount that something or someone weighs
exampleEn: What weight can this lorry safely carry?
exampleCn: 这辆卡车的安全载重量是多少？

en: expected to happen, arrive, etc. at a particular time
exampleEn: The next meeting is due to be held in three months' time.
exampleCn: 下次会议预计将在三个月后召开。

en: the set of necessary tools, clothing, etc. for a particular purpose
exampleEn: Our equipment is top of the range.
exampleCn: 我们的设备是最昂贵的。

en: to be in a particular place
exampleEn: Our office is located in midtown Manhattan.
exampleCn: 我们的办事处位于曼哈顿市中心。

en: to stop something from happening or someone from doing something
exampleEn: A block in the pipe was preventing the water from coming through.
exampleCn: 管子里的一个阻塞物阻止了水流出来。

en: including everything
exampleEn: the total cost

en: An average number is the number you get by adding two or more amounts together and dividing the total by the number of amounts.
exampleEn: average earnings

en: the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money
exampleEn: He's hoping for a career in the police force.
exampleCn: 他希望当一名警察。

en: physical or mental activity needed to achieve something
exampleEn: You should put more effort into your work.
exampleCn: 你应该更加努力地工作。

en: a connection between two people, things, or ideas
exampleEn: There's a direct link between diet and heart disease.
exampleCn: 日常饮食与心脏病有直接的关系。

en: a chance that something may happen or be true
exampleEn: The forecast said that there's a possibility of snow tonight.
exampleCn: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。

en: a path or rough road that is made of soil rather than having a surface covered with stone or other material
exampleEn: The house is at the end of a dirt track.
exampleCn: 房子在一条泥土路的尽头。

en: to move someone or something from one place, vehicle, person, or group to another
exampleEn: We were transferred from one bus into another.
exampleCn: 我们被从一辆大客车转到了另一辆大客车上。

cn: 登广告，做广告，宣传；公布；征聘
en: to make something known generally or in public, especially in order to sell it
exampleEn: We advertised our car in the local newspaper.
exampleCn: 我们在当地报纸上登了广告出售我们的轿车。

en: the writer of a book, article, play, etc.
exampleEn: The author is a seasoned academic.
exampleCn: 作者是位经验丰富的大学教师。

en: easy to recognize because of being seen, met, heard, etc. before
exampleEn: The street was familiar to me.
exampleCn: 这条街我很熟悉。

en: a unit of distance equal to 1,760 yards or 1.6 kilometres
exampleEn: My son hoofs a mile to school each day.
exampleCn: 我的儿子每天步行一英里去上学。

cn: （可看见或可触摸到的）实物，物体
en: a thing that you can see or touch but that is not usually a living animal, plant, or person
exampleEn: Several people reported seeing a strange object in the sky.
exampleCn: 好几个人报告说看见空中有一个奇怪的物体。

cn: 效率高的；有能力的；有效的；生效的
en: working or operating quickly and effectively in an organized way
exampleEn: The city's transport system is one of the most efficient in Europe.
exampleCn: 这座城市的交通系统运行效率很高，在全欧洲名列前茅。

en: extremely large
exampleEn: a giant earth-moving machine

en: to say that an event or action will happen in the future, especially as a result of knowledge or experience
exampleEn: Weather forecasts predict more hot weather, gusty winds, and lightning strikes.
