exampleCn: 气象预报预测将有更多炎热、大风，和雷电天气。

en: If people or things disappear, they go somewhere where they cannot be seen or found.
exampleEn: The sun disappeared behind a cloud.
exampleCn: 太阳躲到了云彩的后面。

en: a small animal that has smooth skin, lives in water and on land, has long powerful back legs with which it jumps from place to place, has no tail, and is usually greenish-brown in colour
exampleEn: Are there any species of frog indigenous to the area?
exampleCn: 这一地区是否有原产的蛙种?

en: a room or building with scientific equipment for doing scientific tests or for teaching science, or a place where chemicals or medicines are produced
exampleEn: Laboratory tests suggest that the new drug may be used to treat cancer.
exampleCn: 实验室测试表明这种新药可用于治疗癌症。

en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents
exampleEn: These words are empty of meaning.
exampleCn: 这些话毫无意义

en: separated by a distance or by time
exampleEn: How far apart should the two tables be?
exampleCn: 两张桌子要相隔多远？

en: a person whose job is to design new buildings and make certain that they are built correctly
exampleEn: The architect is drawing up plans for the new offices.
exampleCn: 建筑师正在绘制新办公楼的设计图。

en: to move air into and out of the lungs
exampleEn: He breathed deeply before speaking again.
exampleCn: 他深深吸一口气，然后继续说下去。

cn: 交流；沟通；交际；传达；传播；通讯
en: the act of communicating with people
exampleEn: Television is an increasingly important means of communication.
exampleCn: 电视是一种日益重要的传播工具。

cn: 逃走，逃脱，逃离；逃避，避开
en: to get free from something, or to avoid something
exampleEn: A lion has escaped from its cage.
exampleCn: 一头狮子逃出了兽笼。

en: really or certainly, often used to emphasize something
exampleEn: Evidence suggests that errors may indeed be occurring.
exampleCn: 证据表明可能确实出错了。

en: to open the mouth wide and take a lot of air into the lungs and slowly send it out, usually when tired or bored
exampleEn: I can't stop yawning - I must be tired.
exampleCn: 我一个劲儿打哈欠——肯定是累了。

en: an open, round container shaped like a bowl with sloping sides, used for holding food or liquid
exampleEn: The water in the basin is spilling over, but there is no one in the washroom.
exampleCn: 洗脸盆里的水都溢出来了，但盥洗室里一个人也没有。

en: the food and drink usually eaten or drunk by a person or group
exampleEn: Diet varies between different countries in the world.
exampleCn: 世界各国的饮食各不相同。

en: more than average, but less than very
exampleEn: I'm fairly sure that this is the right address.
exampleCn: 我相当肯定这个地址没错。

en: a piece of writing in which the words are arranged in separate lines, often ending in rhyme, and are chosen for their sound and for the images and ideas they suggest
exampleEn: The poet recited some of her recent poems.
exampleCn: 诗人朗诵了她最近写的几首诗。

en: the natural outer layer that covers a person, animal, fruit, etc.
exampleEn: dark skin

en: a substance made from a plant, used to give a special flavour to food
exampleEn: Spices are widely used in South Asian cooking.
exampleCn: 南亚菜中广泛使用各种调味香料。

en: one of the parts of a tree that grows out from the main trunk and has leaves, flowers, or fruit on it
exampleEn: Leafy branches

en: to put something into a hole in the ground and cover it
exampleEn: The dog had buried its bone in the garden.
exampleCn: 狗把骨头埋在花园里。

en: (a feeling of) not being certain about something, especially about how good or true it is
exampleEn: I'm having doubts about his ability to do the job.
exampleCn: 我对他是否能胜任此项工作还有一些疑问。

en: extremely large
exampleEn: The main bedroom is enormous.
exampleCn: 主卧室大极了。

en: level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts
exampleEn: An ice rink needs to be completely flat.
exampleCn: 溜冰场地必须十分平坦。

en: needed in order to achieve a particular result
exampleEn: He lacks the necessary skills for the job.
exampleCn: 他不具备做这项工作所需的技能。

cn: 朴素的；不加修饰的；简单的
en: not decorated in any way; with nothing added
exampleEn: She wore a plain black dress.
exampleCn: 她穿着一件朴素的黑色连衣裙。

en: any large or small living thing that can move independently
exampleEn: Rainforests are filled with amazing creatures.
exampleCn: 雨林中满是奇异的生灵。

en: a choice that you make about something after thinking about several possibilities
exampleEn: She has had to make some very difficult decisions.
exampleCn: 她必须要做出一些困难的决定。

en: the outer or furthest point of something
exampleEn: They built the church on the edge of the village.
exampleCn: 他们把教堂建在了村边。

en: an aim or purpose
exampleEn: You need to set yourself some long-term goals .
exampleCn: 你得为自己订一些长期目标。

en: not far away
exampleEn: I noticed a policeman standing nearby.
exampleCn: 我注意到有一名警察站在近旁。

en: If you normally do something, you usually or regularly do it.
exampleEn: She doesn't normally arrive until ten.
exampleCn: 她通常不到十点不会来。

en: any of various types of container, usually round, especially one used for cooking food
exampleEn: Fill a large pot with salted water and bring it to the boil.
exampleCn: 用一个大壶装满盐水并煮开。

en: to look somewhere carefully in order to find something
exampleEn: The police searched the woods for the missing boy.
exampleCn: 警察在树林中搜寻失踪的男孩。

en: the flat part of the body that a bird, insect, or bat uses for flying, or one of the flat, horizontal structures that stick out from the side of an aircraft and support it when it is flying
exampleEn: I don't like chicken wings - there's not much meat on them.
exampleCn: 我不喜欢吃鸡翅——上面没有多少肉。

cn: 通道；途径；（接近某地或某人的）机会（或方法）；（使用某物的）权利
en: the method or possibility of getting near to a place or person
exampleEn: The only access to the village is by boat.
exampleCn: 到那个村子去的唯一方法是乘船。

cn:
①（公开）露面

②外表，外观；外貌；样子
en:
①an occasion when someone appears in public

②the way a person or thing looks to other people
exampleEn: It was his first appearance on television/television appearance as president.
exampleCn: 这是他就任总统以来首次在电视上亮相。

en: to try to do something, especially something difficult
exampleEn: He attempted to escape through a window.
exampleCn: 他企图跳窗逃跑。

en: communication with someone, especially by speaking or writing to them regularly
exampleEn: There isn't enough contact between teachers and parents.
exampleCn: 老师和家长间联系不够。

en: not expecting good things, or likely to consider only the bad side of a situation
exampleEn: a negative attitude

cn: 清楚地；明白地；显而易见地
en: in a way that is easy to understand or see
exampleEn: He was in tears and obviously very upset.
exampleCn: 他泪流满面，显然很难过。

en: happening repeatedly over a period of time
exampleEn: He suffers periodic mental breakdowns.
exampleCn: 他周期性地精神失常。

cn:
①位置，方位，地点

②处境，状况
en:
①the place where something or someone is, often in relation to other things

②a situation
exampleEn: You've moved the furniture around - the sofa is in a different position.
exampleCn: 你把家具移动过了——沙发的位置变了。

cn:
①负有责任的

②负责的
en:
① If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

②If you are responsible for something, it is your job or duty to deal with it and make decisions relating to it.
exampleEn: He still felt responsible for her death.
exampleCn: 他依然觉得对她的死负有责任。

en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.
exampleEn: She tried her best to solve the problem.
exampleCn: 她尽了最大的努力解决这个问题。

en: everything that exists, especially all physical matter, including all the stars, planets, galaxies, etc. in space
exampleEn: Is there intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?
exampleCn: 宇宙中其他地方存在有智慧的生命吗？

cn:
①一年一度的；每年的

②一年的
en:
①happening once every year

②relating to a period of one year
exampleEn: an annual event

en: to stay away from someone or something
exampleEn: I left early to avoid the rush hour.
exampleCn: 我早早动身以避开交通高峰时刻。

en: the distance from the top to the bottom of something, or the quality of being tall
exampleEn: The sheer height of New York's skyscrapers is so impressive.
exampleCn: 纽约的摩天大楼光高度就气势非凡。

en: someone who is skilled in playing music, usually as a job
exampleEn: That musician is very famous.
exampleCn: 那位音乐家非常有名。

en: damage caused to water, air, etc. by harmful substances or waste
exampleEn: The company claims it is not responsible for the pollution in the river.
exampleCn: 这家公司声称他们对这条河的污染没有责任。

en: only for one person or group and not for everyone
exampleEn: I caught him looking through my private papers.
exampleCn: 我撞见他在翻阅我的私人文件。

cn:
①申请；请求

②用途，用法；应用
en:
①an official request for something, usually in writing

②a way in which something can be used for a particular purpose
exampleEn: a letter of application

en: to harm or spoil something
exampleEn: Smoking is likely to damage your health permanently.
exampleCn: 吸烟有可能永久地损害你的健康。

en: to become less, or to make something become less
exampleEn: We have decreased our involvement in children's books.
exampleCn: 我们减少了我们对于儿童读物的参与。

en: to damage something so badly that it cannot be used
exampleEn: Most of the old part of the city was destroyed by bombs during the war.
exampleCn: 该城的大部分老城区都在战争中被炸毁了。

en: the fact of not being easy to do or understand
exampleEn: We finished the job, but only with great difficulty.
exampleCn: 我们非常艰难地完成了工作。

en: in great detail, or complete, correct, or true in every way
exampleEn: She gave an exact description of the attacker.
exampleCn: 她对袭击者的特征作了精确的描述。

cn: 合理的；公平的；公正的；平等待人的
en: treating someone in a way that is right or reasonable, or treating a group of people equally and not allowing personal opinions to influence your judgment
exampleEn: a fair trial

en: connected with studying or representing things from the past
exampleEn: The building is of historical importance.
exampleCn: 这栋建筑有重要的历史研究价值。

en: to make information available to people, especially in a book, magazine, or newspaper, or to produce and sell a book, magazine, or newspaper
exampleEn: She's just had an article published in their weekend supplement.
exampleCn: 她刚在他们周末版的增刊上发表了一篇文章。

cn: 稀少的；罕见的；不常发生的
en: not common; very unusual
exampleEn: The museum is full of rare and precious treasures.
exampleCn: 这家博物馆里收藏的满是奇珍异宝。

en: serious attention, especially to the details of a situation or thing
exampleEn: You need to take a bit more care with your spelling.
exampleCn: 你得多注意一下你的拼写。

cn:
①赊购，赊账，信用贷款

②学分
en:
①a method of paying for goods or services at a later time, usually paying interest as well as the original money

②a unit that represents a successfully finished part of an educational course
exampleEn: They decided to buy the car on credit.
exampleCn: 他们决定用赊购的方法买那辆汽车。

cn: （某个地区的）东部的；来自东部的
en: in or from the east part of an area
exampleEn: The eastern part of the country is very mountainous.
exampleCn: 这个国家的东部地区多山。

en:
①to repair something

②to fasten something in position so that it cannot move
exampleEn: They couldn't fix my old computer, so I bought a new one.
exampleCn: 他们修不好我的旧电脑了，所以我买了台新的。

en: the number of times something happens within a particular period, or the fact of something happening often or a large number or times
exampleEn: Complaints about the frequency of buses rose in the last year.
exampleCn: 去年对公车发车频率的投诉增长了。

cn: 法，法律；法律制度，法律体系
en: a rule, usually made by a government, that is used to order the way in which a society behaves
exampleEn: There are laws against drinking in the street.
exampleCn: 有法律禁止在街上喝酒。

en: poems in general as a form of literature
exampleEn: She started writing poetry at a young age.
exampleCn: 她年纪很小就开始写诗了。

cn: 有权力的；有力量的；强大的
en: having a lot of power to control people and events
exampleEn: The president is more powerful than the prime minister.
exampleCn: 总统比总理权力更大。

en: to push something firmly, often without causing it to move permanently further away from you
exampleEn: Press down firmly on the lever.
exampleCn: 用力向下压杠杆。

en: severe in effect; bad
exampleEn: a serious illness

en: the resting state in which the body is not active and the mind is unconscious
exampleEn: I must get some sleep - I'm exhausted.
exampleCn: 我必须睡一会儿——我太累了。

en: to succeed in finishing something or reaching an aim, especially after a lot of work or effort
exampleEn: She finally achieved her ambition to visit South America.
exampleCn: 她终于实现了去南美洲旅游的梦想。

cn: 令人惊诧的，惊人的；令人惊喜的
en: extremely surprising
exampleEn: This stain remover really works - it's amazing!
exampleCn: 这种去污剂很有效——真想不到！

en: very wide
exampleEn: We walked down a broad avenue lined with trees.
exampleCn: 我们走在林荫大道上。

en: relating to general weather conditions
exampleEn: Some parts of the world seem to be experiencing climatic changes.
exampleCn: 世界上一些地区似乎正在经历气候变化。

cn: （小麦、玉米、燕麦、大麦等）谷物，谷粒
en: (the seeds of) plants, such as wheat, maize, oats, and barley, that can be used to produce flour
exampleEn: A surplus of corn has helped depress the grain market.
exampleCn: 玉米过剩帮助压低了谷物市场。

cn: 紧张；压力；造成紧张的因素
en: great worry caused by a difficult situation, or something that causes this condition
exampleEn: Yoga is a very effective technique for combating stress.
exampleCn: 练瑜伽是舒缓压力的非常有效的方法。

en: quickly and unexpectedly
exampleEn: I suddenly realized what I'd said, but it was too late.
exampleCn: 我突然意识到自己说了什么，不过为时已晚。

en: problems or difficulties
exampleEn: The tax forms were complicated and I had a lot of trouble with them.
exampleCn: 这张税务表格十分复杂，我填起来很费劲。

cn: 更远地，在更大程度上；进一步地
en: to a greater distance or degree, or at a more advanced level
exampleEn: The issue needs further examination.
exampleCn: 这个问题需要进一步考察。

en: the quality of being important
exampleEn: The health report stresses the importance of fresh food in a diet.
exampleCn: 健康报告强调了饮食中新鲜食物的重要性。

en: a thought or belief about something or someone
exampleEn: What's your opinion about the matter?
exampleCn: 你对这件事有什么看法？

cn: 以某种方法，以某种方式
en: in a way or by some means that is not known or not stated
exampleEn: It won't be easy, but we'll get across the river somehow.
exampleCn: 过河不是件容易的事，但我们总会有办法的。

en: acceptable or right for someone or something
exampleEn: The film is not suitable for children.
exampleCn: 这部电影不适宜儿童观看。

en: without taking any notice of or being influenced by; not prevented by
exampleEn: I still enjoyed the week despite the weather.
exampleCn: 尽管天气不好，这一周我过得还是很愉快的。

en: a large amount of water covering an area that is usually dry
exampleEn: After the flood it took weeks for the water level to go down.
exampleCn: 洪水过去几个星期后，水位才回落。

en: a group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose
exampleEn: the World Health Organization

cn: 建设性的；积极的；怀有希望的
en: full of hope and confidence, or giving cause for hope and confidence
exampleEn: a positive attitude

en: having a surface or consisting of a substance that is perfectly regular and has no holes, lumps, or areas that rise or fall suddenly
exampleEn: a smooth surface

en: completely
exampleEn: I totally agree with you.
exampleCn: 我完全同意你的看法。

cn:
①值钱的，贵重的

②有用的；重要的；有价值的
en:
①worth a lot of money

②Valuable information, advice, etc. is very helpful or important
exampleEn: This is losing valuable business for the company.
exampleCn: 这是在使公司损失价值可观的生意。

en: to use physical force to try to defeat another person or group of people
exampleEn: There were children fighting in the playground.
exampleCn: 当时操场上有些孩子在打架。

en: not taking help or money from other people
exampleEn: I've always been financially independent.
exampleCn: 在经济上我一直自食其力。

cn:
①全然不同的，迥异的，截然相反的

②另一边的，相反的，对面的
en:
①completely different

②being in a position on the other side; facing
exampleEn: Police attempts to calm the violence had the opposite effect.
exampleCn: 警方试图平息暴力活动，却适得其反。

en: relating or belonging to a single or particular person rather than to a group or an organization
exampleEn: Her uncle takes a personal interest in her progress.
exampleCn: 她叔叔个人很关心她的进步。

en: happening or existing before something or someone else
exampleEn: Training is provided, so no previous experience is required for the job.
exampleCn: 这项工作提供培训，因此不要求以前有相关经验。

en: before the present time or the time referred to
exampleEn: She was previously employed as a tour guide.
exampleCn: 她以前受聘当导游。

en: to raise someone to a higher or more important position or rank
exampleEn: She's just been promoted to senior sales rep.
exampleCn: 她刚刚被提升为高级销售代表。

en: to show that something is true
exampleEn: They proved him guilty.
exampleCn: 他们证明他是有罪的。

cn:
①敬重；尊重；注重；重视

②方面；细节
en:
①admiration felt or shown for someone or something that you believe has good ideas or qualities

②a particular feature or detail
exampleEn: You really should treat your parents with more respect.
exampleCn: 你待你父母真应该多几分尊重。

en: to hit or attack someone or something forcefully or violently
exampleEn: My golf was terrible today - I just didn't strike the ball well.
exampleCn: 我今天高尔夫打得很糟糕——我就是击不好球。

en: the flavour of something, or the ability of a person or animal to recognize different flavours
exampleEn: I love the taste of garlic.
exampleCn: 我喜欢蒜味。

en: to put your hand or another part of your body lightly onto and off something or someone
exampleEn: He touched the girl on the arm to get her attention.
exampleCn: 他碰了碰女孩的胳膊以引起她的注意。

en: showing all the characteristics that you would usually expect from a particular group of things
exampleEn: I must look like the typical tourist with my shorts and my camera.
exampleCn: 穿着短裤，带着相机，我看上去一定像个典型的游客。

en: a person with a high level of knowledge or skill relating to a particular subject or activity
exampleEn: My mother is an expert at dress-making.
exampleCn: 我妈妈做裁缝活可是行家。

en: to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink
exampleEn: An empty bottle will float.
exampleCn: 空瓶子能浮起来。

en: to design and/or create something that has never been made before
exampleEn: Who invented the steam engine?
exampleCn: 谁发明了蒸汽机

en: a thin, flat, often square piece of hard material such as wood, stone, or metal
exampleEn: The poem was engraved on a tablet of stone.
exampleCn: 这首诗刻在了一块石匾上。

en: a medium-sized road vehicle, used especially for carrying goods, that often has no windows in the sides at the back
exampleEn: There was a series of explosions and the van burst into flames.
exampleCn: 发生了一系列爆炸，货车起火。

en: having a particular value, especially in money
exampleEn: Our house is worth £200,000.
exampleCn: 我们的房子价值约二十万英镑。

en: a yellow and black flying insect that makes honey and can sting you
exampleEn: A swarm of bees flew into the garden.
exampleCn: 一群蜜蜂飞进花园。

cn: 教练；辅导老师；私人教师；家庭教师
en: someone whose job is to teach people to improve at a sport, skill, or school subject
exampleEn: maths coach

en: to join or be joined with something else
exampleEn: Can I connect my printer to your computer?
exampleCn: 我能把我的打印机连在你的计算机上吗？

en: play in a theatre or on television or radio, or plays and acting generally
exampleEn: She's starred in several TV dramas.
exampleCn: 她演过几部电视剧。

cn: 教育；受教育获得的知识
en: the process of teaching or learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this
exampleEn: As a child he received most of his education at home.
exampleCn: 童年时他主要在家中接受教育。

en: a person or an animal that hunts animals for food or for sport
exampleEn: Animals in the cat family are hunters.
exampleCn: 猫科动物都是捕食动物。

en: something that is part of a list or group of things
exampleEn: The most valuable item on show will be a Picasso drawing.
exampleCn: 展览中最有价值的作品将是毕加索的一幅画。

en: one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined at one end to the stem or branch
exampleEn: The trees are in leaf early this year.
exampleCn: 今年树木的叶子长得早。

en: used after an order or suggestion to show what the result will be if you do not follow that order or suggestion
exampleEn: I'd better write it down, otherwise I'll forget it.
exampleCn: 我最好把它写下来，否则我会忘了的。

en: relating to architecture
exampleEn: architectural drawings
exampleCn: 建筑图纸

en: unable to see
exampleEn: She's been blind since birth.
exampleCn: 她天生失明。

en: a light bulb
exampleEn: Edison's most well-known inventions included the electric light bulb.
exampleCn: 爱迪生最著名的发明包括电灯泡。

en: to forgive someone
exampleEn: Please excuse me for arriving late - the bus was delayed.
exampleCn: 我来晚了，请原谅——公共汽车晚点了。

en: completely
exampleEn: Have you fully recovered from your illness?
exampleCn: 你完全康复了吗？

en: a person in control of a group, country, or situation
exampleEn: He's a natural leader.
exampleCn: 他天生就是个领导。

en: a flash of bright light in the sky that is produced by electricity moving between clouds or from clouds to the ground
exampleEn: That tree was struck by lightning.
exampleCn: 那棵树被闪电击中了。

cn:
①成功做到，胜利完成

②管理，掌管；经营
en:
①to succeed in doing or dealing with something, especially something difficult

②to be responsible for controlling or organizing someone or something, especially a business or employees
exampleEn: I only just managed to finish on time.
exampleCn: 我勉强按时完成。

en: to make arrangements for something to happen
exampleEn: They organized a meeting between the teachers and students.
exampleCn: 他们组织了一次师生会议。

en: someone who owns something
exampleEn: Are you the owner of this car?
exampleCn: 你是这辆车的车主吗？

en: a person who writes books or articles to be published
exampleEn: She is a well-known writer of children's books.
exampleCn: 她是一位知名的儿童文学作家。

cn:
①争论；争吵；争辩；争执

②理由，论据，论点；论证，说理
en:
①a disagreement, or the process of disagreeing

②a reason or reasons why you support or oppose an idea or suggestion, or the process of explaining these reasons
exampleEn: The children had an argument about what game to play.
exampleCn: 孩子们为了玩哪个游戏吵了起来。

en: a sea mammal that is large, smooth, and grey, with a long, pointed mouth
exampleEn: Dolphins sometimes play in the wake of the boats.
exampleCn: 有时海豚在船的尾流中嬉戏。

en: often
exampleEn: I see him frequently.
exampleCn: 我和他见面非常频繁。

en: something that has never been made before, or the process of creating something that has never been made before
exampleEn: The world changed rapidly after the invention of the phone.
exampleCn: 电话发明后世界的变化日新月异。

en: the measurement of something from end to end or along its longest side
exampleEn: The boat is ten metres in length.
exampleCn: 这条船长十米。

en: being the largest amount or number allowed or possible
exampleEn: maximum speed

en: any imaginary frightening creature, especially one that is large and strange
exampleEn: A hideous monster attacked the helpless villagers.
exampleCn: 有个丑恶的怪物袭击了手无寸铁的村民。

cn: 神秘的事物，难以理解的事物，谜
en: something strange or not known that has not yet been explained or understood
exampleEn: His past is enveloped in a shroud of mystery.
exampleCn: 他过去的经历笼罩着神秘气氛。

en: a large group of musicians who play many different instruments together and are led by a conductor
exampleEn: She's a cellist in the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra.
exampleCn: 她是伯明翰交响乐团的大提琴手。

en: lasting for a long time or for ever
exampleEn: She is looking for a permanent place to stay.
exampleCn: 她正在寻找一个固定的住所。

en: movement to an improved or more developed state, or to a forward position
exampleEn: Technological progress has been so rapid over the last few years.
exampleCn: 在最近几年中，科技进步如此迅猛。

cn: 分拣收集（垃圾）用于回收再用
en: to sort and collect rubbish in order to treat it and produce useful materials that can be used again
exampleEn: The Japanese recycle more than half their waste paper.
exampleCn: 日本人将一半以上的废纸回收利用。

cn: 有创造力的；创造性的；有创意的
en: producing or using original and unusual ideas
exampleEn: She has been described as the creative colossus of the literary world.
exampleCn: 她被描述为文学界的创造力巨人。

en: to make someone more likely to do something, or to make something more likely to happen
exampleEn: We were encouraged to learn foreign languages at school.
exampleCn: 在校时，学校鼓励我们学习外语。

en: necessary or needed
exampleEn: Water is essential for living things.
exampleCn: 水对于生物来说是必不可少的。

en: an amount of money given especially by the government to a person or organization for a special purpose
exampleEn: They awarded her a grant to study abroad for one year.
exampleCn: 他们授予她一笔奖学金供她出国留学一年。

en: a part of an object designed for holding, moving, or carrying the object easily
exampleEn: a door handle

en: an empty space in an object, usually with an opening to the object's surface, or an opening that goes completely through an object
exampleEn: We dug a hole and planted the tree.
exampleCn: 我们挖了个坑栽下了那棵树。

cn: （车辆不得入内的）商业街，购物中心
en: a large, usually covered, shopping area where cars are not allowed
exampleEn: There are plans to build a new mall in the middle of town.
exampleCn: 计划在市中心建一个新的购物中心。

en: a friend
exampleEn: We've been mates since our school days.
exampleCn: 我们从学生时代起就是朋友。

en: a long printed story about imaginary characters and events
exampleEn: His latest novel is selling really well.
exampleCn: 他的最新小说非常畅销。

en: the smallest unit of money in the UK, of which there are 100 in a pound, or a small coin worth this much. You use "pence" or, more informally, "p" when you are talking about the units of money and pennies when you are talking about the coins themselves.
exampleEn: Could you lend me 50 pence please?
exampleCn: 你能借给我五十便士吗？

en: to allow something
exampleEn: The regulations do not permit much flexibility.
exampleCn: 这些规章不允许有太大的灵活性。

en: (the state of having) enough or more than enough, or a large amount
exampleEn: We've got plenty of time before we need to leave for the airport.
exampleCn: 去机场前我们有的是时间。

en: to put information, especially your name, into an official list or record
exampleEn: I registered the car in my name.
exampleCn: 我把车登记在我的名下。

cn: 可信赖的；可靠的；真实可信的
en: Someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or believed because he, she, or it works or behaves well in the way you expect.
exampleEn: reliable information

cn: （电视或广播节目的）录制室，演播室；（音乐）录音棚
en: a room with special equipment where television or radio programmes or music recordings are made
exampleEn: She spent three months in the studio working on her latest album.
exampleCn: 她在录音棚里呆了三个月录制自己的最新专辑。

en: a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions
exampleEn: This temple is a place of great holiness for the religion's followers.
exampleCn: 这座寺庙对宗教信徒来说是非常神圣的地方。

en: the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it
exampleEn: This is an area of outstanding natural beauty.
exampleCn: 这个地方自然风景极其优美。

en: a group of objects of one type that have been collected by one person or in one place
exampleEn: I have a valuable stamp collection.
exampleCn: 我有一个珍贵的邮票收藏品。

en: in a way that is not the same
exampleEn: Boys and girls may behave differently.
exampleCn: 男孩儿和女孩儿的表现可能不同。

cn:
①（数量、大小）相同的，相等的

②（地位、待遇）平等的，同等的
en:
①the same in amount, number, or size

②the same in importance and deserving the same treatment
exampleEn: two pieces of wood equal in length
exampleCn: 两块长度相同的木头

en: someone who is in charge of making a film
exampleEn: He was acclaimed as America's greatest filmmaker.
exampleCn: 他被赞誉为美国最伟大的电影制片人。

cn: 沒有一个（人或事物）；全无
en: not one, or not any
exampleEn: None of my children have blonde hair.
exampleCn: 我的孩子们的头发都不是金色。

en: the direction that is between north and west
exampleEn: We live in the northwest of the city.
exampleCn: 我们住在城市的西北方向。

cn: 普通的，平常的；平凡的；一般的
en: not different or special or unexpected in any way; usual
exampleEn: Her last concert appearance in Britain was no ordinary performance.
exampleCn: 她在英国的最后一场音乐会不同凡响。

en: not mixed with anything else
exampleEn: a pure cotton shirt

en: relating to love or a close loving relationship
exampleEn: a romantic novel

en: a medium-sized silver-coloured fish that lives in the sea or rivers and swims up rivers to produce its eggs. Its pink flesh is eaten as a food.
exampleEn: salmon fishing

en: the study of the relationships between people living in groups, especially in industrial societies
exampleEn: She has a degree in sociology and politics.
exampleCn: 她拥有社会学和政治学学位。

en: a thin piece of wood or other material
exampleEn: Find some dry sticks and we'll make a campfire.
exampleCn: 找些干树枝，我们来点堆篝火。

en: except if
exampleEn: You can't get a job unless you have experience.
exampleCn: 除非有工作经验，否则你找不到工作。

en: not physically strong
exampleEn: She is still weak after her illness.
exampleCn: 她病后仍然虚弱。

en: to go to an event, place, etc.
exampleEn: Over two hundred people attended the funeral.
exampleCn: 两百多人参加了葬礼。

en: an artificial river built for boats to travel along or to take water from one area to another
exampleEn: the Panama Canal

en: to persuade someone or make someone certain
exampleEn: He managed to convince the jury of his innocence.
exampleCn: 他使陪审团相信他是无辜的。

en: to have someone work or do a job for you and pay them for it
exampleEn: How many people does your company employ?
exampleCn: 你们公司雇有多少员工？

en: relating to money or how money is managed
exampleEn: She organizes her financial affairs very efficiently.
exampleCn: 她把她的财务事项管理的非常高效。

en: having a small distance from one side to the other, especially in comparison with the length
exampleEn: The little village has very narrow streets.
exampleCn: 小村子里的街道很窄。

en: to some degree, but not completely
exampleEn: His attractiveness is partly due to his self-confidence.
exampleCn: 他的魅力部分源于他的自信。

en: the belief in and worship of a god or gods, or any such system of belief and worship
exampleEn: the Christian religion

en: to want to do something
exampleEn: As you wish, Sir. It will be done.
exampleCn: 只要是您想要这样，先生。我们一定会去做。

en: completely
exampleEn: I trusted him absolutely.
exampleCn: 我绝对信任他。

en: correct, exact, and without any mistakes
exampleEn: We hope to become more accurate in predicting earthquakes.
exampleCn: 我们希望能更准确地预报地震。

cn:
①买得起；有时间做，能做

②提供；给予
en:
①to be able to buy or do something because you have enough money or time

②to provide sb with sth
exampleEn: Few people are able to afford cars like that.
exampleCn: 很少有人买得起那样的车。

en: living, not dead
exampleEn: Doctors kept him alive on a life-support machine.
exampleCn: 医生使用生命维持机来维持他的生命。

en: one of the parts that a book is divided into
exampleEn: Read Chapter 10 before class tomorrow.
exampleCn: 明天上课前阅读第十章。

en: thread or cloth made from the fibres of the cotton plant
exampleEn: a shirt made of pure cotton

en: the end of life
exampleEn: The disease causes thousands of deaths a year.
exampleCn: 疾病导致每年有成千上万的死亡。

en: to break up and move soil using a tool, a machine, or your hands
exampleEn: Digging in the garden is good exercise.
exampleCn: 在花园里挖土是一种很好的锻炼。

en: to (cause to) separate into parts or groups
exampleEn: After the Second World War Germany was divided into two separate countries.
exampleCn: 第二次世界大战之后，德国被分成了两个独立的国家。

en: towards the direction that is in front of you
exampleEn: She leaned forward to whisper something in my ear.
exampleCn: 她倾身向前，对我耳语了一番。

en: to get something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time
exampleEn: What do you hope to gain from the course?
exampleCn: 你希望从这门课程中学到些什么？

en: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried
exampleEn: He visits his mother's grave every Sunday.
exampleCn: 他每个星期天都去他母亲墓上祭奠。

en: something that you do often and regularly, sometimes without knowing that you are doing it
exampleEn: I always buy the same brand of toothpaste out of habit.
exampleCn: 我出于习惯总是买同一个牌子的牙膏。

cn: 愿意帮忙的；有帮助的，有用的
en: willing to help, or useful
exampleEn: She's such a pleasant, helpful child!
exampleCn: 她可真是个招人喜欢又乐于助人的孩子！

en: a person who is admired for having done something very brave or having achieved something great
exampleEn: He became a national hero for his part in the revolution.
exampleCn: 他因在革命中所起的作用而成为民族英雄。

en: to put something or someone in a place where that thing or person cannot be seen or found, or to put yourself somewhere where you cannot be seen or found
exampleEn: She used to hide her diary under her pillow.
exampleCn: 她过去常把自己的日记藏在枕头下。

en: the ability to form pictures in the mind
exampleEn: My younger son has a very vivid imagination.
exampleCn: 我的小儿子想象力很丰富。

en: one thing that can be chosen from a set of possibilities, or the freedom to make a choice
exampleEn: The best option would be to cancel the trip altogether.
exampleCn: 最好的选择是彻底取消这次行程。

en: in an accurate way
exampleEn: You need to hit the ball accurately.
exampleCn: 你必须准确击球。

en: close to a particular number or time although not exactly that number or time
exampleEn: The journey took approximately seven hours.
exampleCn: 旅程大约花了七个小时。

en: someone who helps someone else to do a job
exampleEn: an administrative assistant

en: in addition to; also
exampleEn: Do you play any other sports besides basketball?
exampleCn: 除了篮球外，你还从事别的体育活动吗？

en: the opinion you have after considering all the information about something
exampleEn: Did you draw any conclusions at the meeting this morning?
exampleCn: 今天上午的会议上你们有没有作出什么决定？

en: (an) illness of people, animals, plants, etc., caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident
exampleEn: The first symptom of the disease is a very high temperature.
exampleCn: 这种病的最初症状是高烧。

en: relating to electricity
exampleEn: The company is a world leader in electrical goods.
exampleCn: 这家公司的电器产品在全世界首屈一指。

en: an amount of money paid for a particular piece of work or for a particular right or service
exampleEn: We couldn't pay the lawyer's fee.
exampleCn: 我们付不起律师费。

en: a border that surrounds and supports a picture, door, or window
exampleEn: The painting was presented in a gilt picture frame.
exampleCn: 这幅画装在一个镀金的画框里。

en: happening often
exampleEn: He is a frequent visitor to this country.
exampleCn: 他常常访问这个国家。

cn: （艺术作品）陈列馆；美术馆；画廊
en: a room or building that is used forshowing works of art, sometimes so that they can be sold
exampleEn: The art galleries of Florence are very famous.
exampleCn: 佛罗伦萨的画廊非常有名。

en: a piece of equipment that is used to cause liquid, air, or gas to move from one place to another
exampleEn: The pump is powered by a small electric motor.
exampleCn: 这个泵由一个小电动机驱动。

en: to get back something lost or spent
exampleEn: She went into a coma and died without recovering consciousness.
exampleCn: 她陷入昏迷后再也没有醒过来。

en: to make someone think of something they have forgotten or might have forgotten
exampleEn: Could you remind Paul about dinner on Saturday?
exampleCn: 你能否提醒一下保罗周六晚宴的事？

cn:
①水库；蓄水池

②储备；储藏；宝库
en:
①a place for storing liquid, especially a natural or artificial lake providing water for a city or other area

②a large supply of something
exampleEn: Torrents of water gushed into the reservoir.
exampleCn: 急流涌进了水库。

en: covered with sand or containing sand
exampleEn: sandy soil

en: to (cause something or someone to) go down below the surface or to the bottom of a liquid or soft substance
exampleEn: The boat was beginning to sink fast.
exampleCn: 那艘船开始迅速下沉。

en: in front
exampleEn: The road ahead is very busy.
exampleCn: 前面路上很拥挤。

en: to plan, prepare for, or organize something
exampleEn: The meeting has been arranged for Wednesday.
exampleCn: 会议已经安排在了周三。

cn: 系，绑；连接；使附着；附上；固定
en: to fasten, join, or connect something
exampleEn: I attached a photo to my application form.
exampleCn: 我在我的申请表上贴了一张照片。

en: a type of dancing where carefully organized movements tell a story or express an idea, or a theatre work that uses this type of dancing
exampleEn: a ballet dancer

en: a very small insect
exampleEn: We noticed tiny bugs that were all over the walls.
exampleCn: 我们发现墙上爬满了小虫。

en: a space surrounded on all sides by bars or wire, in which animals or birds are kept
exampleEn: A lion has escaped from its cage.
exampleCn: 一只狮子从笼子里逃跑了。

cn: 童年；孩童时期，孩提时代
en: the time when someone is a child
exampleEn: She had an unhappy childhood.
exampleCn: 她的童年很不幸。

en: to say numbers one after the other in order, or to calculate the number of people or things in a group
exampleEn: The teachers counted the students as they got on to the bus.
exampleCn: 学生们上车时老师点了一下人数。

en: the ability to live your life without being helped or influenced by other people
exampleEn: It's important that parents should allow their children some independence.
exampleCn: 父母让子女在一定程度上独立非常重要。

en: to have as a plan or purpose
exampleEn: We intend to go to Australia next year.
exampleCn: 我们打算明年去澳大利亚。

en: being between two other related things, levels, or points
exampleEn: This novel is too difficult for intermediate students of English.
exampleCn: 这部小说对于中等程度的英语学习者来说太难了。

en: not often
exampleEn: We rarely see each other now.
exampleCn: 我们现在很少见面。

cn: （在出现问题之后）再获成功，恢复正常
en: the process of becoming successful or normal again after problems
exampleEn: At last the economy is showing signs of recovery.
exampleCn: 经济最终出现了复苏迹象。

cn: 把…专门留给；把…留作；保留
en: to keep something for a particular purpose or time
exampleEn: I reserve Mondays for tidying my desk and answering letters.
exampleCn: 我把周一的时间留出来专门清理办公桌和回复信件。

cn: 高低不平的；崎岖的；难行的
en: not even or smooth, often because of being in bad condition
exampleEn: It was a rough mountain road, full of stones and huge holes.
exampleCn: 那是一条崎岖的山道，满是石头和巨大的坑洼。

en: the direction that is between south and east
exampleEn: The problem is not restricted to the southeast.
exampleCn: 这个问题并不只存在于东南部。

en: a long passage under or through the ground, especially one made by people
exampleEn: The train went into the tunnel.
exampleCn: 火车驶入隧道。

cn: 未知的；不知名的；不了解的；不熟悉的
en: not known or familiar
exampleEn: Unknown to me, she'd organized a party for my birthday.
exampleCn: 她为我组织了生日派对，我却还蒙在鼓里。

en: not probable or likely to happen
exampleEn: It's pretty unlikely that they'll turn up now - it's nearly ten o'clock.
exampleCn: 他们现在不大可能来了——都快十点了。

en: towards the west
exampleEn: We followed a road leading westward.
exampleCn: 我们沿着一条向西的路走。

en: a fight between armed forces
exampleEn: Her only brother was killed in battle.
exampleCn: 她唯一的哥哥在战斗中牺牲了。

en: a part of the coast where the land curves in so that the sea is surrounded by land on three sides
exampleEn: We sailed into a beautiful, secluded bay.
exampleCn: 我们驶进了一个美丽、僻静的海湾。

cn: 短文；论说文；小品文，散文
en: a short piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one done by students as part of the work for a course
exampleEn: Mr Jones thought my history essay was terrific.
exampleCn: 琼斯先生认为我的历史作业论文写得好极了。

en: an empty space or opening in the middle of something or between two things
exampleEn: The children squeezed through a gap in the wall.
exampleCn: 孩子们从墙的一个缺口处硬挤了过去。

en: a book that gives you the most important information about a particular subject
exampleEn: a guide to the birds of North America
exampleCn: 北美鸟类指南

en: to fasten or support something at the top leaving the other parts free to move, or to be held in this way
exampleEn: A heavy gold necklace hung around her neck.
exampleCn: 她脖子上挂着一串粗重的金项链。

en: the feeling of being happy
exampleEn: He found happiness in later life.
exampleCn: 他在晚年找到了幸福。

en: coloured liquid used for writing, printing, and drawing
exampleEn: The book is printed in three different coloured inks.
exampleCn: 这本书是用三色油墨印刷的。

en: at the present time, in comparison to the past
exampleEn: Nowadays, I bake my own bread rather than buy it.
exampleCn: 现在，我自己烤面包而不去买现成的了。

en: a talk giving information about something
exampleEn: The speaker gave an interesting presentation on urban transport.
exampleCn: 演讲者就城市交通发表了有趣的谈话。

en: a line of things, people, animals, etc. arranged next to each other
exampleEn: a row of houses

en: your name written by yourself, always in the same way, usually to show that something has been written or agreed by you
exampleEn: He denied the signature.
exampleCn: 他否认这是他的签名.

en: in or from the southwest
exampleEn: The southwestern corner of Britain is the warmest.
exampleCn: 英国的西南端最为温暖。

en: a dirty mark on something that is difficult to remove
exampleEn: A dark red stain was spreading across his shirt
exampleCn: 一块深红色的污渍正在他的衬衫上渗开。

en: to not be able to do something
exampleEn: We were unable to contact him at the time.
exampleCn: 我们当时无法和他取得联系。

en: a plan for how something will happen
exampleEn: They'd made all the arrangements for the party.
exampleCn: 他们为聚会作好了一切准备。

en: a type of insect with large, often brightly coloured wings
exampleEn: The butterfly fluttered from flower to flower.
exampleCn: 蝴蝶在花丛中飞来飞去。

cn: （显示个人信息的）卡片；银行卡；通行证
en: a small, rectangular piece of card or plastic, often with your signature, photograph, or other information proving who you are, that allows you to do something, such as make a payment, get money from a bank, or enter a particular place
exampleEn: A lot of shops won't accept cheques unless you have a cheque card with you.
exampleCn: 许多商店不收支票，除非你带了支票保付卡。

en: relating to computers or something that is done by computers
exampleEn: electronic publishing

en: only just; almost not
exampleEn: I could hardly hear her at the back.
exampleCn: 我在后面几乎听不见她说什么。

en: to pay to use something for a short period
exampleEn: How much would it cost to hire a car for the weekend?
exampleCn: 租一辆车周末用要多少钱？

cn: （行动或事件）不可能的，办不到的
en: If an action or event is impossible, it cannot happen or be achieved.
exampleEn: It was impossible to sleep because of the noise.
exampleCn: 噪音太大，无法入睡。

en: a meeting in which someone answers questions about himself or herself for a newspaper article, television show, etc.
exampleEn: In a television interview last night she denied she had any intention of resigning.
exampleCn: 在昨晚的电视采访中，她否认有辞职的打算。

en: the direction that is between north and east
exampleEn: We live in the northeast of Spain.
exampleCn: 我们住在西班牙东北部。

en: a large house that is the official home of a king, queen, or other person of high social rank
exampleEn: Buckingham Palace is open to the public.
exampleCn: 金汉宫向公众开放。

en: someone who reads for pleasure, especially a person who reads a lot
exampleEn: He's a great reader.
exampleCn: 他博览群书。

en: badly or severely
exampleEn: Badly cooked shellfish can make you seriously ill.
exampleCn: 烹调不当的贝类会让你严重不适。

en: slight darkness caused by something blocking the direct light from the sun
exampleEn: The sun was hot, and there were no trees to offer us shade.
exampleCn: 太阳火辣辣的，没有树给我们遮阳。

en: to notice or discover something using the nose
exampleEn: Come and smell these flowers!
exampleCn: 过来闻闻这些花！

en: a person who is in an army and wears its uniform, especially someone who fights when there is a war
exampleEn: Soldiers were patrolling the streets.
exampleCn: 士兵们正在街上巡逻。

en: unexpectedly or in a way that is unusual
exampleEn: The restaurant turned out to be surprisingly cheap.
exampleCn: 没想到这家饭馆这么便宜。

en: (an amount of) money paid to the government that is based on your income or the cost of goods or services you have bought
exampleEn: They're increasing the tax on cigarettes.
exampleCn: 他们要提高烟草税。

en: the sounds that are made when people speak or sing
exampleEn: You could tell from her voice that she wasn't pleased.
exampleCn: 你可以从她的声音里听出来她不高兴。

cn: 陪同，陪伴；伴随，和…一起发生（或存在）
en: to go with someone or to be provided or exist at the same time as something
exampleEn: The course books are accompanied by four CDs.
exampleCn: 这些课本配有四张光盘。

en: to speak angrily to someone, telling that person that you disagree with them
exampleEn: The children are always arguing.
exampleCn: 孩子们老是吵个不休。

en: to move and make currents of air, or to be moved or make something move on a current of air
exampleEn: A cold wind blew from the east.
exampleCn: 东边吹来一股冷风。

en: a place where people stay in tents or other temporary structures
exampleEn: We set up camp by the lakeside.
exampleCn: 我们在湖边扎了营。

en: to share information with others by speaking, writing, moving your body, or using other signals
exampleEn: Has the news been communicated to the staff yet?
exampleCn: 消息传达给员工了吗？

en: something that tells you what something or someone is like
exampleEn: Write a description of your favourite beach.
exampleCn: 写下你最喜欢的海滩的描述。

en: a simple plan that represents a machine, system, or idea, etc., often drawn to explain how it works
exampleEn: The teacher drew a diagram showing how the blood flows through the heart.
exampleCn: 老师画了一张示意图来说明血液如何进出心脏。

en: an event at which objects such as paintings are shown to the public, a situation in which someone shows a particular skill or quality to the public, or the act of showing these things
exampleEn: There's a new exhibition of sculpture on at the city gallery.
exampleCn: 市艺术美术馆正在举行一场新的雕塑作品展。

en: to search and discover (about something)
exampleEn: The best way to explore the countryside is on foot.
exampleCn: 探索农村地区，步行是最好的方法。

en: not soft but not completely hard
exampleEn: I'd rather sleep on a firm mattress than a soft one.
exampleCn: 我宁愿睡硬床垫，也不要软的。

en: a food that is used with other foods in the preparation of a particular dish
exampleEn: Our skin cream contains only natural ingredients.
exampleCn: 我们的护肤霜只含天然成分。

en: a child
exampleEn: He took the kids to the park while I was working.
exampleCn: 我工作时他把孩子们带到公园去了。

en: in or from the northeast
exampleEn: Italy's industrial districts are concentrated in its north-central and northeastern regions.
exampleCn: 意大利的工业区集中在该国中北部和东北部地区。

en: existing, happening, or done outside, rather than inside a building
exampleEn: an outdoor swimming pool
exampleCn: 室外游泳池

en: to choose a small number of things, or to choose by making careful decisions
exampleEn: There was a choice of four prizes, and the winner could select one of them.
exampleCn: 有四种奖品可供选择，获胜者可以从中挑选一个。

en: the land along the edge of a sea, lake, or wide river
exampleEn: You can walk for miles along the shore.
exampleCn: 你可以沿着海岸走上数英里。

en:
①an idea, plan, or action that is suggested or the act of suggesting it

②communication of an idea without stating it directly
exampleEn: They didn't like my suggestion that we should all share the cost.
exampleCn: 他们不喜欢我提出的费用分摊的建议。

en: a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving
exampleEn: This is a growing trend.
exampleCn: 这是一个不断增长的趋势。

en: in or to a foreign country or countries
exampleEn: We always go abroad in the summer.
exampleCn: 我们夏天总是到国外去。

en: to try to hurt or defeat using violence
exampleEn: He was attacked and seriously injured by a gang of youths.
exampleCn: 他被一帮年轻人打成重伤。

en: a feeling or opinion about something or someone, or a way of behaving that is caused by this
exampleEn: It's often very difficult to change people's attitudes.
exampleCn: 人们对事情的看法通常很难改变。

en: relating to behaviour
exampleEn: She studied behavioural psychology at college.
exampleCn: 她在大学学的是行为心理学。

en: to decide that an organized event will not now happen, or to stop an order for goods or services that you no longer want
exampleEn: You may cancel or rearrange the appointment.
exampleCn: 你可以取消或重新安排这次预约。

en: the fact of feeling something physical
exampleEn: I had a tingling feeling in my fingers.
exampleCn: 我手指感到刺痛。

en: the thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, removed from their bodies
exampleEn: She stroked the rabbit's soft fur.
exampleCn: 她轻抚着兔子身上软软的毛。

en: an occasion when something gets better or when you make it better
exampleEn: Your work has shown a significant improvement.
exampleCn: 你的工作有了显著改进。

en: a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and sometimes a fitted lid, usually used for storing food
exampleEn: She opened up a jar of plums.
exampleCn: 她打开了一罐李子。

en: an amount of money that is borrowed, often from a bank, and has to be paid back, usually together with an extra amount of money that you have to pay as a charge for borrowing
exampleEn: She's trying to get a $50,000 loan to start her own business.
exampleCn: 为了开办自己的公司，她正在争取一笔五万美元的贷款。

en: in a negative way
exampleEn: This will negatively affect the result over the first half of the year.
exampleCn: 这将会给前半年的结果带来负面影响。

en: a person who is walking, especially in an area where vehicles go
exampleEn: A few pedestrians sheltered from the rain in doorways.
exampleCn: 几个行人站在门口躲雨。

en: a person who entertains people by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music
exampleEn: He's a brilliant performer.
exampleCn: 他是个出色的演员。

en: the act of politely or officially asking for something
exampleEn: They received hundreds of requests for more information.
exampleCn: 数以百计的人要求他们提供更多的信息。

en: someone who creates sculptures
exampleEn: The sculptor figured the girl in clay.
exampleCn: 雕塑家用粘土塑造了这个女孩子的形象。

en: the direction that is between south and west
exampleEn: China borders on India in the southwest.
exampleCn: 中国的西南与印度相邻。

en: a person who gives a speech at a public event
exampleEn: a good public speaker

en: (of a slope) rising or falling at a sharp angle
exampleEn: The castle is set on a steep hill.
exampleCn: 城堡坐落在陡峭的山。

en: strongly limiting someone's freedom to behave as they wish, or likely to severely punish someone if they do not obey
exampleEn: My parents were very strict with me when I was young.
exampleCn: 我小的时候父母对我要求非常严格。

en: to find someone or something attractive and pleasant to look at
exampleEn: We stood for a few moments, admiring the view.
exampleCn: 我们驻足了一会儿，欣赏美丽的景色。

en: a business that represents one group of people when dealing with another group
exampleEn: a travel agency

en: in total
exampleEn: There are ten of us altogether.
exampleCn: 我们通共十个人。

en: to act in a particular way
exampleEn: She always behaves well when her aunts come to visit.
exampleCn: 每当她姨妈来作客时，她总是表现很好。

en: to or cause to move up or away after hitting a surface
exampleEn: Short sound waves bounce off even small objects.
exampleCn: 短声波即使遇到小物体都会产生回音。

en: a person whose job it is to make buildings
exampleEn: Her father was a builder in Shanghai.
exampleCn: 她父亲是上海的一位建筑工人。

cn: 使集中；使实行中央集权制，使处于中央的控制下
en: to remove authority in a system, company, country, etc. from local places to one central place so that the whole system, etc. is under central control
exampleEn: Payment of bills is now centralized.
exampleCn: 账单的支付现在集中处理。

en: related to, used in, or involving a ceremony
exampleEn: He represented the nation on ceremonial occasions.
exampleCn: 他在礼仪场合代表着国家。

en: something that you say or write that expresses your opinion
exampleEn: He made negative comments to the press.
exampleCn: 他向报界作了些负面的评论。

en: happening because of good luck
exampleEn: Fortunately, we got home before it started to rain.
exampleCn: 很幸运，我们在开始下雨之前回到了家。

en: the quality of being humid
exampleEn: I don't like the humidity of this climate.
exampleCn: 我不喜欢这种潮湿的天气。

cn: 最小值；最少量；最低限度
en: the smallest amount or number allowed or possible
exampleEn: We need a minimum of ten people to play this game.
exampleCn: 玩这个游戏我们至少需要十个人。

en: a substance that pollutes
exampleEn: Nitrogen dioxide is a pollutant emitted by automobiles.
exampleCn: 二氧化氮是汽车排放的一种污染物。

cn: 铁路交通；铁路交通系统
en: the system of transport that uses trains
exampleEn: Environmentalists argue that more goods should be transported by rail.
exampleCn: 环保主义者们主张应该更加充分利用铁路来运输货物。

en: to suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular job or purpose, or to suggest that a particular action should be done
exampleEn: I can recommend the chicken in mushroom sauce - it's delicious.
exampleCn: 我可以向您推荐蘑菇汁鸡肉——这道菜非常可口。

en: the general appearance of the natural environment, especially when it is beautiful
exampleEn: They stopped at the top of the hill to admire the scenery.
exampleCn: 他们在山顶上停了下来，欣赏起风景来。

en: a piece of information that is only known by one person or a few people and should not be told to others
exampleEn: Aren't you going to let me in on the secret?
exampleCn: 难道你不打算告诉我这个秘密？

cn: 开（枪），射（箭）；发射；射中，射伤，射杀
en: to fire a bullet or an arrow, or to hit, injure, or kill a person or animal by firing a bullet or arrow at him, her, or it
exampleEn: If he's not armed, don't shoot.
exampleCn: 如果他没带武器，就不要开枪。

en: the name of a film, book, painting, piece of music, etc.
exampleEn: The title of Evelyn Waugh's first novel was "Decline and Fall".
exampleCn: 伊夫林‧沃的第一部小说名为《衰落与瓦解》。

en: lasting only a short time or containing few words
exampleEn: This is a brief outline of the events.
exampleCn: 这就是事件的简要情况。

cn: 颇有才气的，聪颖的；技艺高超的
en: extremely intelligent or skilled
exampleEn: Her mother was a brilliant scientist.
exampleCn: 她母亲是一位才华横溢的科学家。

en: suitable for your purposes and needs and causing the least difficulty
exampleEn: A bike's a very convenient way of getting around.
exampleCn: 骑自行车四处走动很方便。

en: interested in learning about people or things around you
exampleEn: I was curious to know what would happen next.
exampleCn: 我很好奇想知道接下来会发生什么事。

cn: 娱乐，娱乐节目；娱乐表演
en: shows, films, television, or other performances or activities that entertain people, or a performance of this type
exampleEn: The newscast covers topical events and entertainment.
exampleCn: 该新闻广播涉及时事和娱乐。

cn: 瞥一眼，迅速地看一眼，扫视
en: to give a quick short look
exampleEn: He glanced up from his book as I passed.
exampleCn: 我走过的时候，正埋头读书的他抬头瞥了我一眼。

en: an animal related to sheep that usually has horns and a beard. Goats live wild on mountains or are kept on farms to provide milk, meat, wool, etc.
exampleEn: An old man was herding the goats up the mountainside.
exampleCn: 一个年长的男人正在把山羊往山上赶。

cn: 毕业；接受学位，获得毕业文凭
en: the fact of finishing a degree or other course of study at a university or school, or the ceremony at which you are officially said to have finished
exampleEn: After graduation, he worked there as a lecturer.
exampleCn: 毕业后，他留校任教。

en: covered in ice
exampleEn: Mind the icy sidewalk!
exampleCn: 小心结冰的人行道！

en: consisting of, or partly consisting of, metal
exampleEn: Brass is a metallic alloy of copper and zinc.
exampleCn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

en: in a perfect way
exampleEn: They're perfectly suited.
exampleCn: 他们俩是天造地设的一对。

en: first in order of importance
exampleEn: The principal aim of this meeting is to reach a decision that we all agree on.
exampleCn: 这次会议的主要目的是达成一项大家都同意的决定。

en: something given in exchange for good behaviour or good work, etc.
exampleEn: There's a reward for whoever finishes first.
exampleCn: 无论谁先完成都会得到一份奖赏。

en: an area of darkness, caused by light being blocked by something
exampleEn: The children were playing, jumping on each other's shadows.
exampleCn: 孩子们正在嬉戏，跳来跳去踩彼此的影子。

en: without any soundg
exampleEn: The empty house was completely silent.
exampleCn: 那座空房子一片寂静。

en: a result that your plans or actions are intended to achieve
exampleEn: The aim is to improve the public image of the police.
exampleCn: 目的是改善警察的公众形象。

en: a particular country's fighting force
exampleEn: When did you join the army?
exampleCn: 你什么时候参的军？

en: for a short time
exampleEn: We chatted briefly about the weather.
exampleCn: 我们聊了几句天气。

en: someone who is famous, especially in the entertainment business
exampleEn: Being recognized in the street is part of being a celebrity.
exampleCn: 在街上被人认出是成为名人的一部分。

en: a legal document that states and explains a formal agreement between two different people or groups, or the agreement itself
exampleEn: My solicitor is drawing up a contract.
exampleCn: 我的律师正在起草一份合同。

en: in a way that is in agreement with the true facts or with what is generally accepted
exampleEn: Correctly answer this question for your chance to win a car!
exampleCn: 正确回答这个问题，以便您有机会赢得汽车！

cn: 全体工作人员；全体船员，全体机组人员，全体乘务人员
en: a group of people who work together, especially all those who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, etc.
exampleEn: The aircraft has a crew of seven.
exampleCn: 这架飞机上有七名机组人员。

en: to protect someone or something against attack or criticism; to speak in favour of someone or something
exampleEn: White blood cells help defend the body against infection.
exampleCn: 白细胞帮助身体防御感染。

en: a condition or situation that causes problems, especially one that causes something or someone to be less successful than other things or people
exampleEn: One major disadvantage of the area is the lack of public transport.
exampleCn: 这个地区的一大不便之处就是缺少公共交通工具。

en: for the environment
exampleEn: Young people are very environmentally aware.
exampleCn: 年轻人的环保意识很强。

en: an organized journey for a particular purpose
exampleEn: They started on a dangerous expedition.
exampleCn: 他们出发去进行一次危险的远征。

en: the buildings, equipment, and services provided for a particular purpose
exampleEn: shopping facilities

en: a special day or period, usually in memory of a religious event, with its own social activities, food, or ceremonies
exampleEn: a Christian festival

en: the type of book or story that is written about imaginary characters and events and not based on real people and facts
exampleEn: The book is a work of fiction and not intended as a historical account.
exampleCn: 这本书是一部小说作品而并非史实陈述。

en: to a great degree
exampleEn: He gave her a hugely expensive diamond ring.
exampleCn: 他送给她一枚十分昂贵的钻戒。

en: recently
exampleEn: I haven't been feeling so well lately.
exampleCn: 最近我一直有些不舒服。

en: great comfort, especially as provided by expensive and beautiful things
exampleEn: a luxury hotel

en: a unit of length that is equal to 0.001 meters
exampleEn: We measure rainfall by the millimeter.
exampleCn: 我们以毫米测量雨量。

en: material made of threads of rope, string, wire, or plastic with spaces between them, allowing gas, liquid, or small objects to go through, or an object made with this material that is used to limit the movement of something
exampleEn: Dolphins often get tangled in the nets that are used to catch tuna fish.
exampleCn: 海豚常常被缠在捕金枪鱼的网中。

en: If someone is given permission to do something, they are allowed to do it.
exampleEn: The authorities have refused permission for the demonstration to take place.
exampleCn: 官方拒绝批准游行示威。

en: an important male member of a royal family, especially a son or grandson of the king or queen
exampleEn: The prince has two bodyguards watching over him every hour of the day.
exampleCn: 王子有两名保镖每时每刻看守着他。

cn:
①锋利的；尖的

②突然的；急剧的；猛烈的
en:
①having a thin edge or point that can cut something or make a hole in something

②happening suddenly, quickly, and strongly
exampleEn: a knife with a sharp edge

cn: 壮观的，壮丽的；令人惊叹的
en: very exciting to look at
exampleEn: There was a spectacular sunset last night.
exampleCn: 昨晚的日落非常壮观。

en: the time in the morning when the sun starts to rise in the sky
exampleEn: They went out at sunrise to go bird-watching.
exampleCn: 他们日出的时候就出去观鸟去了。

en: the front of the neck, or the space inside the neck down which food and air can go
exampleEn: A fish bone got stuck in my throat.
exampleCn: 我喉咙里卡了一根鱼刺。

en: the sudden loud noise that comes from the sky especially during a storm
exampleEn: We heard thunder growling in the distance.
exampleCn: 我们听见远处有隆隆雷声。

en: the fact of arriving somewhere
exampleEn: Hundreds gathered to await the boxer's arrival at the airport.
exampleCn: 数百人聚在机场等候拳击手的到来。

cn: 面包师；糕点师；面包店店员（或店主）
en: a person whose job is to make bread and cakes for sale, or to sell bread and cakes
exampleEn: A baker is kneading the dough.
exampleCn: 一位面包师正在揉面团。

en: a stick of wax with string going through it which produces light as it burns
exampleEn: Shall I light a candle?
exampleCn: 我点支蜡烛好吗？

en: entertainment such as a film, play, etc. which is funny
exampleEn: His latest movie is described as a "romantic comedy".
exampleCn: 他的最新影片被描述为一部“浪漫喜剧”。

cn: 会议，大会；讨论会，协商会
en: an event, sometimes lasting a few days, at which there is a group of talks on a particular subject, or a meeting in which especially business matters are discussed formally
exampleEn: They frequently hold conferences at that hotel.
exampleCn: 他们常在那家酒店举办会议。

cn: 发育中的；进化中的；开发中的
en: in a state of developing or being developed
exampleEn: The product is still at a developmental stage.
exampleCn: 这种产品仍处于开发阶段。

cn: 激动，兴奋；令人兴奋的事情
en: a feeling of being excited, or an exciting event
exampleEn: Robin's heart was pounding with excitement.
exampleCn: 罗宾的心激动得怦怦直跳。

en: the activity of searching and finding out about something
exampleEn: Livingstone was the first European to make an exploration of the Zambezi river.
exampleCn: 利文斯通是第一个勘探赞比西河的欧洲人。

cn: 非凡的；特别的；意想不到的；令人惊奇的
en: very unusual, special, unexpected, or strange
exampleEn: He told the extraordinary story of his escape.
exampleCn: 他讲述了他离奇的逃亡经历。

en: for all time
exampleEn: We'll support you forever.
exampleCn: 我们会永远支持你。

en: a unit used for measuring length, approximately equal to 2.54 centimetres, sometimes shown by the symbol ″
exampleEn: He had a cut an inch long above his left eye.
exampleCn: 他左眼上方有一道一英寸长的伤口。

cn: 部分时间地（的），兼职地（的）
en: If you work part-time or do part-time work, you work for only some of the day or the week.
exampleEn: After my children were born I decided to go part-time.
exampleCn: 孩子出生以后，我决定改为兼职工作。

en: relating to planets
exampleEn: planetary motion
exampleCn: 行星运动

en: a town by the sea or by a river that has a harbour, or the harbour itself
exampleEn: This is one of the furthermost ports of northern Europe.
exampleCn: 这是北欧最远的港口之一。

en: any type of work that needs special training or a particular skill, often one that is respected because it involves a high level of education
exampleEn: They're both doctors by profession.
exampleCn: 他们两人的职业都是医生。

en: a forest in a tropical area that receives a lot of rain
exampleEn: a tropical rainforest
exampleCn: 一片热带雨林

cn:
①登记员，户籍管理员

②（某些大学的）注册主任，教务主任，教务长
en:
①an official whose job is to keep official records, especially of births, deaths, and marriages

②at some colleges, an official in charge of exams, keeping records, and new students
exampleEn: The judge said the registrar would discuss that with him.
exampleCn: 法官表示，记录员将就此跟他进行讨论。

en: If you are rid of someone or something that you did not want or that caused problems for you, they are no longer with you or causing problems for you.
exampleEn: I didn't enjoy marking those papers and I was glad to be rid of them.
exampleCn: 我不喜欢批改那些卷子，所以我很高兴能免去这一麻烦。

cn: （提供服务的）厅，院，室，店；美容院，美发厅，时装店
en: a shop where you can get a particular service, especially connected with beauty or fashion
exampleEn: a beauty salon

cn: 令人震惊的事件（或经历）；惊愕，震惊
en: (the emotional or physical reaction to) a sudden, unexpected, and usually unpleasant event or experience
exampleEn: It was a shock to see her looking so ill.
exampleCn: 看到她病得如此厉害，真让人震惊。

en: the grey, black, or white mixture of gas and very small pieces of carbon that is produced when something burns
exampleEn: cigarette smoke

en: towards the south
exampleEn: The train moved slowly southward.
exampleCn: 火车缓慢地向南开去。

en: in or from the southeast
exampleEn: The southeastern part of Britain is the most populated.
exampleCn: 英国东南部是人口最密集的地区。

cn: （从一种语言到另一种语言的）翻译；译文
en: something that is translated, or the process of translating something, from one language to another
exampleEn: The English version is boring - maybe it has lost something in translation.
exampleCn: 英语版读起来枯燥乏味——也许翻译得有点儿走味。

en: to believe that someone is good and honest and will not harm you, or that something is safe and reliable
exampleEn: My sister warned me not to trust him.
exampleCn: 我姐姐告诫我不要相信他。

en: under or below
exampleEn: They found a bomb underneath the car.
exampleCn: 他们在车底下发现了一枚炸弹。

cn: 缺勤的；缺席的；不在场的
en: not in the place where you are expected to be, especially at school or work
exampleEn: John has been absent from school for three days now.
exampleCn: 约翰到现在已经旷课三天了。

en: something that someone says officially, giving information about something
exampleEn: The president made an unexpected announcement this morning.
exampleCn: 今天上午总统发表了一项出人意料的声明。

en: a person who formally requests something, especially a job, or to study at a college or university
exampleEn: How many applicants did you have for the job?
exampleCn: 申请这个工作的有多少人？

en: the act of avoiding something or someone
exampleEn: The avoidance of injury is critical to a professional athlete.
exampleCn: 对于一个职业运动员来说，避免受伤是至关重要的。

en: to defeat or do better than
exampleEn: Simon always beats me at tennis.
exampleCn: 西蒙打网球总是赢我。

en: the air that goes into and out of your lungs
exampleEn: She was dizzy and short of breath.
exampleCn: 她头昏眼花，上气不接下气。

en: a number of things of the same type fastened together or in a close group
exampleEn: The reorganization will give us a whole bunch of problems.
exampleCn: 重组将会给我们带来一堆问题。

en: someone who buys something expensive such as a house
exampleEn: He's still looking for a buyer for his house.
exampleCn: 他还在给自己的房子寻找买主。

en: (a set of) formal acts, often fixed and traditional, performed on important social or religious occasions
exampleEn: a graduation ceremony

en: to say that something is wrong or not satisfactory
exampleEn: Lots of people have complained about the noise.
exampleCn: 许多人抱怨过这噪声。

en: to add something to an object or place, especially in order to make it more attractive
exampleEn: They decorated the wedding car with ribbons and flowers.
exampleCn: 他们用彩带和鲜花装饰婚车。

en: dust, soil, or any substance that makes a surface not clean
exampleEn: His coat was covered with dirt.
exampleCn: 他的外套上满是泥土。

en: to move something by pulling it along a surface, usually the ground
exampleEn: She dragged the canoe down to the water.
exampleCn: 她把独木舟拉到水边。

en: the part of the face above the eyes
exampleEn: A frown creased her forehead.
exampleCn: 她一皱眉，额头显出了皱纹。

en: telling the truth or able to be trusted and not likely to steal, cheat, or lie
exampleEn: She's completely honest.
exampleCn: 她很诚实。

cn: （空气和天气状况）潮湿的，湿润的
en: (of air and weather conditions) containing extremely small drops of water in the air
exampleEn: New York is very hot and humid in the summer.
exampleCn: 纽约的夏天炎热潮湿。

en: a group of teams playing a sport who take part in competitions between each other
exampleEn: They are currently bottom of the league.
exampleCn: 他们目前在联赛中垫底。

en: to become the legally accepted husband or wife of someone in an official or religious ceremony
exampleEn: They don't have any plans to marry at present.
exampleCn: 他们目前没打算结婚

en: until something expected happens, or while something else is happening
exampleEn: Meanwhile, my debts were mounting up.
exampleCn: 同时，我的债务还在不断增加。

en: to learn something so that you will remember it exactly
exampleEn: The boy can memorize the data easily.
exampleCn: 这男孩能轻松地记住这些数据。

en: tidy, with everything in its place
exampleEn: She likes everything neat and tidy.
exampleCn: 她喜欢一切都井井有条。

en: a person who has a position of authority in an organization
exampleEn: a personnel officer

cn: 就个人而言；就本人而言
en: used when you give your opinion
exampleEn: Personally speaking, I think the show is going to be a great success.
exampleCn: 在我个人看来，演出会取得巨大成功。

en: a person who writes poems
exampleEn: The poet Baggesen was born here.
exampleCn: 诗人柏格森就出生在这里。

en: the things that you do or the time that you spend preparing for something
exampleEn: The teacher didn't seem to have done much preparation for the class.
exampleCn: 看来这位教师这堂课准备得不是太充分。

en: to tell someone that you will certainly do something
exampleEn: He promised faithfully to call me every week.
exampleCn: 他信誓旦旦地保证每周都给我打电话。

en: correctly, or in a satisfactory way
exampleEn: It's still not working properly.
exampleCn: 它还是不能正常运转。

en: an arrangement in which something such as a seat on an aircraft or a table at a restaurant is kept for youy
exampleEn: I'd like to make a table reservation for two people for nine o'clock.
exampleCn: 我要预订九点两人用餐的桌位。

en: the state of being either male or female
exampleEn: What sex is your cat?
exampleCn: 你的猫是公的还是母的？

en: a period without any sound; complete quiet
exampleEn: A loud crash of thunder broke the silence of the night.
exampleCn: 一声炸雷打破了夜晚的宁静。

cn:
①整洁漂亮的，时髦的

②聪明的，机灵的
en:
①having a clean, tidy, and stylish appearance

②intelligent, or able to think quickly or intelligently in difficult situations
exampleEn: I need a smart jacket for my interview.
exampleCn: 我需要穿一件像样的上衣去面试。

cn: 成功；实现目标；达到目的
en: If you succeed, you achieve something that you have been aiming for, and if a plan or piece of work succeeds, it has the results that you wanted.
exampleEn: You need to be pretty tough to succeed in the property world.
exampleCn: 要想在房地产界出人头地，你必须要坚忍不拔。

en: very good
exampleEn: You look terrific!
exampleCn: 你看起来棒极了！

en: the distance between the opposite sides of something
exampleEn: Look at the thickness of that tree trunk.
exampleCn: 看一下那个树干的厚度。

cn: 塔；建筑物的塔形部分；塔楼，高楼
en: a tall, narrow structure, often square or circular, that either forms part of a building or stands alone
exampleEn: He works in an office tower in downtown San Francisco.
exampleCn: 他在旧金山市中心的一座高层写字楼里工作。

en: not feeling comfortable and pleasant, or not making you feel comfortable and pleasant
exampleEn: I've eaten so much, I actually feel uncomfortable.
exampleCn: 我吃了这么多，实在感觉很不舒服。

en: a container for holding flowers or for decoration
exampleEn: He was clasping the vase tightly, terrified of dropping it.
exampleCn: 他紧紧地扣着花瓶，害怕掉下去。

en: to make someone realize a possible danger or problem, especially one in the future
exampleEn: We were warned not to eat the fish which might upset our stomachs.
exampleCn: 我们被告诫不要吃那种鱼，因为可能会导致胃部轻微不适。

en: a net used to catch insects, made by a spider from the sticky thread that its body produces
exampleEn: We watched a spider spin a web between three tall grass stems.
exampleCn: 我们注视着一只蜘蛛在三根高高的草茎之间织了一张网。

en: to have a heaviness of a stated amount, or to measure the heaviness of an object
exampleEn: She weighs herself every week on the scales in the bathroom.
exampleCn: 她每周都用浴室里的秤称体重。

cn: 为…提供住宿；容纳；为…提供空间
en: to provide with a place to live or to be stored in
exampleEn: New students may be accommodated in halls of residence.
exampleCn: 新生可以住在学校宿舍楼里。

en: something very good and difficult that you have succeeded in doing
exampleEn: It was a remarkable achievement for such a young player.
exampleCn: 如此年轻的选手有这样的成绩真是了不起。

cn: 有利的；有优势的；有好处的
en: giving advantages or helping to make you more successful
exampleEn: The lower tax rate is particularly advantageous to poorer families.
exampleCn: 低税率对于较为贫困的家庭尤其有利。

en: to accept, allow, or officially agree to something
exampleEn: The court approved the sale of the property.
exampleCn: 法院批准卖掉这处房产。

en: towards the direction that is opposite to the one in which you are facing or opposite to the usual direction
exampleEn: I walked backwards towards the door.
exampleCn: 我向门口退去。

en: a pleasant feeling of being relaxed and free from pain
exampleEn: She evidently dresses for comfort.
exampleCn: 显然，她穿着讲究舒适。

en: a person, team, or company that is competing against others
exampleEn: Their prices are better than any of their competitors.
exampleCn: 他们的价格比所有竞争对手的都要优惠。

en: If a vehicle crashes or someone crashes it, it is involved in an accident, usually a serious one in which the vehicle is damaged and someone is hurt.
exampleEn: We skidded on the ice and crashed.
exampleCn: 我们在冰上打滑撞了车。

en: a way of behaving or a belief that has been established for a long time
exampleEn: a local custom

en: to fail to satisfy someone or their hopes, wishes, etc., or to make someone feel unhappy
exampleEn: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I'm afraid I can't come after all.
exampleCn: 很抱歉让你失望，但恐怕我真的来不了。

en: the act of entering a place or joining a particular society or organization
exampleEn: A flock of sheep blocked our entry to the farm.
exampleCn: 一群羊挡住了我们进入农场的路。

en: someone who travels to places where no one has ever been in order to find out what is there
exampleEn: Magellan was a famous 16th-century explorer.
exampleCn: 麦哲伦是十六世纪著名的探险家。

en: to cook food in hot oil or fat
exampleEn: Fry the mushrooms in a little butter.
exampleCn: 用少许黄油煎一下蘑菇。

en: not violent, severe, or strong
exampleEn: a gentle breeze

en: a type of plant whose leaves are used in cooking to give flavour to particular dishes or in making medicine
exampleEn: Basil, oregano, thyme, and rosemary are all herbs.
exampleCn: 罗勒、牛至、百里香和迷迭香都是香草。

cn: 关于历史事件，从历史观点上说；在过去，历史上地
en: connected with studying or representing things from the past
exampleEn: Historically, the major purpose of free public libraries was educational.
exampleCn: 从历史上看，开设免费公共图书馆的主要目的是教育。

en: a person whose job is to teach people a practical skill
exampleEn: He is an aerobics instructor.
exampleCn: 他是一个有氧健身操教练。

en: to form, give, or have as an opinion, or to decide about something or someone, especially after thinking carefully
exampleEn: I'm hopeless at judging distance.
exampleCn: 我不擅长估算距离。

en: a tropical forest in which trees and plants grow very closely together
exampleEn: Either side of the river is dense, impenetrable jungle.
exampleCn: 河的两岸是茂密而难以穿行的丛林。

en: the principle that specific functions have relatively circumscribed locations in some particular part or organ of the body
exampleEn: Globalization and localization are both inevitable, the report says.
exampleCn: 报告认为，全球化和地方化都是不可避免的。

en: making a lot of noise
exampleEn: She spoke very loudly.
exampleCn: 她说话的声音很大。

en: a legally accepted relationship between two people in which they live together, or the official ceremony that results in this
exampleEn: They had a long and happy marriage.
exampleCn: 他们的婚姻长久而幸福。

en: worried and anxious
exampleEn: I was too nervous to speak.
exampleCn: 我紧张得说不出话来。

en: in or from the northwest
exampleEn: Virtually every river in northwestern Oregon was near flood stage.
exampleCn: 俄勒冈西北部的差不多每条河都接近洪涝阶段了。

en: a short part of a text, consisting of at least one sentence and beginning on a new line. It usually deals with a single event, description, idea, etc.
exampleEn: Write a paragraph on each of the topics given below.
exampleCn: 就下面所列主题各写一个段落。

en: in a way that is repeated after a particular period of time
exampleEn: The equipment should be tested periodically.
exampleCn: 设备应定期检测。

en: Someone who is picky is very careful about choosing only what they like.
exampleEn: The children are such picky eaters.
exampleCn: 孩子们非常挑食。

en: to stop doing something or leave a job or a place
exampleEn: I'm going to quit smoking.
exampleCn: 我准备戒烟。

en: raining a lot
exampleEn: They take a walk on rainy day.
exampleCn: 他们在下雨天散步。

cn: 移开；拿开；去掉；除去；调动
en: the act of taking something or someone away from somewhere or something
exampleEn: Does your firm do removals?
exampleCn: 你们公司承接搬家业务吗？

en: a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper or magazine or for radio or television
exampleEn: a crime reporter

en: a person who works on a ship, especially one who is not an officer
exampleEn: The sailor coiled the rope around the anchor.
exampleCn: 水手把绳子绕在锚上。

en: the number of points, goals, etc. achieved in a game or competition
exampleEn: a high score

en: to slide without intending to
exampleEn: She slipped on the ice.
exampleCn: 她在冰上滑倒了。

en: the whole number or amount when two or more numbers or amounts have been added together
exampleEn: The sum of 13 and 8 is 21.
exampleCn: 十三加八等于二十一。

en: to change words into a different language
exampleEn: We were asked to translate a list of sentences.
exampleCn: 我们被要求翻译一组句子。

en: an action that is intended to deceive, either as a way of cheating someone, or as a joke or form of entertainment
exampleEn: She played a really nasty trick on me - she put syrup in my shampoo bottle!
exampleCn: 她对我搞了一个很讨厌的恶作剧——把糖浆放进了我装洗发剂的瓶子里。

cn: 不公平的，不公正的；不正当的
en: not treating people in an equal way, or not morally right
exampleEn: It's unfair to blame Robert.
exampleCn: 责备罗伯特是不公平的。

en: to express your choice or opinion, especially by officially writing a mark on a paper or by raising your hand or speaking in a meeting
exampleEn: She was too young to vote in the election.
exampleCn: 她的年龄太小，不能在选举中投票。

en: to meet and speak to someone in a friendly way when they arrive
exampleEn: The visitors were warmly welcomed by the head of the department.
exampleCn: 来访人士受到系主任的热烈欢迎。

en: animals and plants that grow independently of people, usually in natural conditions
exampleEn: wildlife conservation

en: someone who keeps or examines the records of money received, paid, and owed by a company or person
exampleEn: a firm of accountants

en: the line that divides one country from another
exampleEn: The train crosses the border between France and Spain.
exampleCn: 火车穿过法国和西班牙之间的边界。

en: someone who tries to win a competition, fight, or sports event from someone who has previously won it
exampleEn: The world champion conquered yet another challenger last night.
exampleCn: 昨晚这位世界冠军又战胜了一名挑战者。

cn: （动物或植物的）颜色；色彩；花纹
en: the fact of colour being present on an animal or plant and the pattern that the colour makes
exampleEn: This piece of cloth has bad coloration.
exampleCn: 这块布料染的不好。

en: the fact of something becoming smaller or shorter
exampleEn: Cold causes contraction of the metal.
exampleCn: 金属遇冷收缩。

en: a small house, usually in the countryside
exampleEn: The cottage had a delightful sea view.
exampleCn: 这小屋可以看到宜人的海景。

en: relating to your diet
exampleEn: Dietary habits can be very difficult to change.
exampleCn: 饮食习惯很难改变。

en: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two different things you could do
exampleEn: The president is clearly in a dilemma about how to tackle the crisis.
exampleCn: 对于如何化解危机总统明显处于两难境地。

en: a flat, circular device that is used for storing information
exampleEn: I saved the photos onto a disk for you.
exampleCn: 我把照片给你存进光盘里了。

en: extremely or very much
exampleEn: She worked enormously hard on the project.
exampleCn: 她为了这个项目拼命工作。

cn: 交换器；交易所；交换程序
en: a person or thing that exchanges
exampleEn: Don't pull a vacuum on the exchanger.
exampleCn: 不要移动热交换器上的真空设备。

en: (of words and phrases) used not with their basic meaning but with a more imaginative meaning, in order to create a special effect
exampleEn: Of course, she was using the term "massacre" in the figurative sense.
exampleCn: 当然，她是在用“屠杀”这个词的比喻义。

en: belonging or relating to government or the government.
exampleEn: We await a governmental decision about the future of the programme.
exampleCn: 我们正等待着政府就该项目的前途作出决定。

en: writing with a pen or pencil
exampleEn: We need to ensure that handwriting is properly taught in our primary schools.
exampleCn: 我们要确保小学里有正规的习字课。

en: to make a product or service more suitable for a particular area
exampleEn: The TV station is continuing to localize content in order to maximize regional sales.
exampleCn: 电视台继续对内容进行地方化，以期实现区域销售最大化。

en: a device that prevents something such as a door from being opened and can only be opened with a key
exampleEn: I heard someone turn a key in the lock.
exampleCn: 我听见有人在用钥匙开门。

en: in, at, or to no place; not anywhere
exampleEn: Nowhere does the article mention the names of the people involved.
exampleCn: 这篇文章中并未提及相关人员的名字。

en: based on or acting on good judgment and practical ideas or understanding
exampleEn: It would be sensible to take an umbrella.
exampleCn: 带把伞是明智的。

en: one of the two parts of the body at each side of the neck that join the arms to the rest of the body
exampleEn: I rested my head on her shoulder.
exampleCn: 我把头靠在她的肩上。

cn:
①在社交方面

②社会地
en:
①in or relating to a social situation

②by or relating to society
exampleEn: I chat to him at work now and then but I've never seen him socially.
exampleCn: 我偶尔在工作时和他闲聊一会儿，但我从未在社交场合见过他。

cn: 社会学家，社会关系研究者
en: someone who studies or is an expert in sociology
exampleEn: She is a sociologist by training.
exampleCn: 她是一位训练有素的社会学家。

cn: 壮丽地，壮观地，令人惊叹地
en: in a very beautiful way that people admire
exampleEn: At night, the city is spectacularly lit.
exampleCn: 夜晚，该市灯火辉煌，非常壮观。

en:
①a chemical element that is a silver-coloured metal, often combined with other metals or used to cover and protect other metals

②a closed metal container in which food is sold
exampleEn: a tin mine

en: a place to live, work, stay, etc. in
exampleEn: There's a shortage of cheap accommodation.
exampleCn: 便宜的住所供不应求。

en: to agree that something is true, especially unwillingly
exampleEn: He admitted his guilt.
exampleCn: 他承认有罪。

cn: 劝告；忠告；向…提供意见，给…出主意
en: to give someone advice
exampleEn: His doctor advised him against smoking.
exampleCn: 他的医生劝他戒烟。

en: a strong wish to achieve something
exampleEn: She was intelligent but suffered from a lack of ambition.
exampleCn: 她很聪明，但却缺乏远大志向。

en: to make something known or tell people about something officially
exampleEn: She announced the winner of the competition to an excited audience.
exampleCn: 她向激动的观众宣布了比赛的获胜者。

cn: 吸引（力）；有吸引力的事物
en: something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing
exampleEn: tourist attractions

en: great skill or intelligence
exampleEn: Her first novel showed signs of brilliance.
exampleCn: 她的第一部小说显示出她的才气。

cn: 挑剔的；难讨好的；难伺候的
en: difficult to please because you are very exact about what you like
