exampleEn: She's very choosy about what she eats and drinks.
exampleCn: 她对饮食非常挑剔。

en: of or shared by every member of a group of people
exampleEn: a collective decision

cn: 色彩鲜艳的；艳丽的；五颜六色的
en: having bright colours or a lot of different colours
exampleEn: The handbags are colorful.
exampleCn: 这些手提包五颜六色。

en: involving a lot of different parts, in a way that is difficult to understand
exampleEn: The rules are rather complicated to follow.
exampleCn: 这些规定遵守起来挺复杂的。

en: to exchange ideas on a particular subject, often in order to reach a decision on what action to take
exampleEn: I need some time to confer with my lawyer.
exampleCn: 我想花点时间跟我的律师商量一下。

cn: 自信的，有信心的；确信的；有把握的；信任的
en: having confidence
exampleEn: Be a bit more confident in yourself!
exampleCn: 你应该再自信一点！

cn: 令人困惑的；令人费解的；含糊不清的
en: Something that is confusing makes you feel confused because it is difficult to understand.
exampleEn: The statement is really confusing.
exampleCn: 该声明确实令人困惑。

en: the feeling of being disappointed
exampleEn: To my disappointment, he decided to leave.
exampleCn: 令我沮丧的是，他决定离开。

cn: （电影或电视）纪录片；纪实性广播节目
en: a film or television or radio programme that gives facts and information about a subject
exampleEn: The documentary took a fresh look at the life of Darwin.
exampleCn: 这部纪录片从一个崭新的角度介绍了达尔文的一生。

cn: 紧急情况；不测事件；突发事件
en: something dangerous or serious, such as an accident, that happens suddenly or unexpectedly and needs fast action in order to avoid harmful results
exampleEn: The pilot of the aircraft was forced to make an emergency landing on Lake Geneva.
exampleCn: 这架飞机的驾驶员不得不在日内瓦湖面上紧急迫降。

en: the fact of someone being paid to work for a company or organization
exampleEn: Employment levels are unlikely to rise significantly before the end of next year.
exampleCn: 在明年年底之前就业率很难有大幅度上升。

en: to keep a group of people interested or enjoying themselves
exampleEn: We hired a magician to entertain the children.
exampleCn: 我们雇了一位魔术师表演节目让孩子们开心。

en: to break up into pieces violently, or to cause something to do this
exampleEn: A bomb exploded at one of the capital's busiest railway stations this morning.
exampleCn: 今天上午一枚炸弹在首都最繁忙的一个火车站爆炸。

en: done in order to discover more about something
exampleEn: She's having some exploratory tests done to find out what's causing the illness.
exampleCn: 她正在接受一些检查以查明病因。

en: to increase or make something increase, especially an emotion or effect
exampleEn: This habit, too, seems to heighten happiness.
exampleCn: 这个做法似乎也能提高人们的幸福感。

en: to tell someone about particular facts
exampleEn: Why wasn't I informed about this earlier?
exampleCn: 为什么不早点儿将这事通知我？

cn: 精力充沛的；生气勃勃的；活跃的
en: full of energy and enthusiasm; interesting and exciting
exampleEn: There was some lively discussion at the meeting.
exampleCn: 会上讨论得很热烈。

en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.
exampleEn: Strawberries are plentiful in the summer.
exampleCn: 夏天草莓很多。

cn: 适合的；适当的；恰当的；正确的
en: real, satisfactory, suitable, or correct
exampleEn: You shouldn't rush headfirst into starting your own business without proper advice.
exampleCn: 没有适当的建议，你不应该鲁莽地开始自己的事业。

cn: 有明确目标的，有清晰目的的；坚决的
en: showing that you know what you want to do
exampleEn: He has a quiet, purposeful air.
exampleCn: 他镇定而又坚决。

en: an official record showing that you have finished a training course or have the necessary skills, etc.
exampleEn: You'll never get a good job if you don't have any qualifications.
exampleCn: 你要是没有任何资格证书就永远得不到一份好工作。

en: to measure or judge the size or amount of something
exampleEn: It's difficult to quantify how many people will be affected by the change.
exampleCn: 很难确定将有多少人受到该变化的影响。

en: the act of measuring or judging the size or amount of something
exampleEn: Quantification can create the illusion of precision.
exampleCn: 量化能给人精确的假象。

cn: （旅馆或办公楼的）接待处；服务台
en: the place in a hotel or office building where people go when they first arrive
exampleEn: I signed in at the reception desk.
exampleCn: 我在接待处登了记。

en: about
exampleEn: The company is being questioned regarding its employment policy.
exampleCn: 该公司的用人政策正受到质疑。

en: the act of recording a name or information on an official list
exampleEn: voter registration
exampleCn: 选民登记

en: the quality of being dependable or reliable
exampleEn: Car buyers are more interested in safety and reliability than speed.
exampleCn: 比起速度，汽车买主更关注安全性和可靠性。

cn: 恋爱关系；罗曼史；风流韵事
en: a close, usually short relationship of love between two people
exampleEn: a historical romance

en: frightening
exampleEn: Planes are a little scary but helicopter are scarier!
exampleCn: 飞机有点吓人，但是直升机更吓人！

en: protection of a person, building, organization, or country against threats such as crime or attacks by foreign countries
exampleEn: The station was closed for two hours because of a security alert.
exampleCn: 由于有安全警报，车站关闭了两小时。

en: to put something in a particular position
exampleEn: They plan to situate the bus stop at the corner of the road.
exampleCn: 他们打算把公交车站设在道路拐角上。

en: a public event or show that is exciting to watch; an exciting appearance
exampleEn: The carnival was a magnificent spectacle.
exampleCn: 嘉年华场面十分壮观。

en: making you feel worried and nervous
exampleEn: Police work is physically demanding and stressful.
exampleCn: 警察的工作很辛苦，压力很大。

en: relating to a particular style of doing something
exampleEn: In their second album, the band tried to expand their stylistic range.
exampleCn: 在他们的第二张专辑里，乐队尝试着拓展他们的风格。

cn: 令人意外的，让人吃惊的，出人意料的
en: unexpected
exampleEn: He gave a quite surprising answer.
exampleCn: 他的回答非常出人意料。

en: Clothes or shoes that are tight fit the body too closely and are uncomfortable.
exampleEn: That jacket's too tight - you need a bigger size.
exampleCn: 那件夹克太紧身了——你需要号大一点的。

en: a set of animals or plants in which the members have similar characteristics to each other and can breed with each other
exampleEn: Over a hundred species of insect are found in this area.
exampleCn: 这一地区有上百种昆虫。

en: the material on the surface of the ground in which plants grow
exampleEn: fertile soil

en: to bring something into existence
exampleEn: She left a large sum of money in her will to found a wildlife sanctuary.
exampleCn: 她在遗嘱里留下了一大笔钱用来创建野生动物保护区。

cn: （一定范围内的）人口，动物总数
en: all the people or animals of a particular type or group who live in one country, area, or place
exampleEn: The dolphin population has been decimated by tuna fishing.
exampleCn: 捕捞金枪鱼导致海豚的数量大大减少。

en: the outer or top part or layer of something
exampleEn: I need a flat surface to write on.
exampleCn: 我需要一个平面在上面写字。

en: a physical substance that things can be made from
exampleEn: The colour in this silk material will not fade.
exampleCn: 这种绸布料子不会褪色。

cn:
①过程；步骤

②变化过程；进程
en:
①a series of actions that you take in order to achieve a result

②a series of changes that happen naturally
exampleEn: This decision may delay the process of European unification.
exampleCn: 这一决策可能会推迟欧洲一体化的进程。

en: one or more reasons for believing that something is or is not true
exampleEn: The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.
exampleCn: 警方没有发现任何证据证明这起谋杀案和恐怖分子有关。

en: the reason why something, especially something bad, happens
exampleEn: The police are still trying to establish the cause of the fire.
exampleCn: 警方仍在努力查证失火的原因。

en: a formal statement of the rules on which a subject of study is based or of ideas that are suggested to explain a fact or event or, more generally, an opinion or explanation
exampleEn: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.
exampleCn: 他认为那个洞是陨石坠落形成的。

en: (especially of accidents and other unexpected events) to happen
exampleEn: An accident involving over ten vehicles has occurred in the east-bound lane.
exampleCn: 在东向车道上发生了一起涉及十多辆汽车的交通事故。

en: special, or this and not any other
exampleEn: She wanted a particular type of cactus.
exampleCn: 她要某一特定品种的仙人掌。

en: the conditions that you live or work in and the way that they influence how you feel or how effectively you can work
exampleEn: The office is quite bright and airy - it's a pleasant working environment.
exampleCn: 办公室明亮、通风，工作环境不错。

en: a part of something
exampleEn: Cost was a key element in our decision.
exampleCn: 价钱是我们决策时考虑的主要因素。

cn: 较重要的；主要的；重大的
en: more important, bigger, or more serious than others of the same type
exampleEn: All of her major plays have been translated into English.
exampleCn: 她的主要剧本都被译成了英文。

en: a single living plant, animal, virus, etc.
exampleEn: Amoebae and bacteria are single-celled organisms.
exampleCn: 变形虫和细菌是单细胞生物。

cn: 来源，出处；发源地；起源，根源
en: the place something comes from or starts at, or the cause of something
exampleEn: Oranges are a good source of vitamin C.
exampleCn: 橙子富含维生素C。

en: a problem, a series of events, or a person being dealt with by police, doctors, lawyers, etc.
exampleEn: Several social workers have looked into the child's case.
exampleCn: 几名社会工作者已经调查了这个孩子的案例。

en: a level of material, such as a type of rock or gas, that is different from the material above or below it, or a thin sheet of a substance
exampleEn: There was a thin layer of oil on the surface of the water.
exampleCn: 水面上有一层薄薄的油膜。

en: the way in which the parts of a system or object are arranged or organized, or a system arranged in this way
exampleEn: The structure of this protein is particularly complex.
exampleCn: 这种蛋白质的结构特别复杂。

en: the bottom part of an object, on which it rests, or the lowest part of something
exampleEn: At the base of the cliff was a rocky beach.
exampleCn: 悬崖的下面是多岩石的海滩。

en: a substance in a form like air that is neither solid nor liquid
exampleEn: Oxygen, hydrogen, and nitrogen are all gases.
exampleCn: 氧气、氢气和氮气都是气体。

en: a method or way of doing something
exampleEn: Are there any means of getting there?
exampleCn: 有什么方法可以到那里吗？

en: to agree with and give encouragement to someone or something because you want him, her, or it to succeed
exampleEn: I think it's important to support local businesses by buying locally.
exampleCn: 我认为购买本地商品来支持本地企业这一点很重要。

en: a chemical element present in all animals and plants and in coal and oil
exampleEn: Diamonds are formed from carbon.
exampleCn: 钻石由碳构成。

en: the work of a group or organization to achieve an aim
exampleEn: He was found guilty of terrorist activity.
exampleCn: 他因从事恐怖主义活动而被判有罪。

cn: 大量的；大规模的；大批的
en: having an effect on or involving a large number of people or forming a large amount
exampleEn: weapons of mass destruction

cn:
①事情，事件

②（某一类）物质
en:
①a situation or subject that is being dealt with or considered

②a substance of a particular kind
exampleEn: I don't talk with my boss about my private matters.
exampleCn: 我不和我的老板谈私事。

en: a change of position
exampleEn: If you did so, you would lose the movement of the knee.
exampleCn: 如果你这样做,你的膝关节就不能活动了。

en: the people living in one particular area or people who are considered as a unit because of their common interests, social group, or nationality
exampleEn: He's well known in the local community.
exampleCn: 他在当地非常出名。

cn:
①成长；生长；发育

②增多；增强；增长；增大
en:
①The growth of a person, animal, or plant is its process of increasing in size.

②an increase in the size or the importance of something
exampleEn: A balanced diet is essential for healthy growth.
exampleCn: 营养均衡的饮食对于健康发育是不可或缺的。

cn: 太阳的；来自太阳的；使用太阳能的
en: of or from the sun, or using the energy from the sun to produce electric power
exampleEn: solar radiation

en: a fact or situation that influences the result of something
exampleEn: economic factors

cn:
①（包围地球的）大气，大气层，大气圈

②气氛；环境
en:
①the mixture of gases around the earth

②the character, feeling, or mood of a place or situation
exampleEn: These factories are releasing toxic gases into the atmosphere.
exampleCn: 这些工厂向大气中排放有毒气体。

cn:
①期，期限

②术语；专门名称；措词
en:
①the fixed period of time that something lasts for

②a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, often to describe something official or technical
exampleEn: He served a short term for drunk driving.
exampleCn: 他因酒后开车而短期入狱。

en: the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of times it happens or changes in a particular period
exampleEn: The taxi was going at a tremendous rate.
exampleCn: 出租车飞速奔驰。

en: the process of making or growing goods to be sold
exampleEn: The company's new model will be going into production early next year.
exampleCn: 这家公司的新型号将于明年初投产。

en: to have an influence on someone or something, or to cause a change in someone or something
exampleEn: Both buildings were badly affected by the fire.
exampleCn: 两座楼都在大火中严重受损。

en: a small, round, or oval object produced by a plant and from which, when it is planted, a new plant can grow
exampleEn: The farmers grow these crops for seed.
exampleCn: 农民种这些庄稼是为了育种。

en: in the end, especially after a long time or a lot of effort, problems, etc.
exampleEn: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
exampleCn: 我们的班机最终晚了五个小时起飞。

en: a powerful effect that something, especially something new, has on a situation or person
exampleEn: The anti-smoking campaign had had quite an impact on young people.
exampleCn: 禁烟运动对年轻人影响很大。

en: with this result
exampleEn: They planned to reduce staff and thus to cut costs.
exampleCn: 他们计划裁员，从而达到降低成本的目的。

en: ability to control people and events
exampleEn: Once nicotine has you in its power, it's very difficult to stop smoking.
exampleCn: 一旦尼古丁对你起了作用，戒烟就很难了。

en: said when you are judging one thing in comparison with other things
exampleEn: He's a relatively good squash player.
exampleCn: 他是个比较不错的壁球运动员。

en: to continue to live or exist, especially after coming close to dying or being destroyed or after being in a difficult or threatening situation
exampleEn: These plants cannot survive in very cold conditions.
exampleCn: 这些植物无法在非常寒冷的条件下生存。

en: relating to chemicals
exampleEn: The chemical industry produces such things as petrochemicals, drugs, and rubber.
exampleCn: 化学工业生产诸如石化产品、药品、橡胶之类的东西。

en: any picture, especially one formed by a mirror or a lens
exampleEn: The image you see in the mirror.
exampleCn: 你在镜子中看到的映像

cn: （使）展开，（使）铺开；（使）蔓延，（使）扩散
en: to (cause to) cover, reach, or have an effect on a wider or increasing area
exampleEn: The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.
exampleCn: 风很大，火势迅速蔓延开来。

en: used when referring to the main or most important characteristic or feature of something
exampleEn: The village has remained basically unchanged for over 300 years.
exampleCn: 这个村子三百多年来基本上没怎么变。

en: something that you plan to do or achieve
exampleEn: Her main objective now is simply to stay in power.
exampleCn: 她现在的主要目标就是继续掌权。

en: one only
exampleEn: He knocked his opponent down with a single blow.
exampleCn: 他仅用一拳就打倒了对手。

cn:
①由许多相关的不同部分组成的；构造复杂的

②难懂的，费解的；错综复杂的
en:
①involving a lot of different but related parts

②difficult to understand or find an answer to because of having many different parts
exampleEn: The company has a complex organizational structure.
exampleCn: 公司组织结构非常复杂。

en: a useful or valuable possession or quality of a country, organization, or person
exampleEn: The country's greatest resource is the dedication of its workers.
exampleCn: 这个国家最大的资源就是劳动者的奉献精神。

en: considering the whole of someone or something, and not just a particular part of him, her, or it
exampleEn: Your health is generally good, but you do have a few minor problems.
exampleCn: 总的来说你身体状况不错，但有些小毛病。

cn:
①有机的，不使用化肥的

②生物的；有机物的
en:
①not using artificial chemicals in the growing of plants and animals for food and other products

②being or coming from living plants and animals
exampleEn: organic food

cn: 影响，作用；有影响的人（或物）
en: the power to have an effect on people or things, or a person or thing that is able to do this
exampleEn: Helen's a bad influence on him.
exampleCn: 海伦对他有不良的影响。

cn:
①倾向；易于；往往会

②照顾，照管；护理
en:
①to be likely to behave in a particular way or have a particular characteristic

②to care for something or someone
exampleEn: We tend to get cold winters and warm, dry summers in this part of the country.
exampleCn: 在我国这个地区，往往冬季寒冷而夏季温暖干燥。

en: to show, point, or make clear in another way
exampleEn: Please indicate which free gift you would like to receive.
exampleCn: 请标出你想要哪种免费礼物。

en: a group of events that happen in a particular order, one following the other, and are often repeated
exampleEn: We have studied the life cycle of a moth
exampleCn: 我们研究了蛾的生命周期

en: the natural purpose (of something) or the duty (of a person)
exampleEn: I'm not quite sure what my function is within the company.
exampleCn: 我拿不太准自己在公司里有什么职责。

en: physical, especially violent, strength, or power
exampleEn: I don't hold with the use of force.
exampleCn: 我不赞成使用武力。

en: a typical quality or an important part of something
exampleEn: The town's main features are its beautiful mosque and ancient marketplace.
exampleCn: 漂亮的清真寺和古老的集市是该镇的主要特色。

cn:
①身体的，肉体的

②实物的；物质的；有形的；按自然规律的
en:
①relating to the body

②relating to things you can see or touch, or relating to the laws of nature
exampleEn: I'm not a very physical sort of person.
exampleCn: 我不是那种喜欢体育活动的人。

cn:
①压力

②压力，紧迫；催促
en:
①the force you produce when you press something

②the act of trying to make someone else do something by arguing, persuading, etc.
exampleEn: He put too much pressure on the door handle and it snapped.
exampleCn: 他用力过猛，把门把手弄断了。

en: the position or purpose that someone or something has in a situation, organization, society, or relationship
exampleEn: What is his role in this project?
exampleCn: 他在这个工程中负责什么？

en: more important than anything else; main
exampleEn: The primary responsibility lies with those who break the law.
exampleCn: 主要的责任在于那些违法者。

cn: （数量、种类等变化的）范围，幅度，区域
en: the amount, number, or type of something between an upper and a lower limit
exampleEn: It's difficult to find a house in our price range.
exampleCn: 在我们的价格范围以内，很难找到房子。

cn: 电影剧本；剧本；广播稿；讲话稿
en: the words of a film, play, broadcast, or speech
exampleEn: Bruce Robinson wrote the script for "The Killing Fields".
exampleCn: 布鲁斯‧罗宾逊为《战火屠城》写了剧本。

en: in every part, or during the whole period of time
exampleEn: He yawned throughout the performance.
exampleCn: 演出期间他一直在打哈欠。

en: important or noticeable
exampleEn: There has been a significant increase in the number of women students in recent years.
exampleCn: 近年来，女学生的人数有了显著增加。

en: the smallest basic unit of a plant or animal
exampleEn: DNA is stored in the nucleus of a cell.
exampleCn: DNA储存在细胞核中。

en: to provide something that is wanted or needed, often in large quantities and over a long period of time
exampleEn: At the beginning of termthe semester, students are supplied with a list of books that they are expected to read.
exampleCn: 在学期初，学生们拿到了一份阅读书目清单。

en: used for farming or relating to farming
exampleEn: The world's supply of agricultural land is shrinking fast.
exampleCn: 世界农业用地面积正在迅速减少。

en: relating to trade, industry, and money
exampleEn: The country has been in a very poor economic state ever since the decline of its two major industries.
exampleCn: 自从这个国家的两大支柱产业衰退后，其经济一直萎靡不振。

en: farming
exampleEn: Agriculture is still largely based on traditional methods in some countries.
exampleCn: 一些国家的农业仍然主要依靠传统耕作手段。

en: to watch carefully the way something happens or the way someone does something, especially in order to learn more about it
exampleEn: Children learn by observing adults.
exampleCn: 儿童通过观察成年人来学习。

cn:
①坚固的；坚硬的

②实心的，无空隙的
en:
①hard or firm, keeping a clear shape

②completely hard or firm all through an object, or without any spaces or holes
exampleEn: The drill is strong enough to bore through solid rock.
exampleCn: 这把钻足以钻透坚固的岩石。

en: relating to one thing and not others; particularz
exampleEn: The virus attacks specific cells in the brain.
exampleCn: 这种病毒专门攻击大脑内特定的细胞。

en: a chemical element that is a gas with no smell or colour. Oxygen forms a large part of the air on earth, and is needed by animals and plants to live.
exampleEn: Plants absorb oxygen.
exampleCn: 植物吸收氧气。

en: the part of a plant that grows down into the earth to get water and food and holds the plant firm in the ground
exampleEn: The tree's roots go down three metres.
exampleCn: 这棵树的根延伸到地底下三米。

cn:
①完全地；绝对地

②仅仅；只不过
en:
①completely or as much as possible

②only
exampleEn: You look simply beautiful in that dress.
exampleCn: 你穿那条裙子看上去真漂亮。

en: information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer
exampleEn: The data was collected by various researchers.
exampleCn: 这些数据是由不同的研究人员收集的。

cn:
①演化；进化

②发展；演变
en:
①the way in which living things change and develop over millions of years

②a gradual process of change and development
exampleEn: Darwin's theory of evolution

en: a typical or noticeable quality of someone or something
exampleEn: Unfortunately a big nose is a family characteristic.
exampleCn: 不幸的是，大鼻子是家族特征。

en: involving or relating to most or all people, things, or places, especially when these are considered as a unit
exampleEn: The general feeling is that justice was not served.
exampleCn: 普遍的看法是这样做没有达成公平合理。

en: the companies and activities involved in the process of producing goods for sale, especially in a factory or special area
exampleEn: The city needs to attract more industry.
exampleCn: 这个城市需要吸引更多的工业。

en: the buildings of a college or university and the land that surrounds them
exampleEn: There's housing for about five hundred students on campus.
exampleCn: 校园内可供大概五百名学生住宿。

en: a mountain with a large, circular hole at the top through which lava gases, steam, and dust are or have been forced out
exampleEn: The long-dormant volcano has recently shown signs of erupting.
exampleCn: 这座休眠已久的火山最近有喷发迹象。

cn: 假定，假设；臆断，想当然地认为
en: to accept something to be true without question or proof
exampleEn: We mustn't assume the suspects' guilt.
exampleCn: 我们千万不能臆断犯罪嫌疑人有罪。

en: of the present time
exampleEn: The word is no longer in current use.
exampleCn: 这个单词现在已不再使用了。

cn:
①认出，识别

②确定；发现
en:
①to recognize someone or something and say or prove who or what that person or thing is

②to recognize a problem, need, fact, etc. and to show that it exists
exampleEn: Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.
exampleCn: 就连年龄最小的婴儿也能根据声音分辨出自己的妈妈。

en: involved in a particular activity
exampleEn: She's very active in local politics.
exampleCn: 她积极参与当地的政治活动。

en: possible when the necessary conditions exist
exampleEn: Many potential customers are waiting for a fall in prices before buying.
exampleCn: 很多潜在的顾客都在等着降价再购买。

cn:
①反射（光、热、声等）；反映；映出（影像）

②显示；反映；表达
en:
①If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it.

②to show, express, or be a sign of something
exampleEn: He saw himself reflected in the mirror.
exampleCn: 他在镜子里看到了自己的影像。

en: to continue to have; to keep in existence, or not allow to become less
exampleEn: It is absolutely vital that food supplies should be maintained.
exampleCn: 维持食物的供给是绝对必要的。

en: having parts that are close together so that it is difficult to go or see through
exampleEn: a dense forest

en: a group of people or things that is chosen out of a larger number and is asked questions or tested in order to get information about the larger group
exampleEn: a nationally representative sample of 200 schools
exampleCn: 具有全国代表性的两百个学校样本

en: the process of doing something, especially when dealing with a problem or difficulty
exampleEn: This problem calls for swift action from the government.
exampleCn: 这一问题需要政府马上采取行动。

cn: 采用；引进；推行；放入，插入
en: to put something into use, operation, or a place for the first time
exampleEn: We want to introduce the latest technology into schools.
exampleCn: 我们想向各学校推介最新的技术。

cn: 发现（的过程）；被发现的事物
en: the process of finding information, a place, or an object, especially for the first time, or the thing that is found
exampleEn: Leonardo made many scientific discoveries.
exampleCn: 莱昂纳多有许多科学发现。

en: to discover the exact size or amount of something
exampleEn: They measured the height of the ceiling.
exampleCn: 他们测量了天花板的高度。

en: objects that are made out of clay by hand
exampleEn: They sell pottery and other handmade goods.
exampleCn: 他们卖陶器和其他手工制品。

en: to talk or write about someone or something, especially in only a few words
exampleEn: In her autobiography she occasionally refers to her unhappy schooldays.
exampleCn: 在其自传中，她偶尔提及了她不快乐的学生时代。

en: a story, especially one that might be invented or difficult to believe
exampleEn: He told some fascinating tales about his life in India.
exampleCn: 他讲了他在印度生活的一些奇闻轶事。

en: of or in a city or town
exampleEn: Most of the population is an urban population.
exampleCn: 大部分人口是城市人口。

en: an agreement or an arrangement, especially in business
exampleEn: I'll make a deal with you.
exampleCn: 我会与你做一个交易。

en: a period of ten years, especially a period such as 2010 to 2019
exampleEn: Environmental awareness has increased dramatically over the past decade.
exampleCn: 在过去十年中，环保意识急剧提高。

en: to start a company or organization that will continue for a long time
exampleEn: The new treaty establishes a free trade zone.
exampleCn: 新条约设立了自由贸易区。

en: the beginning or cause of something
exampleEn: It's a book about the origin of the universe.
exampleCn: 这是一本关于宇宙起源的书。

en: with rapid movements
exampleEn: Crime figures are rising rapidly.
exampleCn: 犯罪数字正在迅速上升。

en: If things of the same type vary, they are different from each other, and if you vary them, you cause them to be different from each other.
exampleEn: The samples varied in quality but were generally acceptable.
exampleCn: 这些样品质量有差异，但是大体上可以接受。

en: an answer or reaction
exampleEn: Responses to our advertisement have been disappointing.
exampleCn: 人们对我们广告的反应令人失望。

en: human society with its well-developed social organizations, or the culture and way of life of a society or country at a particular period in time
exampleEn: Some people think that nuclear war would mean the end of civilization.
exampleCn: 有人认为核战争将意味着文明的终结。

en: the act of observing something or someone
exampleEn: The police are keeping the suspect under observation.
exampleCn: 警方监视着犯罪嫌疑人。

en: any of various usually liquid substances that can react with and sometimes dissolve other materials
exampleEn: acetic acid

en: a level of quality
exampleEn: We have very high safety standards in this laboratory.
exampleCn: 我们这个实验室有很高的安全标准。

en: the process of adding numbers or amounts together
exampleEn: children learning addition and subtraction

en: the ability to think carefully about something you are doing and nothing else
exampleEn: The noise outside made concentration difficult.
exampleCn: 外面吵得我难以集中注意力。

en: an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose
exampleEn: Rescuers used a special device for finding people trapped in collapsed buildings.
exampleCn: 救援者使用特殊器械来寻找被困在倒塌建筑物下面的人。

en: to take something in, especially gradually
exampleEn: Plants absorb carbon dioxide.
exampleCn: 植物吸收二氧化碳。

en: a chemical element that is a reddish-brown metal, used especially for making wire and coins
exampleEn: a copper alloy
exampleCn: 铜合金

en: without any doubt
exampleEn: He definitely said he'd be here.
exampleCn: 他明确说过他会在这里。

en: to cause something to exist
exampleEn: The new development will generate 1,500 new jobs.
exampleCn: 新开发项目将会创造一千五百个新的就业岗位。

en: very, to a large degree, or at a high level
exampleEn: For our country to remain competitive, we need a highly-skilled, highly-educated workforce.
exampleCn: 为了使我们的国家保持竞争力，我们需要具备高技能、高学识的劳动力。

en: to not have or not have enough of something that is needed or wanted
exampleEn: He just lacks a little confidence.
exampleCn: 他只是有点缺乏自信。

cn: 定时的；固定的；有规律的；规则的；均匀的
en: existing or happening repeatedly in a fixed pattern, with equal or similar amounts of space or time between one and the next; even
exampleEn: Her heartbeat was regular.
exampleCn: 她的心跳很正常。

en: relating to religion
exampleEn: religious education

en: from or relating to the area between the two tropics
exampleEn: The Amazon river basin contains the world's largest tropical rainforest.
exampleCn: 亚马孙河流域有世界上最大的热带雨林。

cn: 担心；忧虑；挂念；忧虑的事情
en: a worried or nervous feeling about something, or something that makes you feel worried
exampleEn: My concern is that you're not getting enough work done.
exampleCn: 我担心的是你你工作的完成量不够。

en: any stage in a series of events or in a process of development
exampleEn: The project is only in its initial phase as yet, but it's looking quite promising.
exampleCn: 该项目前才刚起步，但看起来很有前途。

en: to need a particular thing or the help and support of someone or something in order to continue, to work correctly, or to succeed
exampleEn: The success of this project relies on everyone making an effort.
exampleCn: 这个项目的成功要靠每个人的努力。

en: the hot gas that is produced when water boils
exampleEn: The pump is driven by steam.
exampleCn: 这个泵是由蒸汽驱动的。

en: to take part in a race or competition
exampleEn: Both girls compete for their father's attention.
exampleCn: 两个女孩在父亲面前争宠。

en: to keep something as it is, especially in order to prevent it from decaying or being damaged or destroyed
exampleEn: We want to preserve the character of the town while improving the facilities.
exampleCn: 我们想在改善市镇设施的同时保持其特色。

cn: （使）结合；（使）联合；（使）合并；（使）综合
en: to (cause to) exist together, or join together to make a single thing or group
exampleEn: Sickness, combined with terrible weather, contrived to ruin the trip.
exampleCn: 疾病，加上恶劣的天气，毁掉了这次旅行。

cn: 出生国的；出生地的；土生土长的
en: relating to or describing someone's country or place of birth or someone who was born in a particular country or place
exampleEn: She returned to live and work in her native Japan.
exampleCn: 她回到她的出生地日本生活和工作。

en: different from
exampleEn: Unlike you, I'm not a great dancer.
exampleCn: 我可不像你，我不太会跳舞。

en: related to buying and selling things
exampleEn: a commercial organization

en: a principle or idea
exampleEn: The concept of free speech is unknown to them.
exampleCn: 他们没有言论自由的概念。

en: to turn from something solid into something soft or liquid, or to cause something to do this
exampleEn: The sun melted the snow.
exampleCn: 太阳使雪融化。

cn: 出席，在场；（事物的）存在，出现
en: the fact that someone or something is in a place
exampleEn: The document was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
exampleCn: 这项文件签署时有两个证人在场。

en: fast or sudden
exampleEn: The disease is spreading at a rapid rate.
exampleCn: 这种疾病正在迅速蔓延。

en: to give freedom or free movement to someone or something
exampleEn: The surgery released him from years of pain.
exampleCn: 手术使他摆脱了多年的病痛。

en: used to say you have read or been told something although you are not certain it is true
exampleEn: Apparently it's going to rain today.
exampleCn: 看样子今天有雨。

en: the work of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.
exampleEn: She works in the construction industry.
exampleCn: 她在建筑行业工作。

en: to give something, especially money, in order to provide or achieve something together with other people
exampleEn: Aren't you going to contribute towards Jack's leaving present?
exampleCn: 你不打算凑一份钱给杰克买送别礼物吗？

en: to gradually become less, worse, or lower
exampleEn: His interest in the project declined after his wife died.
exampleCn: 他妻子死后他对于这个项目的兴趣也减少了。

en: to guess or calculate the cost, size, value, etc. of something
exampleEn: Police estimate the crowd at 30 000.
exampleCn: 警方估计聚集的人有三万。

en: in or related to industry, or having a lot of industry and factories, etc.
exampleEn: He has an industrial background.
exampleCn: 他在业界工作过。

en: the size or level of something, especially when this is large
exampleEn: We don't yet know the scale of the problem.
exampleCn: 我们还不知道问题有多严重。

cn: 在地下（的），在地面以下的
en: below the surface of the earth; below ground
exampleEn: Moles live underground.
exampleCn: 鼹鼠生活在地下。

en: to study or examine something in detail, in order to discover more about it
exampleEn: We need to analyse what went wrong.
exampleCn: 我们需要分析是什么出了差错。

en: the fact that you no longer have something or have less of something
exampleEn: He suffered a gradual loss of memory.
exampleCn: 他的记忆力越来越差了。

en: at a greater distance from the centre
exampleEn: the outer lane of the motorway
exampleCn: 高速公路的外车道

en: a very important change in the way that people do things
exampleEn: a technological revolution

en: a change in amount or level
exampleEn: global temperature variations over the last 100 years
exampleCn: 过去一百年间全球气温的变化

en: coming from or created by volcanoes
exampleEn: Molten volcanic lava solidifies as it cools.
exampleCn: 火山熔岩冷却后变成固体。

cn: 生物的；与生命过程有关的
en: connected with the natural processes of living things
exampleEn: Eating is a biological necessity!
exampleCn: 吃是一种生理需求！

en: the system of trade and industry by which the wealth of a country is made and used
exampleEn: Tourism contributes millions of pounds to the local economy.
exampleCn: 旅游业带来数百万英镑的地方收入。

cn: 全部的；整个的；完全的；完整的
en: whole or complete, with nothing missing
exampleEn: Between them they ate an entire cake.
exampleCn: 他们两个吃了整整一个蛋糕。

en: an action, movement, or sound that gives information, a message, a warning, or an order
exampleEn: When she gave them the signal, they all cheered.
exampleCn: 她发出信号后，他们都欢呼起来。

en: extremely big
exampleEn: A vast audience watched the broadcast.
exampleCn: 大量的观众观看了转播。

cn: 外加的，附加的；额外的；另外的
en: extra
exampleEn: There will be an extra charge for any additional passengers.
exampleCn: 如额外再上乘客，将会加收费用。

en: one part of a situation, problem, subject, etc.
exampleEn: Which aspects of the job do you most enjoy?
exampleCn: 你最喜欢这个工作的哪些方面？

en: the number 1,000,000,000
exampleEn: The population of China is over a billion.
exampleCn: 中国的人口超过十亿。

en: to say that something is true or is a fact, although you cannot prove it and other people might not believe it
exampleEn: He claims to have met the president, but I don't believe him.
exampleCn: 他声称见过总统，可是我不信。

cn: 紧密地，密切地，直接联系地
en: in a way that is directly connected or has a strong relationship
exampleEn: English and German are closely related.
exampleCn: 英语和德语的亲缘关系很近。

en: without anyone or anything else being involved or between
exampleEn: She decided to take direct control of the project.
exampleCn: 她决定直接管理这个项目。

cn: 乡村的，农村的；似乡村的
en: in, of, or like the countryside
exampleEn: The area is still very rural and undeveloped.
exampleCn: 这个地区仍是一片乡村景象，没有被开发。

en: relating to seeing
exampleEn: The building makes a tremendous visual impact.
exampleCn: 这栋建筑物给人以极其深刻的视觉印象。

en: the forward movement of something, or an improvement or development in something
exampleEn: Recent advances in medical science mean that this illness can now be cured.
exampleCn: 医学新近取得的进展意味着这种疾病现在不再是绝症了。

en: the act of analysing something
exampleEn: Chemical analysis revealed a high content of copper.
exampleCn: 化学分析结果显示出极高的铜含量。

cn: （使）（尺寸、数量或重要性）扩大，增加；（使）膨胀
en: to increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way
exampleEn: We have to expand the size of the image.
exampleCn: 我们不得不扩大图像的尺寸。

en: to reach, stretch, or continue
exampleEn: The Sahara Desert extends for miles.
exampleCn: 撒哈拉沙漠绵延数百英里。

en: to make known or show something that is surprising or that was previously secret
exampleEn: He was jailed for revealing secrets to the Russians.
exampleCn: 他因为向俄国人泄密而被监禁。

en: pleased with your situation and not hoping for change or improvement
exampleEn: He seems fairly content with his life.
exampleCn: 他好像对生活相当满足。

cn:
①批评的；批判的；挑剔的；谨严的

②关键性的；决定性的；至关重要的
en:
①saying that someone or something is bad or wrong

②of the greatest importance to the way things might happen
exampleEn: The report is highly critical of safety standards at the factory.
exampleCn: 这篇报道尖锐地批评了那家工厂的安全标准。

cn: 骤然的；戏剧性的；激动人心的
en: very sudden or noticeable, or full of action and excitement
exampleEn: We watched scenes of the dramatic rescue on the news.
exampleCn: 我们在新闻中看到了惊心动魄的救援场面。

en: very large in amount or degree
exampleEn: They were reduced to extreme poverty.
exampleCn: 他们沦落到极度贫困的地步。

en: behaviour, a feeling or an action that is a direct result of something else
exampleEn: I love to watch people's reactions when I say who I am.
exampleCn: 我喜欢观察人们在听到我说出我是谁时的反应。

en: the light that comes from the sun
exampleEn: The lake sparkled in the bright sunlight.
exampleCn: 在明亮的阳光下，湖面波光粼粼。

en: the fact of a person, organization, etc. continuing to live or exist
exampleEn: England are fighting for survival in this game.
exampleCn: 这场比赛中，英格兰队在为生存而战。

cn: 现实的，实际的；真实的，真正的
en: existing in fact
exampleEn: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
exampleCn: 实际成本比我们预计的要高。

cn: 能产生预期结果的；有效的
en: successful or achieving the results that you want
exampleEn: It's an extremely effective cure for a headache.
exampleCn: 这种药物治疗头痛极其有效。

cn:
①建议；提议；提出

②计划，打算
en:
①to offer or suggest a possible plan or action for other people to consider

②to intend to do something
exampleEn: She proposed a boycott of the meeting.
exampleCn: 她建议抵制这次会议。

en: a strong metal that is a mixture of iron and carbon, used for making things that need a strong structure, especially vehicles and buildings
exampleEn: The frame is made of steel.
exampleCn: 这个架子是钢制的。

cn: 容积，容量；生产能力；办事能力
en: the total amount that can be contained or produced, or (especially of a person or organization) the ability to do a particular thing
exampleEn: The new stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000.
exampleCn: 这个新的体育场可以容纳五万人。

en: an obvious difference between two or more things
exampleEn: I like the contrast of the white trousers with the black jacket.
exampleCn: 我喜欢白色长裤与黑色夹克形成的反差。

cn:
①给...下定义；说明，解释

②界定；确定；限定
en:
①to say what the meaning of something, especially a word, is

②to explain and describe the meaning and exact limits of something
exampleEn: The term 'mental illness' is difficult to define.
exampleCn: “精神病”这个词很难下定义。

en: to remove what is covering something so that it can be seen
exampleEn: The plaster on the walls has been removed to expose the original bricks underneath.
exampleCn: 墙上的灰泥已被除去，露出了里面原本的墙砖。

en: public or official
exampleEn: a formal announcement

en: slowly over a period of time or a distance
exampleEn: Gradually, she realized that he wasn't telling her the truth.
exampleCn: 她渐渐地意识到他不跟她说实话。

en: to press or be pressed against something with a circular or up-and-down repeated movement
exampleEn: She yawned and rubbed her eyes sleepily.
exampleCn: 她打着哈欠睡意朦胧地揉着眼睛。

en: to take goods or people from one place to another
exampleEn: Such heavy items are expensive to transport by plane.
exampleCn: 这样重的物品用飞机运输很贵。

cn:
①进化的

②演变的；逐步发展的
en:
①relating to the way in which living things develop over millions of years

②involving a gradual process of change and development
exampleEn: evolutionary theory

en: inside or contained within something else
exampleEn: Leading off the main hall is a series of small inner rooms.
exampleCn: 从主客厅开始是一系列小的内室。

en: existing or happening inside a person, object, organization, place, or country
exampleEn: He sustained injuries to his arms, legs, and several internal organs.
exampleCn: 他的手臂、腿和一些内脏都受了伤。

cn: 总的（来说） ；全面的（地） ；包括一切的（地）
en: in general rather than in particular, or including all the people or things in a particular group or situation
exampleEn: Overall, it has been a good year.
exampleCn: 总的来说，这一年很不错。

en: someone who speaks or does something officially for another person or group of people
exampleEn: The firm has representatives in every major city.
exampleCn: 这家公司在每个大城市都设有销售代表。

en: to keep animals for the purpose of producing young animals in a controlled way
exampleEn: His main income comes from breeding cattle.
exampleCn: 他的主要收入来自养牛。

en: the state of being related to someone or something else
exampleEn: The connection between smoking and heart disease is well known.
exampleCn: 吸烟和心脏病之间的联系已为人们所熟知。

cn: （尺寸、数量或重要性的）扩大，增加，扩展
en: the increase of something in size, number, or importance
exampleEn: Expansion into new areas of research is possible.
exampleCn: 拓展新的研究领域是可能的。

en: to complete school, college, or university successfully
exampleEn: After he graduated from high school, he joined the Army.
exampleCn: 他高中毕业后参军了。

en: a substance made from a combination of different substances, or any combination of different things
exampleEn: You need a spoon to beat the mixture smooth.
exampleCn: 你需要用一把调羹来搅均混合液。

en: to be a sign or symbol of something
exampleEn: To many people the White House represents the identity of the United States.
exampleCn: 在许多人看来，白宫是美国的象征。

cn: 环（状物）；圆形的东西；环形排列
en: a circle of any material, or any group of things or people in a circular shape or arrangement
exampleEn: The children sat in a ring around the teacher.
exampleCn: 孩子们围着老师坐成一圈。

en: a number of similar or related events or things, one following another
exampleEn: They do a series on architecture throughout the ages.
exampleCn: 他们出版一套介绍各个时代建筑的系列图书。

en: having only a short distance from the top to the bottom
exampleEn: The stream was fairly shallow so we were able to walk across it.
exampleCn: 小溪很浅，所以我们可以趟水过去。

en: a sign, shape, or object that is used to represent something else
exampleEn: A heart shape is the symbol of love.
exampleCn: 心形是爱的象征。

cn: 独一无二的；与众不同的；唯一的；独特的；罕见的
en: being the only existing one of its type or, more generally, unusual, or special in some way
exampleEn: I'd recognize your handwriting anywhere - it's unique.
exampleCn: 无论在哪儿，我都能认出你的笔迹——它太与众不同了。

en: to become familiar with a new situation
exampleEn: It took me a while to adapt to the new job.
exampleCn: 我过了一段时间才适应了新工作。

en: in a normal way
exampleEn: Relax and try to behave naturally.
exampleCn: 放松，举止自然点。

cn: 计划表；日程安排表；进度表
en: a list of planned activities or things to be done showing the times or dates when they are intended to happen or be done
exampleEn: The class schedule is available on the website.
exampleCn: 课程表可在网站上查到。

en: a sign that something has happened or existed
exampleEn: When she moved out, she left no trace of having been there.
exampleCn: 她搬走后，没有留下任何在那儿住过的痕迹。

en: the number or amount of something in general
exampleEn: It's the sheer volume of traffic in the city that is causing the problems.
exampleCn: 造成这些问题的就是城里的交通流量。

en: a person related to you who lived a long time ago
exampleEn: There were portraits of his ancestors on the walls of the room.
exampleCn: 房间墙壁上挂着他祖先的画像。

en: all the time or often
exampleEn: She has the TV on constantly.
exampleCn: 她总是开着电视。

en: to break something so that it does not separate, but very thin lines appear on its surface, or to become broken in this way
exampleEn: A stone hit the window and cracked the glass.
exampleCn: 石块击中窗户，打裂了玻璃。

cn:
①统治；控制

②在…中占首要地位；拥有优势；最明显的
en:
①to have control over a place or person

②to be the largest, most important, or most noticeable part of something
exampleEn: He refuses to let others speak and dominates every meeting.
exampleCn: 每次开会他都专横跋扈，不让他人讲话。

cn: 广阔的，大面积的；覆盖范围广的
en: covering a large area; having a great range
exampleEn: Her knowledge of music is extensive.
exampleCn: 她的音乐知识非常广博。

en: mainly
exampleEn: We're primarily concerned with keeping expenditure down.
exampleCn: 我们主要关心的是缩减开支。

en: material with particular physical characteristics
exampleEn: What sort of substance could withstand those temperatures?
exampleCn: 哪种物质能够承受那样的温度？

en: relating to art
exampleEn: a work of artistic merit

en: relating to the whole world
exampleEn: a global catastrophe
exampleCn: 世界性灾难

cn:
①放置，安放，平放

②产（卵）；产（蛋）
en:
①to put something in especially a flat or horizontal position, usually carefully or for a particular purpose

②(of an animal or bird) to produce eggs from out of the body
exampleEn: She laid aside her book and went to answer the phone.
exampleCn: 她把书放在一边去接电话。

en: a painting, photograph, drawing, etc. of a person or, less commonly, of a group of people
exampleEn: She's commissioned an artist to paint her portrait.
exampleCn: 她委托一位画家为她画一幅肖像。

en: the act of choosing someone or something
exampleEn: The showroom has a wide selection of kitchens.
exampleCn: 展厅里有多种式样的厨房可供选择。

cn:
①确定；决定；解决（争端等）

②定居，安家
en:
①to reach a decision or an agreement about something, or to end a disagreement

②to go and live somewhere, especially permanently
exampleEn: They haven't yet settled when the wedding is going to be.
exampleCn: 他们还没有确定婚礼在什么时候举行。

cn: 战略；策略；计谋；行动计划；策划，部署
en:
a detailed plan for achieving success in situations 
such as war, politics, business, industry, or sport, or the skill of planning for such situations
exampleEn: We're working on new strategies to improve our share of the market.
exampleCn: 我们正在研究新的策略，以提高我们的市场份额。

en: a piece of work to be done, especially one done regularly, unwillingly, or with difficulty
exampleEn: We usually ask interviewees to perform a few simple tasks on the computer just to test their aptitude.
exampleCn: 我们通常让接受面试者在电脑上进行一些简单操作，只想测测他们的能力。

en: including a lot of different places, people, subjects, etc.
exampleEn: They have both travelled widely.
exampleCn: 他们俩都游历过很多地方。

en: (in a system for dividing things according to appearance, quality, etc.) a type, or a group of things having some features that are the same
exampleEn: This book clearly falls into the category of fictionalized autobiography.
exampleCn: 这本书显然类属自传体小说。

en: to make someone able to do something, or to make something possible
exampleEn: Computerization should enable us to cut production costs by half.
exampleCn: 实现计算机化可以使我们的生产成本减半。

en: very large in size, amount, or number
exampleEn: They have a massive house.
exampleCn: 他们有一座很大的房子。

en: the use of reason in understanding such things as the nature of the real world and existence, the use and limits of knowledge, and the principles of moral judgment
exampleEn: a professor of philosophy

en: something that you must do, or something you need
exampleEn: A good degree is a minimum requirement for many jobs.
exampleCn: 很多工作的最低要求是要有一个好的学位。

cn: 专门研究，专攻；专门从事
en: to spend most of your time studying one particular subject or doing one type of business
exampleEn: We specialize in quality furniture.
exampleCn: 我们专营高档家具。

en: compared with the fact that; but
exampleEn: Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.
exampleCn: 有一些研究结果令人满意，然而其他的则不然。

en: the support or approval of something or someone
exampleEn: Her economic theories are in favour with the current government.
exampleCn: 她的经济理论获得现任政府的赞同。

en: an act of exchanging something for money
exampleEn: I haven't made a sale all morning.
exampleCn: 我一上午什么都没卖出去。

cn: 意识到的；明白的；知道的
en: knowing that something exists, or having knowledge or experience of a particular thing
exampleEn: I wasn't even aware that he was ill.
exampleCn: 我都不知道他生病了。

en: situated on, or relating to the coast
exampleEn: The coastal resorts are deserted in winter.
exampleCn: 沿海的度假胜地冬天无人居住。

en: skill and experience, especially in relation to making objects; a job or activity that needs skill and experience, or something produced using skill and experience
exampleEn: I bought a wooden salad bowl at the local craft fair.
exampleCn: 我在当地的手工艺品博览会上买了一个木制沙拉碗。

cn: 生态的；生态学的；环保的
en: relating to ecology or the environment
exampleEn: The destruction of the rain forests is an ecological disaster.
exampleCn: 雨林遭破坏是一种生态灾难。

en:
①to buy or bring in products from another country

②to introduce new goods, customs, or ideas to one country from another
exampleEn: We import a large number of cars from Japan.
exampleCn: 我们从日本进口大量的汽车。

en: the inside part of something
exampleEn: the interior of a building

en: the scientific study of the way the human mind works and how it influences behaviour, or the influence of a particular person's character on their behaviour
exampleEn: She studied psychology at Harvard.
exampleCn: 她在哈佛大学学习心理学。

en: a part of an animal's body, sticking out from the base of the back, or something similar in shape or position
exampleEn: The dog wagged its tail excitedly.
exampleCn: 那条狗兴奋地摇着尾巴。

en: a cylinder-shaped device for making objects that are far away look closer and larger, using a combination of lenses, or lenses and curved mirrors
exampleEn: With a good telescope, you can see craters on the moon.
exampleCn: 用好的望远镜，你可以看到月球上的环形山。

en: able to be seen
exampleEn: The comet should be visible to the naked eye.
exampleCn: 肉眼应该能看见那颗彗星。

en: something that you believe
exampleEn: All religious and political beliefs should be respected equally.
exampleCn: 对所有宗教和政治信仰应予以同等尊重。

en: relating to the most important characteristics or ideas of something
exampleEn: It's essentially a dictionary but it differs in one or two respects.
exampleCn: 本质上说这还是一本词典，但在一两个方面它又不同于一般词典。

cn: 越来越多地，不断增加地
en: more and more
exampleEn: Increasingly, there is pressure on the council to reverse its decision.
exampleCn: 要求市政会推翻其决定的压力越来越大。

en: one of many tissues in the body that can tighten and relax to produce movement
exampleEn: He strained his muscle in the match.
exampleCn: 他在那次比赛中拉伤了肌肉。

en: a large system consisting of many similar parts that are connected together to allow movement or communication between or along the parts, or between the parts and a control centre
exampleEn: We could reduce our costs by developing a more efficient distribution network.
exampleCn: 我们可以通过发展更为高效的分销系统来降低成本。

en: a belief, principle, or way of acting that people in a particular society or group have continued to follow for a long time, or all of these beliefs, etc. in a particular society or group
exampleEn: Asia has long tradition of tea-drinking.
exampleCn: 亚洲有饮茶的悠久传统。

en: the movement of people or goods from one place to another
exampleEn: the safe transportation of used nuclear fuel

cn:
①树皮

②狗叫声；嗥叫声
en:
①the hard outer covering of a tree

②the loud, rough noise that a dog and some other animals make
exampleEn: Deer had stripped the tree of its bark.
exampleCn: 鹿啃掉了树皮。

en: the mixture you get when two or more things are combined
exampleEn: This drug can be safely used in combination with other medicines.
exampleCn: 这药可以同其他药物一起安全服用。

en: a result of a particular action or situation, often one that is bad or not convenient
exampleEn: Not making a will can have serious consequences for your children and other family members.
exampleCn: 不立遗嘱可能会给你的子女或者家庭其他成员带来严重后果。

en: the situation within which something exists or happens, and that can help explain it
exampleEn: You must place these events in their historical context.
exampleCn: 必须把这些事件同它们的历史环境联系起来看。

en: a period of time of which particular events or stages of development are typical
exampleEn: They had worked for peace during the long era of conflict.
exampleCn: 在漫长的冲突不断的年代里，他们努力争取和平。

cn: 主要地；大多；在很大程度上
en: almost completely
exampleEn: Their complaints have been largely ignored.
exampleCn: 他们的抱怨大多被无视了。

en: first of all
exampleEn: Originally it was a bedroom, but we turned it into a study.
exampleCn: 这原本是间卧室，但我们把它改成了书房。

en: an evergreen tree that grows in cooler areas of the world
exampleEn: a plantation of pines

en: to consider or have an opinion about something or someone
exampleEn: Her parents always regarded her as the smartest of their children.
exampleCn: 她父母一贯把她看作是所有子女中最聪明的。

en: a little
exampleEn: She's slightly taller than her sister.
exampleCn: 她比她姐姐稍高一点儿。

en: an examination of opinions, behaviour, etc., made by asking people questions
exampleEn: The survey covers a representative sample of schools.
exampleCn: 调查覆盖了有代表性的一些学校。

en: a device or hole for catching animals or people and preventing their escape
exampleEn: The fox got its foot caught in a trap.
exampleCn: 狐狸的一只脚被夹子夹住了。

en: almost
exampleEn: Their twins are virtually identical.
exampleCn: 他们的双胞胎长得几乎一模一样。

cn: 专注，专心；全神贯注；集中（注意力）
en: to direct your attention or your efforts towards a particular activity, subject, or problem
exampleEn: I can't concentrate on my work with all that noise.
exampleCn: 那么吵，我没法集中精力。

cn: 与…不同，跟…不一样，有区别
en: to be not like something or someone else, either physically or in another way
exampleEn: The twins look alike, but they differ in temperament.
exampleCn: 这对双胞胎长得相像，但性格却不同。

en: to appear by coming out of something or out from behind something
exampleEn: She emerged from the sea, blue with cold.
exampleCn: 她从海里出来，冻得发紫。

en: area or length; amount
exampleEn: From the top of the Empire State Building, you can see the full extent of Manhattan.
exampleCn: 从帝国大厦顶层你可以看到曼哈顿全景。

cn: （高等院校中院系的）全体教师
en: a group of departments in a college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects
exampleEn: the Law School faculty

en: the control and organization of something
exampleEn: The company has suffered from several years of bad management.
exampleCn: 公司已数年经营不善。

cn:
①（动物的）主人

②大师，名家；专家
en:
①the person who owns, cares for, and controls an animal

②a person who is very skilled in a particular job or activity
exampleEn: The dog remained faithful to his master.
exampleCn: 这条狗始终忠于它的主人。

cn: 实际的；实干的；有实际经验的
en: relating to experience, real situations, or actions rather than ideas or imagination
exampleEn: What's the use of theoretical knowledge that has no practical application?
exampleCn: 理论知识如果没有实际应用又有什么用呢？

cn: 现实的；实事求是的；务实的
en: accepting things as they are in fact and not making decisions based on unlikely hopes for the future
exampleEn: It isn't realistic to expect people to work for so little money.
exampleCn: 给那么点报酬还指望人们干这个工作，这是不现实的。

cn: （音乐、诗歌和舞蹈的）节奏，韵律，节律
en: a strong pattern of sounds, words, or musical notes that is used in music, poetry, and dancing
exampleEn: He beat out a jazz rhythm on the drums.
exampleCn: 他击出爵士乐节奏的鼓点。

en: the hard outer covering of something, especially nuts, eggs, and some animal
exampleEn: Brazil nuts have very hard shells.
exampleCn: 巴西果的壳很坚硬。

cn: 抽象的；纯理论的；纯概念的
en: existing as an idea, feeling, or quality, not as a material object
exampleEn: Truth and beauty are abstract concepts.
exampleCn: 真和美都是抽象的概念。

en: a long pole, fence, wall, or natural feature, such as a mountain or sea, that stops people from going somewhere
exampleEn: The mountains acted as a natural barrier to the spread of the disease.
exampleCn: 群山成为了阻止该疾病扩散的天然屏障。

cn: 有能力的；熟练的；能干的
en: able to do things effectively and achieve results
exampleEn: We need to get an assistant who's capable and efficient.
exampleCn: 我们需要一个能力强、效率高的助理。

cn:
①作曲；创作（乐曲、诗歌）；著（书）

②组成，构成
en:
①to produce music, poetry, or formal writing

②to be the parts that something is made of
exampleEn: The music was specially composed for the film.
exampleCn: 这音乐是专门为该电影创作的。

en: the fact of something or someone existing
exampleEn: Many people question the existence of God.
exampleCn: 很多人怀疑上帝是否真的存在。

en: used in negatives to mean "in every case" or "therefore"
exampleEn: That's not necessarily true.
exampleCn: 那不一定是真的。

en: the state of things as they are, rather than as they are imagined to be
exampleEn: His theories are somewhat remote from reality.
exampleCn: 他的理论有点儿脱离现实。

en: in a way that is easy to see or by a large amount
exampleEn: Profits have increased significantly over the past few years.
exampleCn: 几年来，利润大幅度提高了。

en: to change completely the appearance or character of something or someone, especially so that that thing or person is improved
exampleEn: The reorganization will transform the entertainment industry.
exampleCn: 这次重组将使娱乐业大为改观。

en: a particular form of something that is slightly different from other forms of the same thing
exampleEn: The official version of events is that the police were attacked and were just trying to defend themselves.
exampleCn: 事件的官方说法是警察受到了攻击，他们只是想自卫。

en: the fact of someone or something not succeeding
exampleEn: The meeting was a total failure.
exampleCn: 这次会议是彻头彻尾的失败。

en: one of the many soft, light things that cover a bird's body, consisting of a long, thin, central part with material like hairs along each side
exampleEn: The bird ruffled its feathers.
exampleCn: 这只鸟竖起了羽毛。

cn:
①映像；映照出的影像；反射

②显示；反映；表达
en:
①the image of something in a mirror or on any reflective surface

②a sign or result of something
exampleEn: He put silver foil around the fire to increase heat reflection.
exampleCn: 他用银箔围住火炉来增加热的反射。

en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms
exampleEn: The rock weighed over a ton and was completely immovable.
exampleCn: 这块石头重一吨多，完全不能动。

en: the fact of not existing
exampleEn: They complained about the absence of vegetarian food on the menu.
exampleCn: 他们抱怨菜单上没有素食。

cn: 清晰可见的；显而易见的；明白易懂的
en: able to be seen or understood
exampleEn: Her unhappiness was apparent to everyone.
exampleCn: 谁都看得出来她很不开心。

en: a set of connected or related things
exampleEn: His resignation was followed by a remarkable chain of events.
exampleCn: 在他辞职之后，发生了一系列引人注目的事件。

cn: （对动植物、自然地区、历史建筑等的）保护
en: the protection of plants and animals, natural areas, and interesting and important structures and buildings, especially from the damaging effects of human activity
exampleEn: The government is trying to pass laws concerning wildlife conservation
exampleCn: 政府正在通过野生生物保护的法案。

cn: （使）改变，（使）转变；（使）改信；（使）皈依
en: to (cause something or someone to) change in form or character
exampleEn: Could we convert the small bedroom into a second bathroom?
exampleCn: 我们能把这间小卧室改建成第二间浴室吗？

en: to give something out to several people, or to spread or supply something
exampleEn: The books will be distributed free to local schools.
exampleCn: 这些书将免费发放给当地学校。

en: completely
exampleEn: The company is run almost entirely by middle-aged men.
exampleCn: 管理这个公司的几乎都是中年男性。

en: to use something in a way that helps you
exampleEn: We need to make sure that we exploit our resources as fully as possible.
exampleCn: 我们需要确保尽可能充分利用资源。

en: someone who has guests
exampleEn: We thanked our hosts for a very enjoyable evening.
exampleCn: 我们感谢主人让我们度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

en: related to the Middle Ages (= the period in European history from about AD 600 to AD 1500)
exampleEn: Knighthood was an ideal in medieval Europe.
exampleCn: 在中世纪的欧洲，成为骑士是理想。

cn: 占有，占用，占据（空间或时间）
en: to fill, exist in, or use a place or period of time
exampleEn: The rest of the time was occupied with writing a report.
exampleCn: 剩下的时间用来写了份报告。

cn:
①情节

②小块土地，小块地皮
en:
①the story of a book, film, play, etc.

②a small piece of land that has been marked or measured for a particular purpose
exampleEn: The movie has a very simple plot.
exampleCn: 这部电影情节很简单。

en: the putting and keeping of things in a special place for use in the future
exampleEn: We've had to build some cupboards to give us more storage space.
exampleCn: 我们不得不做了些壁橱来增加储藏空间。

en: poisonous
exampleEn: They might eat something toxic and damage their health.
exampleCn: 它们可能会吃到一些有毒的东西，损害到健康。

en: relating to schools, colleges, and universities, or connected with studying and thinking, not with practical skills
exampleEn: academic standards

cn: 经常发生的；连续发生的；连续不断的
en: happening a lot or all the time
exampleEn: He's in constant trouble with the police.
exampleCn: 他与警方麻烦不断。

en: suddenly or obviously
exampleEn: Your life changes dramatically when you have a baby to take care of.
exampleCn: 有了孩子以后你的生活会骤然发生巨大的变化。

en: to look at or consider a person or thing carefully and in detail in order to discover something about them.
exampleEn: The research examined the effects of alcohol on long-term memory.
exampleCn: 这项研究探讨了酒精对长期记忆的影响。

en: in addition; more importantly
exampleEn: The house is beautiful. Furthermore, it's in a great location.
exampleCn: 这座房子很漂亮，而且位置也非常好。

en: operated by a machine, or connected with machines or their parts
exampleEn: The company produces mechanical parts for airplane engines.
exampleCn: 这家公司生产飞机引擎的机械部件。

en: to disagree with something or someone, often by speaking or fighting against it, him, or her
exampleEn: The proposed new testing system has been vigorously opposed by teachers.
exampleCn: 实行新考试制度的提议遭到了教师们的强烈反对。

en: a set of ideas or a plan of what to do in particular situations that has been agreed to officially by a group of people, a business organization, a government, or a political party
exampleEn: What is your party's policy on immigration?
exampleCn: 你们党关于移民的政策是什么？

en: a small area of usually still water
exampleEn: She looked at her reflection in the deep green pool of water.
exampleCn: 她看着她在绿色深潭中的倒影。

en: relating to work that needs special training or education
exampleEn: If it's a legal matter you need to seek professional advice.
exampleCn: 如果这属于法律问题，你就需要进行专业咨询了

cn: 原料未经加工的，自然状态的
en: (of materials) in a natural state, without having been through any chemical or industrial process
exampleEn: The raw sewage is chemically treated.
exampleCn: 未经处理的污水要进行化学处理。

cn: 非凡的；奇异的；引人注目的
en: unusual or special and therefore surprising and worth mentioning
exampleEn: It is indeed a remarkable achievement.
exampleCn: 这的确是非凡的成就。

cn:
①精于世故的，老练的；见多识广的；很有品位的

②精密的，复杂的；高级的
en:
①having a good understanding of the way people behave and/or a good knowledge of culture and fashion

②intelligent or made in a complicated way and therefore able to do complicated tasks
exampleEn: These people are very sophisticated observers of the foreign policy scene.
exampleCn: 这些人是外交政策领域干练的观察家。

en: relating to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry
exampleEn: I have a few technical problems.
exampleCn: 我有几个技术问题。

en: a large amount of money or valuable possessions that someone has
exampleEn: During a successful business career, she accumulated a great amount of wealth.
exampleCn: 在成功的经商生涯中，她积累了巨额财富。

en: to accept or start to use something new
exampleEn: The new tax would force companies to adopt energy-saving measures.
exampleCn: 征收新税将迫使公司采取节能措施。

en: to make a very strong and urgent request
exampleEn: They begged for mercy.
exampleCn: 他们乞求饶恕。

en: to build something or put together different parts to form something whole
exampleEn: The walls are constructed of concrete.
exampleCn: 墙是用混凝土筑成的。

cn: 法院；法庭；全体出庭人员；全体审判人员
en: a place where trials and other legal cases happen, or the people present in such a place, especially the officials and those deciding if someone is guilty
exampleEn: Protestors gathered outside the court to await the verdict.
exampleCn: 抗议者聚集在法庭外等待判决。

en: to show or make something clear
exampleEn: These problems demonstrate the importance of strategic planning.
exampleCn: 这些问题说明了战略规划的重要性。

cn: 多种多样的，形形色色的
en: including many different types of people or things
exampleEn: New York is a very culturally diverse city.
exampleCn: 纽约是一个在文化方面具有多样性的城市。

cn: 采用；引进；推行；放入，插入
en: an occasion when something is put into use or brought to a place for the first time
exampleEn: The introduction of new working practices has dramatically improved productivity.
exampleCn: 采用新的工作方法已经显著提高了生产率。

en: (used to add information) also and more importantly
exampleEn: He was, moreover, a poet of promise.
exampleCn: 此外，他还是一个有前途的诗人。

en: earth that has been mixed with water
exampleEn: My car's stuck in the mud, and it won't budge.
exampleCn: 我的车陷入泥中，一动也不动。

en: someone who studies or writes about the meaning of life
exampleEn: Plato was a Greek philosopher.
exampleCn: 柏拉图是古希腊哲学家。

cn: 回答，作答；回应，作出反应
en: to say or do something as a reaction to something that has been said or done
exampleEn: I asked him his name, but he didn't respond.
exampleCn: 我问他叫什么名字，可他没回答。

en: used to show that you think a word that is used to describe someone or something is not suitable or not correct
exampleEn: It isn't yet clear how dangerous these so-called "super-rats" are.
exampleCn: 目前还不清楚这种名叫“超级老鼠”的东西有多危险。

cn: （谈话、书籍、电影等的）题目，主题
en: the main subject of a talk, book, film, etc.
exampleEn: The theme of loss runs through most of his novels.
exampleCn: 失落这一主题贯穿了他的大多数小说作品。

en: under the surface of the water, especially under the surface of the sea
exampleEn: Some species of turtle can remain underwater for a long time.
exampleCn: 有些种类的海龟能在水下呆很长时间。

en: to change something, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change
exampleEn: We've had to alter some of our plans.
exampleCn: 我们不得不对一些计划作了改动。

en: a person who buys goods or services for their own use
exampleEn: The new rates will affect all consumers, including businesses.
exampleCn: 新的费率会影响到所有用户，包括工商企业。

en: to notice or understand the difference between two things, or to make one person or thing seem different from another
exampleEn: I sometimes have difficulty distinguishing Spanish from Portuguese.
exampleCn: 我有时很难分清西班牙语和葡萄牙语。

en: to collect several things, often from different places or people
exampleEn: We gathered blueberries from the bushes.
exampleCn: 我们从灌木上采摘蓝莓。

en: very much, used especially to show how much you feel or experience something
exampleEn: I greatly regret not having told the truth.
exampleCn: 我非常后悔没有说出实情。

en: an occasion when an army or country uses force to enter and take control of another country
exampleEn: They were planning to mount an invasion of the north of the country.
exampleCn: 他们正计划发动对该国北部的侵略。

en: to produce goods in large numbers, usually in a factory using machines
exampleEn: He works for a company that manufactures car parts.
exampleCn: 他在一家生产汽车部件的公司工作。

en: the act or process of returning something to its earlier good condition or position
exampleEn: The first task following the disaster was the restoration of clean water supplies.
exampleCn: 灾难过后的首要任务就是要恢复清洁水的供应。

en: approximately
exampleEn: They all left at roughly the same time.
exampleCn: 他们都是大约同一时间离开的。

en: to (cause to) move easily and without interruption over a surface
exampleEn: When I was little I used to like sliding on the polished floor in my socks.
exampleCn: 小时候我喜欢穿着短袜在光亮的地板上滑行。

en: the rise and fall of the sea that happens twice every day
exampleEn: The tide is out.
exampleCn: 潮退了。

en: the ability to see
exampleEn: She has very little vision in her left eye.
exampleCn: 她的左眼几乎失明了。

cn: （计划或方法）可替代的；可供选择的
en: An alternative plan or method is one that you can use if you do not want to use another one.
exampleEn: We can make alternative arrangements if necessary.
exampleCn: 如果需要，我们可以作出其他安排。

cn: 人工制品，制造物，手工艺品
en: an object that is made by a person, such as a tool or a decoration, especially one that is of historical interest
exampleEn: The museum's collection includes artefacts dating back to prehistoric times.
exampleCn: 这家博物馆的藏品包括一些史前器物。

en: A classic book, film, etc. is one that has been popular for a long time and is considered to be of a high quality.
exampleEn: Another classic goal there from Corley!
exampleCn: 科利又踢进一个漂亮球！

en: a person who writes music
exampleEn: In my opinion, no other composers even begin to approach Mozart.
exampleCn: 我认为，没有其他作曲家开始接触莫扎特。

en: existing or happening now
exampleEn: Although the play was written hundreds of years ago, it still has a contemporary feel to it.
exampleCn: 这个剧本尽管写于几百年前，但读来仍具现代感。

en: without a pause or interruption
exampleEn: My computer makes a continuous low buzzing noise.
exampleCn: 我的电脑不停地发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

en: perfect, or the best possible
exampleEn: She's the ideal person.
exampleCn: 她是这项工作的理想人选。

cn: 交流，交往；互相作用，互相影响
en: to communicate with or react to
exampleEn: Teachers have a limited amount of time to interact with each child.
exampleCn: 教师和每个孩子沟通的时间有限。

cn:
①理解，解释，阐释

②翻译，口译
en:
①to decide what the intended meaning of something is

②to change what someone is saying into another language
exampleEn: It's difficult to interpret these statistics without knowing how they were obtained.
exampleCn: 不了解这些统计数字是怎样得来的就难以理解它们。

en: exact and accurate
exampleEn: We don't know the precise details of the story yet.
exampleCn: 我们不知道故事的确切细节。

en: exactly
exampleEn: The fireworks begin at eight o'clock precisely.
exampleCn: 烟花在八点整开始燃放。

en: the possibility of something bad happening
exampleEn: In this business, the risks and the rewards are high.
exampleCn: 这个行业的风险和回报都很高。

en: to try to find or get something, especially something that is not a physical object
exampleEn: "Are you actively seeking jobs?" she asked.
exampleCn: “你在积极地找工作吗？”她问。

en: the ability to do things that need a lot of physical or mental effort
exampleEn: We will struggle on, drawing our strength from the courage of others.
exampleCn: 我们应该从其他人的勇气中汲取力量，继续奋斗。

en: the quality of being true
exampleEn: There would seem to be some truth in what she says.
exampleCn: 她说的话似乎有些真实的成分。

en: a state where things are of equal weight or force
exampleEn: She had to hold onto the railings to keep her balance.
exampleCn: 她得扶住围栏才能保持平衡。

cn: 至关重要的；关键的；决定性的
en: extremely important or necessary
exampleEn: Her work has been crucial to the project's success.
exampleCn: 她的工作对于这个项目的成功至关重要。

cn: 给…留下深刻印象；使钦佩
en: to cause someone to admire or respect you
exampleEn: I remember when I was a child being very impressed with how many toys she had.
exampleCn: 我记得小时候我对她有那么多的玩具羡慕不已。

en: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
exampleEn: That is a city of five million inhabitants.
exampleCn: 拥那是一个有五百万居民的城市。

en: a description of the main facts about something
exampleEn: Some novelists start by writing an outline.
exampleCn: 有些小说家创作时会先写个提纲。

cn: 远的；遥远的；久远的；关系疏远的
en: far away in distance or time, or not closely related
exampleEn: remote galaxies

en: the frame of bones supporting a human or animal body
exampleEn: We found an old sheep skeleton up on the cliffs.
exampleCn: 我们在悬崖上发现了一副老绵羊的骨架。

en: relating to the tide
exampleEn: The tidal stream or current gradually decreases in the shallows.
exampleCn: 浅滩上的潮水逐渐退去。

en: a plant whose yellowish-brown grain is used for making flour, or the grain itself
exampleEn: Wheat is a staple crop for millions of people across the world.
exampleCn: 小麦是一种为全世界亿万人提供主食的农作物。

en: to mix up someone's mind or ideas, or to make something difficult to understand
exampleEn: You're confusing him! Tell him slowly and one thing at a time.
exampleCn: 你把他搞糊涂了！慢慢跟他讲，一次说一件事。

cn: 相当大的；相当多的；非常可观的；相当重要的
en: large or of noticeable importance
exampleEn: The fire caused considerable damage to the church.
exampleCn: 那场火灾给教堂造成了重大损失。

en: traditional and ordinary
exampleEn: I find his art dull and conventional.
exampleCn: 我觉得他的艺术作品乏味俗套。

en: (a) serious discussion of a subject in which many people take part
exampleEn: Education is the current focus of public debate.
exampleCn: 教育是当前公众争论的焦点。

en: to become gradually damaged, worse, or less; to cause something to do this
exampleEn: Sugar makes your teeth decay.
exampleCn: 糖使得你的牙齿腐烂。

en: (at, in, from, or to) another place or other places; anywhere or somewhere else:
exampleEn: They were living well, in comparison with people elsewhere in the world.
exampleCn: 和世界上其他地方的人们比起来，他们过着舒适的生活。

en: a strong feeling such as love or anger, or strong feelings in general
exampleEn: Like a lot of men, he finds it hard to express his emotions.
exampleCn: 像很多男人一样，他不大会表达自己的感情。

en: to experience something, especially something unpleasant
exampleEn: When did you first encounter these difficulties?
exampleCn: 你什么时候开始遇到这些困难的？

cn:
①称赞的；赞同的

②有利的；有助益的
en:
①showing that you like or approve of someone or something

②giving you an advantage or more chance of success
exampleEn: We have had a favorable response to the plan so far.
exampleCn: 到目前为止，关于此计划我们得到的反馈是肯定的。

cn: 可变动的；灵活的；可变通的
en: able to change or be changed easily according to the situation
exampleEn: My schedule is flexible - I could arrange to meet with you any day next week.
exampleCn: 我的时间安排很灵活——下周任何一天我都可以安排与你见面。

cn: （因特殊、重要或巨大而）给人留下深刻印象的
en: If an object or achievement is impressive, you admire or respect it, usually because it is special, important, or very large.
exampleEn: There are some very impressive buildings in the town.
exampleCn: 镇上有一些非常雄伟的建筑物。

en: the lower part of your face that moves when you open your mouth
exampleEn: He has a square jaw.
exampleCn: 他长着方下巴。

en: the larger number or part of something
exampleEn: In Britain women are in the majority.
exampleCn: 在英国，女性占多数。

cn: 较不重要的；次要的；轻微的
en: having little importance, influence, or effect, especially when compared with other things of the same type
exampleEn: We can only make minor concessions, but it might break the deadlock.
exampleCn: 我们只能做些较小的让步，但这就可能打破僵局。

en: not either of two things or people
exampleEn: Neither my mother nor my father went to university.
exampleCn: 我父母都没有上过大学。

en: being or using the power produced when the nucleus of an atom is divided or joined to another nucleus
exampleEn: Nuclear power is cleaner than coal.
exampleCn: 核能比煤更清洁。

en: agreed to or arranged by people in positions of authority
exampleEn: The Queen will attend the official opening of the theatre in June.
exampleCn: 女王将在六月份参加这家剧院的正式落成典礼。

en: with equal or similar amounts of space or time between one and the next
exampleEn: We meet regularly to discuss progress on the project.
exampleCn: 我们有规律地定期见面讨论项目进展。

en: to (cause something to) move somewhere by turning over and over or from side to side
exampleEn: The vase rolled off the edge of the table and smashed.
exampleCn: 花瓶从桌边滚落下来摔得粉碎。

cn: 技术的，关于（或涉及）技术的
en: relating to, or involving, technology
exampleEn: We live in an age of rapid technological advance.
exampleCn: 我们生活在技术迅猛发展的时代。

en: according to tradition; in a traditional way
exampleEn: Men traditionally monopolized jobs in the printing industry.
exampleCn: 在传统上，男人包揽了印刷行业中的所有工作。

cn:
①呼吁，吁请，求助，恳求

②吸引力；感染力；魅力
en:
①a request to the public for money, information, or help

②the quality in someone or something that makes him, her, or it attractive or interesting
exampleEn: The police have issued an appeal to the public to stay away from the area over the weekend.
exampleCn: 警察呼吁公众在周末远离这一地区。

en: made by people, often as a copy of something natural
exampleEn: an artificial lake

cn:
①协会；社团；联盟

②联系；关系；关联
en:
①a group of people who work together in a single organization for a particular purpose

②the fact of being involved with or connected to someone or something
exampleEn: The Football Association

en: to take someone as a prisoner, or to take something into your possession, especially by force
exampleEn: Two of the soldiers were killed and the rest were captured.
exampleCn: 两名士兵被杀，其余被俘。

en: someone whose job is to give their opinion about something, especially films, books, music, etc.
exampleEn: The play has been well received by the critics.
exampleCn: 该剧赢得了评论家们的赞誉。

en: a large reptile with a hard skin that lives in and near rivers and lakes in hot, wet parts of the world. It is like an alligator, but it usually has a longer and narrower nose
exampleEn: Among the animals are the puma, manatee, alligator and crocodile, but the number of these has been greatly diminished by hunting.
exampleCn: 在动物中有美洲狮，海牛，短吻鳄和鳄鱼，但由于狩猎，它们的数量已大大减少。

en: far away
exampleEn: She could hear the distant sound of fireworks exploding.
exampleCn: 她能听到远处放焰火的声音。

en: working or operating in an organized, quick, and effective way:
exampleEn: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?
exampleCn: 你是如何激励人们努力而高效地工作的？

en: to show a feeling, opinion, or fact
exampleEn: Her eyes expressed deep sadness.
exampleCn: 她眼神中流露出深切的悲伤。

en: at the beginning
exampleEn: Initially, most people approved of the new plan.
exampleCn: 起初，大部分人都同意这个新方案。

en: completely grown physically
exampleEn: Mature male gorillas have silver-grey hairs on their backs.
exampleCn: 成年雄性大猩猩背部有银灰色毛发。

en: relating to or belonging to the armed forces
exampleEn: In some countries all the young men do a year's military service.
exampleCn: 有些国家，所有年轻男子都要服一年兵役。

en: neither
exampleEn: I can't be at the meeting and nor can Andrew.
exampleCn: 我无法出席会议，安德鲁也去不了。

en: a large tree that is common in northern countries, or the hard wood of this tree
exampleEn: The timbers of those old sailing ships were mostly oak.
exampleCn: 制造那些老帆船的木料主要是橡木。

cn: （移动的）步速；（发生的）速度；节奏
en: the speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes
exampleEn: When she thought she heard someone following her, she quickened her pace.
exampleCn: 她觉得听见有人在尾随她，便加快了脚步。

en: the act of protecting or state of being protected
exampleEn: New legislation still does not offer adequate protection for many endangered species.
exampleCn: 新的法律还是没有给许多濒临灭绝的物种提供充分的保护。

en: to bring the memory of a past event into your mind, and often to give a description of what you remember
exampleEn: The old man recalled the city as it had been before the war.
exampleCn: 这位老人回忆起战前这座城市的样子。

en: the connection or similarity between two things
exampleEn: The relation between the original book and this new film is very faint.
exampleCn: 原著和这部新电影之间没太多联系。

en: to cause something to reach, often as far as possible, in a particular direction
exampleEn: She stretched out her hand and helped him from his chair.
exampleCn: 她伸手将他从椅子上扶起来。

cn:
①结实的；坚固的；坚强的

②困难的；棘手的
en:
①strong; not easily broken or made weaker or defeated

②difficult to do or to deal with
exampleEn: These toys are made from tough plastic.
exampleCn: 这些玩具是由结实的塑料制成的。

en: to behave towards someone or deal with something in a particular way
exampleEn: My parents treated us all the same when we were kids.
exampleCn: 小时候父母对我们一视同仁。

en: used to emphasize that what you are saying is true
exampleEn: At this time of year the river is a truly beautiful sight.
exampleCn: 每年的这个时候，这条河的景色确实很美。

en: the fact that something can be bought, used, or reached, or how much it can be
exampleEn: The ready availability of guns has contributed to the escalating violence.
exampleCn: 人们太容易弄到枪支，这也成了暴力事件激增的一个诱因。

en: a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is
exampleEn: I think she coped very well under the circumstances.
exampleCn: 我觉得在那种情况下她处理得很不错。

cn: （由于压力、无力或缺乏支持而）倒塌，坍塌；崩溃，垮掉
en: to fall down suddenly because of pressure or having no strength or support
exampleEn: Thousands of buildings collapsed in the earthquake.
exampleCn: 数以千计的建筑物在地震中倒塌了。

en: to organize and perform a particular activity
exampleEn: The experiments were conducted by scientists in New York.
exampleCn: 这些实验是科学家在纽约做的。

en: the act of destroying something, or the fact of being destroyed
exampleEn: Many people are very concerned about the destruction of the rainforests.
exampleCn: 许多人都非常关注雨林遭破坏的问题。

en: a difference between two similar things
exampleEn: There's a clear distinction between the dialects spoken in the two regions.
exampleCn: 这两个地区的方言有着明显的不同。

en: a wild mammal belonging to the dog family that has a pointed face and ears, a wide tail covered in fur, and often reddish-brown fur
exampleEn: As the fox came into the yard, the chickens began squawking in alarm.
exampleCn: 狐狸一走进院子，小鸡们就开始惊慌地嘎嘎叫起来。

en: happening or done without delay or very soon after something else
exampleEn: We must make an immediate response.
exampleCn: 我们必须立即作出反应。

en: in a way that is independent
exampleEn: It was the first time that she had lived independently.
exampleCn: 那是她第一次独立生活。

en: of or at the beginning
exampleEn: My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.
exampleCn: 我最初的惊讶很快变成了兴奋。

en: using the real or original meaning of a word or phrase
exampleEn: They were responsible for literally millions of deaths.
exampleCn: 他们的确对数百万人的死负有责任。

en: either of the two organs in the chest with which people and some animals breathe
exampleEn: There's a high correlation between smoking and lung cancer.
exampleCn: 吸烟和肺癌之间有很高的相关性。

en: to get something, especially by asking for it, buying it, working for it, or producing it from something else
exampleEn: First editions of these books are now almost impossible to obtain.
exampleCn: 这些书的第一版现在已几乎弄不到了。

en: sometimes but not often
exampleEn: I see him occasionally in town.
exampleCn: 我偶尔在城里见到他。

en: resulting in or providing a large amount or supply of something
exampleEn: highly productive farming land

cn: （绘画、电影、书籍等的）现实主义，现实主义风格
en: paintings, films, books, etc. that try to represent life as it really is
exampleEn: The director used handheld camera techniques to add to the gritty realism of the film.
exampleCn: 导演运用了手提式摄像机实拍手法，增加了影片的真实感。

cn: 有关的；相关联的；切题的
en: connected with what is happening or being discussed
exampleEn: Education should be relevant to the child's needs.
exampleCn: 教育应和孩子的需要挂钩。

en: a large mammal that eats fish and lives partly in the sea and partly on land or ice
exampleEn: The dark head of a seal bobbed up a few yards away.
exampleCn: 在几码远处一只海豹的黑脑袋猛地钻出水面。

en: a person who arrives, especially from another country, in a new place in order to live there and use the land
exampleEn: Each settler is given a self-contained complete unit with residential, arable and grazing lot.
exampleCn: 给每个定居者一个独立的完整的单元住宅，耕地和牧场。

en: small in amount or degree
exampleEn: a slight improvement

en: in a way that achieves the results wanted or hoped for
