exampleEn: Heavy snow has caused total chaos on the roads.
exampleCn: 大雪导致道路上交通一片混乱。

cn: （由不同部分组成的）混合物，合成物，综合体
en: something that is made of various different parts
exampleEn: Scientists have put together a composite picture of what the earth's crust is like.
exampleCn: 科学家们拼出了一幅地壳形状复合图。

en: about
exampleEn: I've had a letter from the tax authorities concerning my tax payments.
exampleCn: 我收到了税务部门寄来的关于我纳税情况的一封信。

en: a statement, often written, that an arrangement or meeting is certain
exampleEn: We've only received five confirmations for the conference so far.
exampleCn: 目前我们只收到五封参加会议的确认信。

en: to act or work together for a particular purpose, or to be helpful by doing what someone asks you to do
exampleEn: The two companies have cooperated in joint ventures for the past several years.
exampleCn: 两家公司在过去几年中合作经营合资企业。

cn:
①通信，通信联系

②关联
en:
①the action of writing, receiving, and reading letters, especially between two people

②a connection between two things
exampleEn: Her correspondence with Jim lasted many years.
exampleCn: 她和吉姆保持了多年的通信联系。

en: to make something slightly wet
exampleEn: He dampened his hair to make it lie flat.
exampleCn: 他把头发弄湿，梳得平平的。

en: fixed, certain, or clear
exampleEn: She has very definite opinions.
exampleCn: 她的意见非常明确。

en: (often of something bad) intentional or planned
exampleEn: We made a deliberate decision to live apart for a while.
exampleCn: 我们做了蓄意决定分开住一段时间。

cn: 民主；民主思想；民主政体
en: the belief in freedom and equality between people, or a system of government based on this belief, in which power is either held by elected representatives or directly by the people themselves
exampleEn: The government has promised to uphold the principles of democracy.
exampleCn: 政府承诺将坚持民主的原则。

cn:
①使忧郁，使沮丧

②使萧条；使不景气
en:
①to cause someone to feel unhappy and without hope

②to reduce the amount of activity in something, especially a business operation
exampleEn: This weather depresses me.
exampleCn: 天气使我消沉。

en: to prevent something, especially a system, process, or event, from continuing as usual or as expected
exampleEn: Heavy snow disrupted travel into the city this morning.
exampleCn: 今晨的大雪扰乱了入城交通系统的正常运行。

cn: 使分心；使转移注意力，干扰
en: to make someone stop giving their attention to something
exampleEn: Don't distract her.
exampleCn: 不要让她分心。

en: to start to include more different types or things
exampleEn: Patterns of family life are diversifying.
exampleCn: 家庭生活模式正在变得多样化。

cn: 精力充沛的；充满活力的
en: having or involving a lot of energy
exampleEn: I tried aerobics but it was too energetic for me.
exampleCn: 我试过有氧运动，但是对我来说它太剧烈了。

en: the feeling of enjoying something
exampleEn: I get a lot of enjoyment from music.
exampleCn: 我从音乐中获得很多乐趣。

en: the whole of sth
exampleEn: I've never actually read the book in its entirety.
exampleCn: 实际上我从来没有完整地读过这本书。

en: to provide a person or a place with objects that are necessary for a particular purpose
exampleEn: All the police officers were equipped with shields to defend themselves against the rioters.
exampleCn: 所有警察都配备了盾牌以在与暴乱分子的对抗中防身。

cn: （费用、尺寸、价值等的）估计，估测
en: a guess or calculation about the cost, size, value, etc. of something
exampleEn: estimation of the cost

en: in a way that is easy to see
exampleEn: He was evidently upset by the news of the accident.
exampleCn: 显然，他听到出了事故很是不安。

en: the state of being extremely tired
exampleEn: She felt ill from exhaustion.
exampleCn: 她过于劳累，病倒了。

en: to use or spend time, effort, or money
exampleEn: You expend so much effort for so little return.
exampleCn: 你费了那么大劲儿，回报却如此微不足道。

en: very; more than usual
exampleEn: She is, it must be said, extraordinarily beautiful.
exampleCn: 必须得提一下，她特别美。

en: great trust or confidence in something or someone
exampleEn: She has no faith in modern medicine.
exampleCn: 她对现代医学没有信心。

en: extremely interesting
exampleEn: I found the whole movie fascinating.
exampleCn: 我觉得整部电影都很吸引人。

cn: 使成为正式；使有固定体系；使定形
en: to make something official or decide to arrange it according to a fixed structure
exampleEn: These informal gatherings have become increasingly formalized in the last few years.
exampleCn: 这些聚会起初很随意，但是在过去几年里变得越来越正式。

en: lucky
exampleEn: He was fortunate in his choice of assistant.
exampleCn: 他很幸运，选择了一位好助手。

en: help and advice about how to do something or about how to deal with problems connected with your work, education, or personal relationships
exampleEn: I've always looked to my father for guidance in these matters.
exampleCn: 在这些问题上我总是依靠父亲指点迷津。

en: friendly and peaceful
exampleEn: We have a harmonious family.
exampleCn: 我们家庭和睦。

en: who a person is, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others
exampleEn: The police are trying to discover the identity of the killer.
exampleCn: 警方正努力调查杀人凶手的身份。

en: the act of recognizing and naming someone or something
exampleEn: Each product has a number for easy identification.
exampleCn: 每件产品都有号码以便于识别。

en: to come to live in a different country
exampleEn: They plan to immigrate to Finland next year.
exampleCn: 他们计划明年移居芬兰。

en: something that you want and plan to do
exampleEn: He has announced his intention to retire.
exampleCn: 他已经宣布他打算退休。

en: planned or intended
exampleEn: Did you leave his name out by accident or was it intentional?
exampleCn: 你漏掉了他的名字，是无意的还是有意的？

en: to put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or get an advantage
exampleEn: The institute will invest five million in the project.
exampleCn: 该机构将在这个项目上投资五百万。

en: fairness in the way people are dealt with
exampleEn: There's no justice in the world when people can be made to suffer like that.
exampleCn: 如果人们被迫遭受这样的痛苦，那么世上就没有公正可言了。

en: the freedom to live as you wish or go where you want
exampleEn: the fight for justice and liberty
exampleCn: 争取正义和自由的斗争

en: firm and not changing in your friendship with or support for a person or an organization, or in your belief in your principles
exampleEn: Jack has been a loyal worker in this company for almost 50 years.
exampleCn: 杰克是这家公司忠诚的员工，已经干了快五十年了。

en: to use a machine to do something that used to be done by hand
exampleEn: Farming has been mechanized, reducing the need for labour.
exampleCn: 耕作已经机械化了，减少了对劳动力的需求。

cn:
①完全的控制

②熟练，精通
en:
①complete control of something

②If someone has a mastery of something, they are extremely skilled at it.
exampleEn: her mastery of the situation
exampleCn: 她对局势的牢牢掌控

en: used to emphasize that something is not large or important
exampleEn: It cost a mere 20 dollars.
exampleCn: 那只需花费二十美元。

en: a reason for doing something
exampleEn: Does he have a motive for lying about where he was?
exampleCn: 他有必要隐瞒自己去过哪里吗？

cn: 泥泞的；浑浊的；粘满烂泥的
en: covered by or containing mud
exampleEn: Don't bring those muddy boots inside!
exampleCn: 别把那双粘满烂泥的靴子拿进来！

en: the act of expressing or feeling opposition to or dislike of something or someone
exampleEn: Her objection against the plan is based on incorrect facts.
exampleCn: 她对这项计划的反对基于错误的数据。

en: the fact that you are obliged to do something
exampleEn: If you have not signed a contract, you are under no obligation to pay them any money.
exampleCn: 如果你没有签合同，你就没有义务付给他们钱。

en: If something is optional, you can choose if you want to do it, pay it, buy it, etc.
exampleEn: optional course

en: not complete
exampleEn: The general has ordered a partial withdrawal of troops from the area.
exampleCn: 将军已下令部队部分人员撤出该地区。

en: an amount of money paid
exampleEn: Payment will be remitted to you in full.
exampleCn: 报酬将会全额汇寄给你。

cn:
①古怪；奇异；怪癖

②特点
en:
①the quality of being strange or unusual, or an unusual characteristic or habit

②something that is typical of one person, group, or thing
exampleEn: You couldn't help but be aware of the peculiarity of the situation.
exampleCn: 你必然会意识到情况有些蹊跷。

en: a substance that can make people or animals ill or kill them if they eat or drink it
exampleEn: Her drink had been laced with a deadly poison.
exampleCn: 她的饮料里掺进了致命的毒药。

en: to make an area or substance, usually air, water, or soil, dirty or harmful to people, animals, and plants, especially by adding harmful chemicals
exampleEn: We won't invest in any company that pollutes the environment.
exampleCn: 我们不会给污染环境的公司投资。

en: to make something become popular
exampleEn: The programme did much to popularize little-known writers.
exampleCn: 这个节目大力宣扬不太知名的作家。

cn: 强有力的，强大的；有效力的
en: very powerful, forceful, or effective
exampleEn: a potent argument

en: the state of knowing what something is like, when something will happen, etc.
exampleEn: We need predictability in our schedules.
exampleCn: 我们需要一些可预测性在日程安排中。

en: the act of stopping something from happening or of stopping someone from doing something
exampleEn: Health education in the local population is crucial to the prevention of killer diseases.
exampleCn: 当地居民的健康教育对于预防致命疾病至关重要。

en: the state of being the most important thing
exampleEn: The government insists on the primacy of citizens' rights.
exampleCn: 政府坚持把公民权利放在首位。

en: someone's right to keep their personal matters and relationships secret
exampleEn: The new law is designed to protect people's privacy.
exampleCn: 新法律旨在保护人们的隐私权。

en: the act of encouraging something to happen or develop
exampleEn: The job offers excellent promotion prospects.
exampleCn: 这份工作有很好的升迁机会。

en: intended to advertise something
exampleEn: The school made a short promotional video.
exampleCn: 学校录制了一个宣传短片。

en: a suggestion, sometimes a written one
exampleEn: a proposal to build more office accommodation
exampleCn: 增建办公楼的建议

cn: （发生好事情的）可能，可能性，机会
en: the possibility that something good might happen in the future
exampleEn: Is there any prospect of the weather improving?
exampleCn: 天气有可能好转吗？

en: to make information about something generally available
exampleEn: The event was well publicized all over town.
exampleCn: 这件事在全城传得沸沸扬扬。

en: to successfully finish a training course so that you are able to do a job; to have or achieve the necessary skills, etc.
exampleEn: She hopes to qualify as a lawyer at the end of the year.
exampleCn: 她希望在年底获得律师资格。

en: reacting to events or situations rather than acting first to change or prevent something
exampleEn: I want our organization to be less reactive and more proactive.
exampleCn: 我希望我们的组织少一些被动反应，能够更加积极主动些。

en: the degree to which a material reflects light or radiation
exampleEn: The reflectivity of glass curtain walls will produce more visual phantasmagoric effects.
exampleCn: 玻璃幕墙的反射性则会产生更多的视觉变幻。

cn: 规则，条例，法规；控制，管理
en: an official rule or the act of controlling something
exampleEn: safety regulations

en: to live, have your home, or stay in a place
exampleEn: The family now resides in southern France.
exampleCn: 这家人现居住在法国南部。

en: to move or cause something to move around a central point or line
exampleEn: The earth revolves around the sun.
exampleCn: 地球围绕太阳转。

en: A rhythmic sound has a regular movement or beat that is repeated.
exampleEn: the rhythmic sound of the train
exampleCn: 火车有节奏的声音

en: involving the possibility of something bad happening
exampleEn: It's risky to buy a car without some good advice.
exampleCn: 不好好听取别人的建议就买车是件冒险的事情。

en: a pleasant feeling that you get when you receive something you wanted, or when you have done something you wanted to do
exampleEn: She looked at the finished painting with satisfaction.
exampleCn: 她满意地看着完成的画作。

cn: 令人满意的；使人满足的；够好的
en: good or good enough for a particular need or purpose
exampleEn: The teachers seem to think his work is satisfactory.
exampleCn: 老师们似乎认为他的作品挺不错。

en: process or result of becoming less or smaller
exampleEn: There has been much shrinkage of the clothes in the wash.
exampleCn: 这些衣服洗后已缩了很多。

en: to change from being a liquid or gas to a solid form, or to make something do this
exampleEn: Molten volcanic lava solidifies as it cools.
exampleCn: 火山熔岩冷却后变成固体。

en: to explain or describe something clearly and exactly
exampleEn: He said we should meet but didn't specify a time.
exampleCn: 他说我们应该见见面，但没说具体时间。

en: something that someone says or writes officially, or an action done to express an opinion
exampleEn: We were not surprised by their statement that jobs would be cut.
exampleCn: 我们对他们宣布将进行裁员的消息并不感到吃惊。

en: to make something stronger or more effective, or to become stronger or more effective
exampleEn: The bank loan has greatly strengthened our financial position.
exampleCn: 银行的贷款极大地加强了我们的财力。

cn: 异乎寻常的，惊人的；引人注目的
en: very unusual or easily noticed, and therefore attracting a lot of attention
exampleEn: She bears a striking resemblance to her mother.
exampleCn: 她酷似她母亲。

en: the act of giving something for a decision to be made by others, or a document formally given in this way
exampleEn: No date has yet been set for the submission of applications.
exampleCn: 申请的提交日期还未确定。

en: to be enough
exampleEn: One example will suffice to illustrate the point.
exampleCn: 举一个例子就足以说明这一点。

en: making you feel that something illegal is happening or that something is wrong
exampleEn: Her behaviour was very suspicious.
exampleCn: 她的举止非常可疑。

en: a belief or idea that something may be true
exampleEn: He was arrested on suspicion of murder.
exampleCn: 他因涉嫌谋杀而被捕。

en: nervous and worried and unable to relax
exampleEn: She was very tense as she waited for the interview.
exampleCn: 在等待面试时她非常紧张。

en: to frighten someone very much
exampleEn: The idea of parachuting out of a plane terrifies me.
exampleCn: 一想到从飞机上跳伞，我就害怕。

cn: 极端的；最重要的；最初（或终）的；最好（差）的
en: most extreme or important because either the original or final, or the best or worst
exampleEn: My manager will make the ultimate decision about who to employ.
exampleCn: 我的经理会最终决定雇佣谁。

en: unlucky or having bad effects
exampleEn: It was an unfortunate accident.
exampleCn: 那是一次不幸的事故。
